zh.title: 辨认导数定义
zh.prompt: 设函数 f 在 x₀ 的某邻域内有定义。下列极限中，若存在，哪一个等于 f′(x₀)？

knowledge: 导数是函数增量与自变量增量之比的极限
solution.analysis: 把每个选项与导数的增量定义逐项比较。正确的差商必须同时具有基点 x₀、函数值之差和同一个自变量增量 Δx。
steps: 令自变量从 x₀ 变到 x₀+Δx，则自变量增量是 Δx。
相应的函数增量是 Δy=f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)，所以差商为 Δy/Δx。
当 Δx→0 时，若差商具有有限极限，该极限按定义就是 f′(x₀)。
A 与上述定义完全一致；B、C 的分母不是相应增量，D 的分子也不是函数增量。
pitfalls: 把 x₀ 或 x 当作差商的分母
忘记函数增量是新函数值减去旧函数值
solution.verification: 取 f(x)=x²、x₀=1，A 给出 lim_{Δx→0}(2Δx+Δx²)/Δx=2，与已知斜率一致；其余形式不能稳定给出 2。
solution.takeaway: 认准“同一增量”：分子比较 x₀+Δx 与 x₀，分母就是 Δx。
solution.extension: 把 Δx 换成 x-x₀，可将定义等价写成 lim_{x→x₀}[f(x)-f(x₀)]/(x-x₀)。

en.title: Recognizing the Definition of a Derivative
en.prompt: Suppose f is defined in a neighborhood of x₀. Which limit, if it exists, equals f′(x₀)?

knowledge: a derivative is the limit of a function increment divided by the corresponding input increment
solution.analysis: Compare every option with the increment definition. A valid difference quotient must use the base point x₀, the difference of the two function values, and the same input increment Δx.
steps: When the input changes from x₀ to x₀+Δx, its increment is Δx.
The corresponding function increment is Δy=f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀), so the difference quotient is Δy/Δx.
If this quotient has a finite limit as Δx→0, that limit is f′(x₀) by definition.
Option A matches the definition exactly; B and C use the wrong denominator, while D does not use a function increment.
pitfalls: using x₀ or x instead of the corresponding input increment
forgetting that the function increment is new value minus old value
solution.verification: For f(x)=x² and x₀=1, A gives lim_{Δx→0}(2Δx+Δx²)/Δx=2, the expected slope; the other forms do not reliably produce 2.
solution.takeaway: Track one consistent increment: compare x₀+Δx with x₀ in the numerator and divide by Δx.
solution.extension: Writing Δx=x-x₀ gives the equivalent form lim_{x→x₀}[f(x)-f(x₀)]/(x-x₀).

zh.title: 用极限表示瞬时速度
zh.prompt: 质点沿直线运动，位置为 s=s(t)。它在 t=3 时的瞬时速度可写为 v(3)=______。

knowledge: 平均速度是位置增量除以时间增量
瞬时速度是平均速度的极限
位置函数对时间的导数
solution.analysis: 先写从时刻 3 到 3+Δt 的平均速度，再令时间间隔缩短到 0；不能把位置本身或路程与瞬时速度混淆。
steps: 在时间区间 [3,3+Δt] 上，时间增量为 Δt。
这段时间内的位置增量为 s(3+Δt)-s(3)。
相应平均速度为 [s(3+Δt)-s(3)]/Δt，其中 Δt≠0。
令 Δt→0，若极限存在，就得到 v(3)=lim_{Δt→0}[s(3+Δt)-s(3)]/Δt。
pitfalls: 把 s(3)/3 当作瞬时速度
分子误写成 s(Δt)-s(3)
遗漏 Δt→0 的极限过程
solution.verification: 若 s(t)=2t+1，则差商恒为 2，极限也为 2，符合匀速运动的速度。
solution.takeaway: 瞬时变化率来自“先求有限区间平均变化率，再让区间长度趋于 0”。
solution.extension: 将 3 换成任意 t₀，即得到 v(t₀)=s′(t₀) 的定义。

en.title: Expressing Instantaneous Velocity as a Limit
en.prompt: A particle moves along a line with position s=s(t). Its instantaneous velocity at t=3 can be written as v(3)=______.

knowledge: average velocity is position increment divided by time increment
instantaneous velocity is a limit of average velocities
the derivative of position with respect to time
solution.analysis: First write the average velocity from time 3 to 3+Δt, then shrink the time interval to 0. Position itself must not be confused with velocity.
steps: On the time interval [3,3+Δt], the time increment is Δt.
The corresponding position increment is s(3+Δt)-s(3).
Thus the average velocity is [s(3+Δt)-s(3)]/Δt for Δt≠0.
Letting Δt→0 gives v(3)=lim_{Δt→0}[s(3+Δt)-s(3)]/Δt whenever the limit exists.
pitfalls: using s(3)/3 as the instantaneous velocity
writing s(Δt)-s(3) in the numerator
omitting the limiting process Δt→0
solution.verification: If s(t)=2t+1, the quotient is identically 2, so its limit is 2, as expected for constant velocity.
solution.takeaway: An instantaneous rate is obtained by first forming an average rate over a finite interval and then shrinking the interval to zero.
solution.extension: Replacing 3 by an arbitrary t₀ gives the definition v(t₀)=s′(t₀).

zh.title: 在非零点由定义求导
zh.prompt: 仅用导数定义求 f(x)=x² 在 x=2 处的导数。

solution.analysis: 把 x₀=2 直接代入差商。先展开并提取 Δx，再在 Δx≠0 时约分，最后才能令 Δx→0。
steps: 按定义，f′(2)=lim_{Δx→0}[(2+Δx)²-2²]/Δx。
展开分子：(2+Δx)²-4=4Δx+(Δx)²。
在取极限的穿孔邻域内 Δx≠0，所以差商化为 [4Δx+(Δx)²]/Δx=4+Δx。
pitfalls: 一开始就令 Δx=0，造成 0/0
漏掉展开式中的 4Δx
把 f′(2) 错写成 f(2)
solution.verification: 函数图像 y=x² 在 x=2 附近上升；对称差商 [f(2+h)-f(2-h)]/(2h)=4，也给出相同结果。
solution.takeaway: 定义求导的标准流程是：列差商、代数化简、约去增量、再取极限。
solution.extension: 把 2 换成任意 a，同样计算可得 f′(a)=2a。

en.title: Differentiate at a Nonzero Point from First Principles
en.prompt: Using only the definition of the derivative, find the derivative of f(x)=x² at x=2.

knowledge: canceling a nonzero increment before taking a limit
solution.analysis: Insert x₀=2 into the difference quotient. Expand and factor out Δx, cancel it while Δx≠0, and only then let Δx approach 0.
steps: By definition, f′(2)=lim_{Δx→0}[(2+Δx)²-2²]/Δx.
Expand the numerator: (2+Δx)²-4=4Δx+(Δx)².
In the punctured neighborhood used by the limit, Δx≠0, so the quotient becomes [4Δx+(Δx)²]/Δx=4+Δx.
Letting Δx→0 yields f′(2)=lim_{Δx→0}(4+Δx)=4.
pitfalls: substituting Δx=0 at the beginning and obtaining 0/0
omitting the term 4Δx
confusing f′(2) with f(2)
solution.verification: The graph y=x² rises near x=2. Moreover, the symmetric quotient [f(2+h)-f(2-h)]/(2h)=4 confirms the same value.
solution.takeaway: The first-principles pattern is: form the quotient, simplify algebraically, cancel the increment, and then take the limit.
solution.extension: Replacing 2 by an arbitrary a gives f′(a)=2a by the same calculation.

zh.title: 可导是否保证连续
zh.prompt: 判断正误并说明理由：若 f 在 x₀ 处可导，则 f 在 x₀ 处连续。

knowledge: 有限极限与无穷小的乘积
solution.analysis: 要证明连续，只需证明 f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)→0。把函数增量写成差商与 Δx 的乘积即可直接使用导数存在。
steps: f 在 x₀ 处可导意味着 lim_{Δx→0}[f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)]/Δx=f′(x₀)，且该极限有限。
对 Δx≠0，有 f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)={[f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)]/Δx}·Δx。
当 Δx→0 时，第一个因子趋于有限数 f′(x₀)，第二个因子趋于 0。
因此函数增量趋于 0，即 lim_{Δx→0}f(x₀+Δx)=f(x₀)，所以 f 在 x₀ 连续。
pitfalls: 把结论错误地反向使用为连续必可导
没有说明导数极限必须是有限值
solution.verification: 证明直接得到连续性的增量判据 Δy→0，没有额外假设，因此原命题正确。
solution.takeaway: 可导比连续更强；导数存在时，函数增量必然能够写成“有限量乘无穷小”。
solution.extension: 连续的逆命题不成立；例如 f(x)=|x| 在 0 连续但不可导。

en.title: Does Differentiability Guarantee Continuity?
en.prompt: Decide whether the statement is true and justify: if f is differentiable at x₀, then f is continuous at x₀.

knowledge: a finite limit times an infinitesimal
solution.analysis: To prove continuity, it is enough to show f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)→0. Factor this increment into the difference quotient and Δx, then use the existence of the derivative.
steps: Differentiability at x₀ means lim_{Δx→0}[f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)]/Δx=f′(x₀), and this limit is finite.
For Δx≠0, write f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)={[f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)]/Δx}·Δx.
As Δx→0, the first factor tends to the finite number f′(x₀), while the second tends to 0.
Hence the function increment tends to 0, so lim_{Δx→0}f(x₀+Δx)=f(x₀); therefore f is continuous at x₀.
pitfalls: reversing the implication and claiming that continuity guarantees differentiability
failing to note that a derivative is a finite limit
solution.verification: The argument establishes the increment criterion Δy→0 for continuity without any extra assumption, so the statement is true.
solution.takeaway: Differentiability is stronger than continuity: the function increment becomes a finite quantity times an infinitesimal.
solution.extension: The converse is false; for example, f(x)=|x| is continuous but not differentiable at 0.

zh.title: 由导数写切线方程
zh.prompt: 已知 f(2)=5，f′(2)=-3。曲线 y=f(x) 在点 (2,5) 处的切线方程是（ ）。

solution.analysis: 切线必须经过给定切点 (2,5)，斜率是 f′(2)=-3。将这两个信息直接代入点斜式。
steps: 导数的几何意义给出该点切线斜率 k=f′(2)=-3。
直线经过 (x₀,y₀) 且斜率为 k 时，点斜式为 y-y₀=k(x-x₀)。
代入得到 y-5=-3(x-2)，故选择 A。
pitfalls: 交换切点的横、纵坐标
把法线斜率 -1/k 当成切线斜率
点斜式中符号写反
solution.verification: 令 x=2，A 给出 y=5，确实经过切点；其斜率也恰为 -3。
solution.takeaway: 切线方程只需要两个量：切点 (x₀,f(x₀)) 与斜率 f′(x₀)。
solution.extension: 该点法线斜率为 1/3，法线方程为 y-5=(1/3)(x-2)。

en.title: Writing a Tangent Line from a Derivative
en.prompt: Suppose f(2)=5 and f′(2)=-3. Which equation is the tangent line to y=f(x) at (2,5)?

knowledge: a derivative is the tangent slope
coordinates of the point of tangency
solution.analysis: The tangent must pass through (2,5), and its slope is f′(2)=-3. Insert these data into point-slope form.
steps: The point on the curve corresponding to x=2 is (2,f(2))=(2,5).
By the geometric meaning of a derivative, the tangent slope is k=f′(2)=-3.
A line through (x₀,y₀) with slope k has point-slope form y-y₀=k(x-x₀).
Substitution gives y-5=-3(x-2), so A is correct.
pitfalls: interchanging the coordinates of the point
using the normal slope -1/k for the tangent
reversing signs in point-slope form
solution.verification: Setting x=2 in A gives y=5, so it passes through the required point, and its slope is exactly -3.
solution.takeaway: A tangent line needs two pieces of information: (x₀,f(x₀)) and the slope f′(x₀).
solution.extension: The normal slope is 1/3, so the normal line is y-5=(1/3)(x-2).

zh.title: 绝对值函数的左右导数

solution.analysis: 在 0 左右两侧分别确定 |h| 的表达式。两个单侧差商虽然都有极限，但极限不相等。
steps: 由于 -1≠1，双侧导数不存在，因此 f 在 0 处不可导。
pitfalls: 把 |h| 一律替换为 h
只算一个方向的导数就断言可导
误认为两个单侧导数只要有限即可
solution.verification: 图像 y=|x| 在原点形成尖角；左侧斜率 -1、右侧斜率 1，与计算吻合。
solution.takeaway: 分段点的可导性必须逐侧检查，并要求左右导数作为数值完全相同。

en.title: One-Sided Derivatives of an Absolute-Value Function
en.prompt: Let f(x)=|x|. Then f′₋(0)=______, f′₊(0)=______, so f is ______ at 0 (write “differentiable” or “not differentiable”).

knowledge: equality of one-sided derivatives as the differentiability criterion
solution.analysis: Determine the expression for |h| separately on the two sides of 0. Both one-sided quotients have limits, but those limits are unequal.
steps: Since f(0)=0, the difference quotient is [f(h)-f(0)]/h=|h|/h.
As h→0⁻, h<0 and |h|=-h, so |h|/h=-1; hence f′₋(0)=-1.
As h→0⁺, h>0 and |h|=h, so |h|/h=1; hence f′₊(0)=1.
Because -1≠1, the two-sided derivative does not exist, and f is not differentiable at 0.
pitfalls: replacing |h| by h on both sides
checking only one one-sided derivative
assuming that two finite one-sided derivatives are sufficient even when they differ
solution.verification: The graph y=|x| has a corner at the origin; its left slope is -1 and its right slope is 1, matching the calculation.
solution.takeaway: At a junction, check both sides and require the two one-sided derivatives to be exactly equal.
solution.extension: For f(x)=|x-a|, the same argument gives f′₋(a)=-1 and f′₊(a)=1.

zh.title: 由定义求切线与法线
zh.prompt: 曲线 y=x² 上取点 P(1,1)。用导数定义求 P 点的切线与法线方程。

knowledge: 互相垂直直线的斜率关系
solution.analysis: 先用差商求 x=1 处的导数。切线斜率等于导数；由于切线斜率非零，法线斜率是其负倒数。
steps: 切线经过 (1,1) 且斜率为 2，所以 y-1=2(x-1)，即 y=2x-1。
pitfalls: 把法线斜率写成 1/2 而漏掉负号
切线和法线没有使用同一个切点
未按要求使用定义求导
solution.verification: 两条直线都经过 (1,1)，且斜率乘积 2·(-1/2)=-1，说明它们互相垂直。
solution.takeaway: 几何题的主线是“定义求斜率—点斜式写切线—负倒数写法线”。
solution.extension: 在点 (a,a²) 处，切线斜率为 2a；当 a=0 时法线是竖直直线 x=0。

en.title: Tangent and Normal Lines from First Principles
en.prompt: Let P(1,1) lie on the curve y=x². Use the definition of the derivative to find the tangent and normal lines at P.

solution.analysis: First find the derivative at x=1 from the difference quotient. The tangent slope equals the derivative, and because it is nonzero, the normal slope is its negative reciprocal.
steps: By definition, f′(1)=lim_{h→0}[(1+h)²-1²]/h.
Expand and cancel: [(1+h)²-1]/h=(2h+h²)/h=2+h, so f′(1)=2.
The tangent passes through (1,1) with slope 2, hence y-1=2(x-1), or y=2x-1.
The normal slope is -1/2, hence y-1=-(1/2)(x-1), or y=-(1/2)x+3/2.
pitfalls: using 1/2 instead of -1/2 for the normal slope
using different points for the tangent and normal
not using first principles as requested
solution.verification: Both lines pass through (1,1), and their slopes satisfy 2·(-1/2)=-1, confirming perpendicularity.
solution.takeaway: The geometric workflow is: obtain the slope from first principles, write the tangent in point-slope form, then take the negative reciprocal for the normal.
solution.extension: At (a,a²), the tangent slope is 2a; when a=0, the normal is the vertical line x=0.

zh.title: 选择对数函数的导数
zh.prompt: 在 x>0 上，函数 y=ln x 的导数为（ ）。

knowledge: 自然对数的基本求导公式
solution.analysis: 直接调用基本公式 (ln x)′=1/x，并保留原题给出的定义域 x>0。
steps: 自然对数 ln x 的实数定义域是 x>0。
基本求导公式给出 d(ln x)/dx=1/x。
因此 y′=1/x，且该表达式在 x>0 上有意义。
A 正确；B 把原函数当成导数，C、D 分别属于其他函数的形式。
pitfalls: 把 (ln x)′ 误写成 ln x
忽略 x>0 的定义域
与 (eˣ)′=eˣ 混淆
solution.verification: 当 x=1 时，公式给出 y′=1；ln x 在 1 附近的差商极限也等于 1。
solution.takeaway: 记忆基本公式时要把函数、导数和适用定义域作为一个整体。
solution.extension: 由链式法则可进一步得到 (ln u(x))′=u′(x)/u(x)，前提是 u(x)>0。

en.title: Choose the Derivative of a Logarithm
en.prompt: For x>0, what is the derivative of y=ln x?

knowledge: basic derivative formula for the natural logarithm
distinguishing a function from its derivative
solution.analysis: Apply the basic formula (ln x)′=1/x and retain the stated domain x>0.
steps: The real-valued natural logarithm ln x has domain x>0.
The basic derivative formula is d(ln x)/dx=1/x.
Therefore y′=1/x, which is defined throughout x>0.
Thus A is correct; B repeats the original function, while C and D belong to different formulas.
pitfalls: writing (ln x)′=ln x
ignoring the domain x>0
confusing the formula with (eˣ)′=eˣ
solution.verification: At x=1 the formula gives y′=1, which agrees with the difference-quotient limit of ln x at 1.
solution.takeaway: Learn each basic formula together with the function, its derivative, and its domain.
solution.extension: The chain rule gives (ln u(x))′=u′(x)/u(x), provided u(x)>0.

zh.title: 多项式与指数函数的乘积
zh.prompt: 设 f(x)=x²eˣ，则 f′(x) 等于下列哪一项？

solution.analysis: 函数由 x² 与 eˣ 相乘而成，必须对两个因子分别求导并保留另一因子，再合并同类因式。
steps: 令 u(x)=x²，v(x)=eˣ，则 f(x)=u(x)v(x)。
分别求导得到 u′(x)=2x，v′(x)=eˣ。
应用乘积法则 f′=u′v+uv′，得 f′(x)=2xeˣ+x²eˣ。
提取公因式 eˣ，得到 f′(x)=eˣ(x²+2x)。
因此正确选项为 B。
pitfalls: 误写成 u′v′
只对一个因子求导
提取公因式时漏掉 x
solution.verification: 在 x=0 处，定义式给出的导数为 lim_{h→0}h²eʰ/h=0；所得公式在 x=0 处也给出 0。
solution.takeaway: 乘积求导是两项之和，而不是两个导数的乘积。
solution.extension: 把 x² 改为 xᵐ，可先猜测并验证 (xᵐeˣ)′=eˣ(xᵐ+mxᵐ⁻¹)。

en.title: A Polynomial Times an Exponential
en.prompt: Let f(x)=x²eˣ. Which expression equals f′(x)?

solution.analysis: The function is the product of x² and eˣ. Differentiate each factor in turn while retaining the other factor, then combine the terms.
steps: Set u(x)=x² and v(x)=eˣ, so f(x)=u(x)v(x).
Differentiate the factors: u′(x)=2x and v′(x)=eˣ.
Apply f′=u′v+uv′ to obtain f′(x)=2xeˣ+x²eˣ.
Factor out eˣ to get f′(x)=eˣ(x²+2x).
Therefore the correct choice is B.
pitfalls: Writing u′v′ instead of the product rule
Differentiating only one factor
Losing a factor of x when factoring
solution.verification: At x=0, the definition gives lim_{h→0}h²eʰ/h=0, and the derived formula also gives 0.
solution.takeaway: The derivative of a product is a sum of two terms, not the product of two derivatives.
solution.extension: Replace x² by xᵐ and verify the pattern (xᵐeˣ)′=eˣ(xᵐ+mxᵐ⁻¹).

zh.title: 商的导数能否逐项相除
zh.prompt: 判断并说明理由：若 u、v 均可导且 v′(x)≠0，则 [u(x)/v(x)]′=u′(x)/v′(x)。
zh.answer: 错误。只需 v(x)≠0，正确公式是 (u/v)′=(u′v−uv′)/v²。

solution.analysis: 原命题既写错了公式，也把分母条件误放在 v′ 上。用一个简单反例即可否定，再给出正确法则。
steps: 商 u/v 有意义并可使用商法则的局部条件是 v(x)≠0，而不是 v′(x)≠0。
正确求导公式为 (u/v)′=(u′v−uv′)/v²。
取 u(x)=x、v(x)=x+1，并在 x≠−1 的区间上考察。
两者一般不相等，所以命题错误。
pitfalls: 把商法则类比成导数之商
把 v≠0 错写成 v′≠0
忘记分子中的减号
solution.verification: 在 x=1 处，实际导数为 1/4，而错误公式给出 1，数值直接矛盾。
solution.takeaway: 商法则的结构是“下乘上导减上乘下导，再除以下的平方”。
solution.extension: 若 v 是非零常数，则商法则才会退化为 (u/v)′=u′/v。

en.title: Can a Quotient Be Differentiated Termwise?
en.prompt: True or false, with justification: If u and v are differentiable and v′(x)≠0, then [u(x)/v(x)]′=u′(x)/v′(x).
en.answer: False. The needed condition is v(x)≠0, and the correct formula is (u/v)′=(u′v−uv′)/v².

solution.analysis: The statement has both an incorrect formula and the wrong nonzero condition. A simple counterexample disproves it, after which the correct rule can be stated.
steps: For u/v to be defined and the quotient rule to apply locally, the condition is v(x)≠0, not v′(x)≠0.
The correct formula is (u/v)′=(u′v−uv′)/v².
Choose u(x)=x and v(x)=x+1 on an interval excluding x=−1.
The proposed formula gives u′/v′=1, whereas (x/(x+1))′=[(x+1)−x]/(x+1)²=1/(x+1)².
These are not generally equal, so the statement is false.
pitfalls: Treating a quotient as the quotient of derivatives
Replacing v≠0 by v′≠0
Forgetting the minus sign in the numerator
solution.verification: At x=1, the actual derivative is 1/4 while the incorrect formula gives 1.
solution.takeaway: The quotient rule is denominator times numerator derivative minus numerator times denominator derivative, divided by the denominator squared.
solution.extension: If v is a nonzero constant, the quotient rule does reduce to (u/v)′=u′/v.

zh.title: 三类基本函数的线性组合
zh.prompt: 在 x>0 上，若 y=3eˣ−2ln x+5arctan x，则 y′=________。

solution.analysis: 这是指数、对数和反正切函数的线性组合，各项可分别求导；x>0 同时保证 ln x 有定义。
steps: 由常数倍法则，(3eˣ)′=3eˣ。
由反正切导数公式，(5arctan x)′=5/(1+x²)。
使用和差法则把三项相加，得到 y′=3eˣ−2/x+5/(1+x²)。
所得表达式在原定义域 x>0 上处处有意义。
pitfalls: 把 (ln x)′写成 ln x
漏掉反正切导数的分母 1+x²
忽略 ln x 的定义域
solution.verification: 逐项的导数单位完全独立；令三项系数中的任意两个为 0，公式都会退化为相应的基本导数公式。
solution.takeaway: 和、差与常数倍可以逐项求导，但每个基本函数的公式和定义域必须同时保留。
solution.extension: 若把 ln x 改为 ln|x|，则同一导数公式在 x≠0 上成立。

en.title: A Linear Combination of Three Basic Functions
en.prompt: For x>0, if y=3eˣ−2ln x+5arctan x, then y′=________.

solution.analysis: This is a linear combination of exponential, logarithmic, and inverse-tangent functions, so the terms can be differentiated separately. The condition x>0 also ensures that ln x is defined.
steps: By the constant-multiple rule, (3eˣ)′=3eˣ.
By the inverse-tangent formula, (5arctan x)′=5/(1+x²).
Add the three derivatives to obtain y′=3eˣ−2/x+5/(1+x²).
The resulting expression is defined everywhere on the original domain x>0.
pitfalls: Writing (ln x)′ as ln x
Omitting 1+x² in the inverse-tangent derivative
Ignoring the domain of ln x
solution.verification: Setting any two coefficients to zero reduces the result to the corresponding basic derivative formula.
solution.takeaway: Sums, differences, and constant multiples differentiate termwise, but each basic formula and its domain must be respected.
solution.extension: If ln x is replaced by ln|x|, the same derivative formula holds for x≠0.

zh.title: 一次函数的五次幂
zh.prompt: 求 y=(2x−1)⁵ 的导数，并明确指出外层函数与内层函数。

solution.analysis: 把 2x−1 看作整体。外层是 u↦u⁵，内层是 x↦2x−1，导数应为外导数乘以内导数。
steps: 设内层变量 u=2x−1，则 y=u⁵。
外层对 u 求导：dy/du=5u⁴。
内层对 x 求导：du/dx=2。
由链式法则 y′=(dy/du)(du/dx)=5u⁴·2。
pitfalls: 只写 5(2x−1)⁴ 而漏乘 2
把指数 5 同时作用到内层导数
展开后计算造成不必要错误
solution.verification: 展开最高次项为 32x⁵，其导数最高次项应为 160x⁴；所得式最高次项 10·16x⁴=160x⁴，一致。
solution.takeaway: 复合函数每穿过一层，就要乘上该层内部的导数。
solution.extension: 对 y=(ax+b)ⁿ，可直接得到 y′=an(ax+b)ⁿ⁻¹。

en.title: The Fifth Power of a Linear Function
en.prompt: Differentiate y=(2x−1)⁵ and explicitly identify the outer and inner functions.

solution.analysis: Treat 2x−1 as one unit. The outer function is u↦u⁵ and the inner function is x↦2x−1, so the derivative is the outer derivative times the inner derivative.
steps: Introduce the inner variable u=2x−1, so y=u⁵.
Differentiate the outer function: dy/du=5u⁴.
Differentiate the inner function: du/dx=2.
The chain rule gives y′=(dy/du)(du/dx)=5u⁴·2.
Substitute u=2x−1 to obtain y′=10(2x−1)⁴.
pitfalls: Writing only 5(2x−1)⁴ and missing the factor 2
Applying the exponent to the inner derivative
Expanding unnecessarily and creating algebra errors
solution.verification: The leading term of the expansion is 32x⁵, whose derivative has leading term 160x⁴; the result has leading term 10·16x⁴=160x⁴.
solution.takeaway: Each layer passed through in a composite function contributes its own derivative factor.
solution.extension: For y=(ax+b)ⁿ, the same reasoning gives y′=an(ax+b)ⁿ⁻¹.

zh.title: 正弦与指数的商
zh.prompt: 求 y=sin x/eˣ 的导数，并把结果写成最简乘积形式。

knowledge: 正弦与指数函数的导数
solution.analysis: 既可直接使用商法则，也可先写成 e⁻ˣsin x 再用乘积法则；后者更容易得到简洁形式。
steps: 将原函数改写为 y=e⁻ˣsin x。
由链式法则，(e⁻ˣ)′=−e⁻ˣ；同时 (sin x)′=cos x。
应用乘积法则，y′=(−e⁻ˣ)sin x+e⁻ˣcos x。
提取 e⁻ˣ，得到 y′=e⁻ˣ(cos x−sin x)。
由于 eˣ≠0，该结果在所有实数 x 上成立。
pitfalls: 把 (e⁻ˣ)′写成 e⁻ˣ
商法则中颠倒减法次序
化简时丢失负号
solution.verification: 直接用商法则得 [eˣcos x−eˣsin x]/e²ˣ=(cos x−sin x)/eˣ，与结果相同。
solution.takeaway: 遇到指数函数作分母时，先改写成负指数常能简化求导。
solution.extension: 把 sin x 换成一般可导函数 f(x)，则 [e⁻ˣf(x)]′=e⁻ˣ[f′(x)−f(x)]。

en.title: A Sine Divided by an Exponential
en.prompt: Differentiate y=sin x/eˣ and write the result in the simplest product form.

knowledge: Derivatives of sine and exponential functions
solution.analysis: One may apply the quotient rule directly or rewrite the function as e⁻ˣsin x and use the product rule. The second route produces a compact form naturally.
steps: Rewrite the function as y=e⁻ˣsin x.
By the chain rule, (e⁻ˣ)′=−e⁻ˣ, while (sin x)′=cos x.
Apply the product rule: y′=(−e⁻ˣ)sin x+e⁻ˣcos x.
Factor e⁻ˣ to obtain y′=e⁻ˣ(cos x−sin x).
Because eˣ is never zero, the formula holds for every real x.
pitfalls: Writing (e⁻ˣ)′ as e⁻ˣ
Reversing the subtraction in the quotient rule
Losing the minus sign while simplifying
solution.verification: The quotient rule gives [eˣcos x−eˣsin x]/e²ˣ=(cos x−sin x)/eˣ, which is identical.
solution.takeaway: When an exponential appears in the denominator, rewriting it with a negative exponent often simplifies differentiation.
solution.extension: Replacing sin x by a differentiable f(x) gives [e⁻ˣf(x)]′=e⁻ˣ[f′(x)−f(x)].

zh.title: 反函数在对应点的导数
zh.prompt: 设 f 在 2 附近存在可导反函数 g=f⁻¹，且 f(2)=5、f′(2)=−3，则 g′(5) 等于多少？

knowledge: 原函数点与反函数点的对应
solution.analysis: 先由 f(2)=5 确定 g(5)=2，再在这对对应点上使用反函数导数互为倒数的公式。
steps: 反函数导数公式为 g′(y)=1/f′(g(y))。
所以正确选项为 B。
pitfalls: 直接把 f′(2) 当作 g′(5)
把对应自变量仍写成 2
漏掉倒数或负号
solution.verification: 对应切线斜率的乘积为 f′(2)g′(5)=(−3)(−1/3)=1，符合反函数图像关于 y=x 对称的斜率关系。
solution.takeaway: 反函数的导数要在对应点取原函数导数的倒数。
solution.extension: 若 f′(2)=0，则不能用该公式断言 g 在 5 处有有限导数。

en.title: The Derivative of an Inverse at Corresponding Points
en.prompt: Suppose f has a differentiable inverse g=f⁻¹ near 2, with f(2)=5 and f′(2)=−3. What is g′(5)?

knowledge: Corresponding points of a function and its inverse
solution.analysis: First use f(2)=5 to identify g(5)=2, then take the reciprocal of the original derivative at this corresponding point.
steps: Since g=f⁻¹ and f(2)=5, we have g(5)=2.
The inverse derivative formula is g′(y)=1/f′(g(y)).
Substitute g(5)=2 and f′(2)=−3 to obtain g′(5)=1/(−3)=−1/3.
Therefore the correct choice is B.
pitfalls: Using f′(2) itself as g′(5)
Using 2 as the inverse function's input
Dropping the reciprocal or the negative sign
solution.verification: The product of the corresponding slopes is f′(2)g′(5)=(−3)(−1/3)=1, consistent with reflection of inverse graphs across y=x.
solution.takeaway: At corresponding points, the derivative of an inverse is the reciprocal of the original derivative.
solution.extension: If f′(2)=0, the formula cannot be used to claim that g has a finite derivative at 5.

zh.title: 多项式的高阶导数
zh.prompt: 判断并说明理由：若 y=x⁴−3x+2，则 y⁽⁵⁾(x)≡0。
zh.answer: 正确。四次多项式的五阶及更高阶导数恒为 0。

solution.analysis: 每求一次导数，多项式的次数降低 1；线性项在二阶导数时已消失，四次项在五阶导数时消失。
steps: 一阶导数为 y′=4x³−3。
二阶导数为 y″=12x²。
三阶与四阶导数依次为 y‴=24x、y⁽⁴⁾=24。
再求一次导数，常数 24 的导数为 0，因此 y⁽⁵⁾=0。
零函数继续求导仍为零，所以结论恒成立。
pitfalls: 把五阶导数误认为 5x⁻¹
遗漏低次项会更早消失
把某一点为 0 与恒等于 0 混淆
solution.verification: 直接使用公式 (x⁴)⁽ⁿ⁾=4!/(4−n)!·x⁴⁻ⁿ 仅适用于 n≤4；n=5 时导数已经为 0。
solution.takeaway: m 次多项式的 m+1 阶及更高阶导数恒为 0。
solution.extension: 若多项式的最高次项系数非零，则它的 m 阶导数是非零常数 m!aₘ。

en.title: Higher Derivatives of a Polynomial
en.prompt: True or false, with justification: If y=x⁴−3x+2, then y⁽⁵⁾(x)≡0.
en.answer: True. Every derivative of order five or higher of a fourth-degree polynomial is identically 0.

solution.analysis: Each differentiation lowers the polynomial degree by one. The linear term disappears after two derivatives, and the fourth-degree term disappears after five.
steps: The first derivative is y′=4x³−3.
The second derivative is y″=12x².
The third and fourth derivatives are y‴=24x and y⁽⁴⁾=24.
Differentiating once more gives y⁽⁵⁾=0 because the derivative of 24 is zero.
Further derivatives of the zero function remain zero, so the assertion holds identically.
pitfalls: Treating the fifth derivative as 5x⁻¹
Forgetting that lower-degree terms disappear earlier
Confusing a zero at one point with an identically zero function
solution.verification: The formula (x⁴)⁽ⁿ⁾=4!/(4−n)!·x⁴⁻ⁿ applies only for n≤4; at n=5 the derivative is already zero.
solution.takeaway: Every derivative of order m+1 or higher of a degree-m polynomial is identically zero.
solution.extension: If the leading coefficient of a degree-m polynomial is nonzero, its mth derivative is the nonzero constant m!aₘ.

zh.title: 余弦函数的第 2026 阶导数
zh.prompt: 若 y=cos x，则 y⁽²⁰²⁶⁾=________。

solution.analysis: 余弦的连续求导以 4 为周期，只需计算 2026 除以 4 的余数。
steps: 前四阶依次为 y′=−sin x、y″=−cos x、y‴=sin x、y⁽⁴⁾=cos x。
第四阶回到原函数，所以导数序列每 4 阶重复一次。
计算 2026=4·506+2，因此第 2026 阶与第 2 阶处于同一位置。
由 y″=−cos x，得到 y⁽²⁰²⁶⁾=−cos x。
该结论对所有实数 x 成立。
pitfalls: 把 2026 的余数算成 0
漏掉二阶导数的负号
误认为周期是 2
solution.verification: 2024 是 4 的倍数，故 y⁽²⁰²⁴⁾=cos x；再求两次导数确实得到 −cos x。
solution.takeaway: 三角函数的超高阶导数通常先找循环，再做模运算。
solution.extension: 可统一写成 (cos x)⁽ⁿ⁾=cos(x+nπ/2)。

en.title: The 2026th Derivative of Cosine
en.prompt: If y=cos x, then y⁽²⁰²⁶⁾=________.

solution.analysis: Successive derivatives of cosine repeat every four steps, so only the remainder when 2026 is divided by 4 matters.
steps: The first four derivatives are y′=−sin x, y″=−cos x, y‴=sin x, and y⁽⁴⁾=cos x.
The fourth derivative returns to the original function, so the sequence has period 4.
Since 2026=4·506+2, the 2026th derivative occupies the same position as the second derivative.
Because y″=−cos x, we obtain y⁽²⁰²⁶⁾=−cos x.
This identity holds for every real x.
pitfalls: Computing the remainder of 2026 as 0
Dropping the minus sign in the second derivative
Assuming the period is 2
solution.verification: Because 2024 is divisible by 4, y⁽²⁰²⁴⁾=cos x; differentiating twice more indeed gives −cos x.
solution.takeaway: For very high trigonometric derivatives, find the cycle first and then use modular arithmetic.
solution.extension: A unified form is (cos x)⁽ⁿ⁾=cos(x+nπ/2).

zh.title: 识别隐函数的一阶导数
zh.prompt: 曲线 x²+xy+y²=7 在 y 可看作 x 的可导函数处，其导数 y′ 等于下列哪一项？

knowledge: 对等式两边关于 x 求导
solution.analysis: 把 y 视为 y(x)。求导时 xy 与 y² 都会产生 y′，最后把所有 y′ 项移到同一侧。
steps: 对 x² 求导得到 2x。
对 xy 使用乘积法则，得到 y+xy′；对 y² 使用链式法则，得到 2yy′。
常数 7 的导数为 0，所以 2x+y+xy′+2yy′=0。
收集 y′ 得 (x+2y)y′=−(2x+y)。
当 x+2y≠0 时，y′=−(2x+y)/(x+2y)，故选择 A。
pitfalls: 把 d(xy)/dx 只写成 xy′
把 d(y²)/dx 写成 2y 而漏掉 y′
移项时丢失负号
solution.verification: 把 A 代回 (x+2y)y′=−(2x+y)，等式恒成立；其余选项一般不能满足该线性方程。
solution.takeaway: 隐函数一阶求导的核心是把每个 y 都当作 y(x)，再统一收集 y′。
solution.extension: 若 x+2y=0，应回到曲线局部几何检查是否出现竖直切线，而不能直接使用该分式。

en.title: Recognizing a First Implicit Derivative
en.prompt: On the curve x²+xy+y²=7, wherever y is a differentiable function of x, which expression equals y′?

knowledge: Differentiating both sides with respect to x
solution.analysis: Treat y as y(x). Differentiating xy and y² both produces y′ terms, which must then be collected.
steps: Differentiate x² to obtain 2x.
The product rule gives d(xy)/dx=y+xy′, and the chain rule gives d(y²)/dx=2yy′.
The derivative of 7 is 0, so 2x+y+xy′+2yy′=0.
Collecting y′ gives (x+2y)y′=−(2x+y).
When x+2y≠0, y′=−(2x+y)/(x+2y), so A is correct.
pitfalls: Writing d(xy)/dx as only xy′
Omitting y′ from d(y²)/dx
Losing the minus sign while rearranging
solution.verification: Substituting A into (x+2y)y′=−(2x+y) satisfies the equation identically; the other options generally do not.
solution.takeaway: In implicit differentiation, regard every y as y(x) and collect all y′ terms at the end.
solution.extension: If x+2y=0, return to the local geometry to check for a vertical tangent rather than using the fraction.

zh.title: 圆上一点的切线
zh.prompt: 曲线 x²+y²=25 上的点 (3,4) 处，求 dy/dx，并写出切线方程。

solution.analysis: 先对圆方程隐式求导得到一般斜率，再把点坐标代入，并用点斜式写切线。
steps: 对 x²+y²=25 关于 x 求导，得 2x+2yy′=0。
当 y≠0 时，解得 y′=−x/y。
两边乘 4 并整理，得到等价标准式 3x+4y=25。
pitfalls: 把圆上点的斜率写成 3/4
求导 y² 时漏掉 y′
切线方程忘记经过给定点
solution.takeaway: 隐式求得的导数就是曲线局部切线斜率，随后使用点斜式即可。
solution.extension: 同一点的法线斜率为 4/3，法线方程为 y−4=(4/3)(x−3)。

en.title: The Tangent to a Circle
en.prompt: At the point (3,4) on x²+y²=25, find dy/dx and the equation of the tangent line.
en.answer: dy/dx=−3/4; the tangent is y−4=−(3/4)(x−3), equivalently 3x+4y=25.

solution.analysis: First differentiate the circle implicitly to obtain the general slope, then substitute the point and use point-slope form.
steps: Differentiate x²+y²=25 with respect to x to get 2x+2yy′=0.
When y≠0, solve for y′=−x/y.
Point-slope form gives y−4=−(3/4)(x−3).
Multiplying by 4 and rearranging gives the equivalent form 3x+4y=25.
pitfalls: Using the positive slope 3/4
Omitting y′ when differentiating y²
Writing a tangent that does not pass through the point
solution.verification: The line 3x+4y=25 contains (3,4) because 9+16=25, and its slope is −3/4.
solution.takeaway: The implicit derivative is the local tangent slope; then apply point-slope form.
solution.extension: The normal slope is 4/3, so the normal is y−4=(4/3)(x−3).

zh.title: 在给定点计算隐函数导数
zh.prompt: 曲线 x²+xy=6 在点 (2,1) 处的 dy/dx=____。

solution.analysis: xy 同时含 x 与 y(x)，必须用乘积法则。求出含 y′ 的方程后再代入点坐标。
steps: 对 x² 求导得到 2x。
对 xy 求导得到 y+xy′。
常数 6 的导数为 0，因此 2x+y+xy′=0。
pitfalls: 把 xy 的导数写成 y′
先把点值代入原方程再求导
解线性方程时漏除以 2
solution.verification: 一般公式 y′=−(2x+y)/x；代入 x=2,y=1 得 −5/2，与逐步计算一致。
solution.takeaway: 隐函数点处导数应先求一般导数关系，再代入坐标。
solution.extension: 若改在 x=0 的点附近研究，该公式分母为 0，需要重新判断能否把 y 写成 x 的函数。

en.title: Evaluating an Implicit Derivative at a Point
en.prompt: For x²+xy=6, dy/dx at (2,1) is ____.

solution.analysis: Because xy contains both x and y(x), the product rule is required. Solve the derivative relation before substituting the point.
steps: Differentiate x² to get 2x.
Differentiate xy to get y+xy′.
The derivative of 6 is 0, so 2x+y+xy′=0.
At (2,1), this becomes 4+1+2y′=0.
Thus 2y′=−5 and y′=−5/2.
pitfalls: Writing the derivative of xy as y′
Substituting the point before differentiating
Forgetting to divide by 2
solution.verification: The general formula is y′=−(2x+y)/x; at x=2,y=1 it gives −5/2.
solution.takeaway: Derive the general implicit relation first, then substitute the point.
solution.extension: Near a point with x=0, the displayed formula has zero denominator and one must recheck whether y is locally a function of x.

zh.title: 导数分式的适用条件
zh.prompt: 判断并说明理由：由 x²+y²=1 可得 y′=−x/y，因此该公式在圆上的每一点都给出有限切线斜率。
zh.answer: 错误。在 (±1,0) 处分母 y=0，曲线具有竖直切线，y 不能在该点附近作为 x 的单值可导函数给出有限导数。

knowledge: 隐函数导数的分母条件
solution.analysis: 求导关系 2x+2yy′=0 没有问题，但解成 y′=−x/y 时新增了 y≠0 的条件。
steps: 对圆方程求导得到 2x+2yy′=0。
只有在 y≠0 时才能除以 2y，得到 y′=−x/y。
圆上的点 (1,0) 与 (−1,0) 都满足 y=0，因此该分式在这些点无定义。
在 (1,0) 附近，圆的切线为 x=1；在 (−1,0) 附近，切线为 x=−1，二者均为竖直线。
竖直线没有有限斜率，所以原命题错误。
pitfalls: 解方程时忽略除数可能为 0
把导数不存在与曲线没有切线混同
认为一个隐式方程处处都能把 y 写成 x 的单值函数
solution.verification: 圆的半径在 (1,0) 处水平，切线必与半径垂直，因而是竖直线 x=1，与分母为 0 的现象一致。
solution.takeaway: 隐函数导数公式必须连同分母非零条件使用；分母为 0 常对应竖直切线。
solution.extension: 若改为把 x 看作 y 的函数，则在 (±1,0) 处可求 dx/dy=−y/x=0。

en.title: The Domain of an Implicit-Derivative Formula
en.prompt: True or false, with justification: From x²+y²=1 we obtain y′=−x/y, so this formula gives a finite tangent slope at every point of the circle.
en.answer: False. At (±1,0), y=0, the curve has a vertical tangent, and y is not locally a single-valued differentiable function of x with a finite derivative.

solution.analysis: The relation 2x+2yy′=0 is valid, but solving it as y′=−x/y introduces the condition y≠0.
steps: Differentiate the circle to obtain 2x+2yy′=0.
Division by 2y is allowed only when y≠0, yielding y′=−x/y.
The points (1,0) and (−1,0) lie on the circle and have y=0, so the fraction is undefined there.
The tangent near (1,0) is x=1, and near (−1,0) it is x=−1; both are vertical lines.
A vertical line has no finite slope, so the statement is false.
pitfalls: Ignoring a possible zero divisor
Confusing a nonexistent finite derivative with no tangent
Assuming every implicit curve globally gives y as a single-valued function of x
solution.verification: At (1,0) the radius is horizontal, so the tangent is vertical, agreeing with the zero denominator.
solution.takeaway: An implicit-derivative formula must be used with its nonzero-denominator condition; a zero denominator often signals a vertical tangent.
solution.extension: If x is viewed as a function of y, then at (±1,0) one has dx/dy=−y/x=0.

zh.title: 识别函数微分
zh.prompt: 若 y=f(x) 在 x 处可导，并令 dx=Δx，则 y 的微分 dy 是下列哪一项？
choices: B. dy=Δy 对任意有限 Δx 恒成立
D. dy 与 dx 无关

knowledge: 函数增量与微分的区别
solution.analysis: 可导函数的增量可写成线性主部与高阶小量之和；线性主部 f′(x)Δx 定义为 dy。
steps: 令自变量增量为 Δx，并规定 dx=Δx。
可导性给出 Δy=f′(x)Δx+o(Δx)。
其中关于 Δx 的线性部分 f′(x)Δx 定义为函数微分。
因此 dy=f′(x)dx，A 正确。
dy 通常只近似 Δy，不对任意有限增量与 Δy 恒等。
pitfalls: 把 dy 与 Δy 永远视为相同
把函数值 f(x) 当作导数
认为 dy 不依赖 dx
solution.verification: 对 f(x)=x²，有 Δy=2xΔx+(Δx)²，而 dy=2x dx；二者之差为 (Δx)²。
solution.takeaway: 微分是函数增量关于自变量增量的线性主部。
solution.extension: 在线性函数 y=ax+b 中，高阶余项为 0，因此 dy=Δy 对所有增量都精确成立。

en.title: Recognizing the Differential of a Function
en.prompt: If y=f(x) is differentiable at x and dx=Δx, which expression is the differential dy?
choices: B. dy=Δy for every finite Δx
D. dy is independent of dx

solution.analysis: For a differentiable function, the increment is a linear principal part plus a higher-order small term. The linear part f′(x)Δx is defined as dy.
steps: Let the independent-variable increment be Δx and set dx=Δx.
Differentiability gives Δy=f′(x)Δx+o(Δx).
The part f′(x)Δx that is linear in Δx is defined as the differential.
Therefore dy=f′(x)dx, so A is correct.
In general dy only approximates Δy; it is not exactly equal for every finite increment.
pitfalls: Treating dy and Δy as always identical
Using f(x) instead of f′(x)
Assuming dy is independent of dx
solution.verification: For f(x)=x², Δy=2xΔx+(Δx)² while dy=2x dx; their difference is (Δx)².
solution.takeaway: The differential is the part of the function increment that is linear in the independent-variable increment.
solution.extension: For a linear function y=ax+b, the higher-order remainder is zero, so dy=Δy exactly for every increment.

zh.title: 幂函数的微分数值
zh.prompt: 若 y=x³，在 x=2 且 dx=0.01 时，dy=____。

solution.analysis: 先求一般微分 dy=3x²dx，再代入基点 x=2 与自变量微分 dx=0.01。
steps: 对 y=x³ 求导，得到 y′=3x²。
函数微分为 dy=y′dx=3x²dx。
所以 dy=0.12。
pitfalls: 把 x+dx=2.01 代入导数作为基点
把 d(x³) 写成 x²dx
漏乘 dx
solution.verification: 精确增量为 2.01³−2³=0.120601，微分 0.12 是其线性主部，数值接近但不完全相等。
solution.takeaway: 微分系数在基点计算，再乘自变量的微小改变量。
solution.extension: 若 dx=−0.01，则 dy=−0.12，符号反映局部变化方向。

en.title: Numerical Differential of a Power Function
en.prompt: If y=x³, then at x=2 with dx=0.01, dy=____.

solution.analysis: First obtain dy=3x²dx, then substitute the base point x=2 and dx=0.01.
steps: Differentiate y=x³ to get y′=3x².
The differential is dy=y′dx=3x²dx.
With dx=0.01, substitute into dy=12dx to obtain dy=12·0.01.
Therefore dy=0.12; this is the linear estimate of the corresponding output increment.
pitfalls: Evaluating the derivative at x+dx=2.01
Writing d(x³)=x²dx
Forgetting to multiply by dx
solution.verification: The exact increment is 2.01³−2³=0.120601. The differential 0.12 is close but not identical.
solution.takeaway: Evaluate the differential coefficient at the base point, then multiply by the small input change.
solution.extension: If dx=−0.01, then dy=−0.12, reflecting the local direction of change.

zh.title: 倒数函数在任意非零点的导数
zh.prompt: 设 f(x)=1/x。对任意 a≠0，仅用导数定义求 f′(a)。

solution.analysis: 在 a 处写出差商后先通分。由于 a≠0，并且 h 足够小时 a+h≠0，差商可合法化简。
pitfalls: 通分时把分子符号写反
约去 h 后忘记负号
漏写 a≠0 以及 a+h≠0 的条件
solution.verification: 取 a=1，结果为 -1；当 x 从 1 略微增大时 1/x 减小，导数为负与变化方向一致。
solution.takeaway: 分式函数的定义求导常靠通分制造可约去的增量因子。
solution.extension: 用同一方法可证明 (c/x)′=-c/x²，其中 c 为常数。

en.title: Derivative of the Reciprocal Function at Any Nonzero Point
en.prompt: Let f(x)=1/x. For any a≠0, use only the definition of the derivative to find f′(a).

knowledge: derivative definition at a nonzero point
solution.analysis: Write the difference quotient at a and combine the fractions. Since a≠0 and a+h≠0 for all sufficiently small h, the algebraic simplification is legitimate.
steps: By definition, f′(a)=lim_{h→0}[1/(a+h)-1/a]/h.
Combine the numerator: 1/(a+h)-1/a=[a-(a+h)]/[a(a+h)]=-h/[a(a+h)].
For h≠0, the quotient simplifies to {-h/[a(a+h)]}/h=-1/[a(a+h)].
Let h→0. Since a≠0, f′(a)=-1/(a·a)=-1/a².
pitfalls: reversing the sign when combining the fractions
losing the minus sign after canceling h
omitting the conditions a≠0 and a+h≠0
solution.verification: At a=1 the result is -1. As x increases slightly from 1, 1/x decreases, which agrees with the negative derivative.
solution.takeaway: For rational functions, combining fractions often exposes the input increment that can be canceled.
solution.extension: The same method proves (c/x)′=-c/x² for any constant c.

zh.title: 辨析可导性的逻辑关系
zh.prompt: 设 x₀ 是 f 定义域的内点。下列命题中正确的是哪些？
choices: A. 若 f′(x₀) 存在，则 f′₋(x₀) 与 f′₊(x₀) 都存在且相等
B. 若 f 在 x₀ 连续，则 f′(x₀) 一定存在
C. 若 f′(x₀) 存在，则 f 在 x₀ 连续
D. 若 f′₋(x₀) 与 f′₊(x₀) 都是有限数，则 f′(x₀) 一定存在

knowledge: 双侧导数与单侧导数的关系
solution.analysis: A、D 需要比较左右导数是否相等；B、C 需要辨认“可导推出连续”的正确方向。用 |x-x₀| 可以同时否定两个常见误判。
steps: 若双侧差商极限 f′(x₀) 存在，则其左、右极限必存在并等于同一个值，所以 A 正确。
可导蕴含连续，因此 C 正确。
函数 f(x)=|x-x₀| 在 x₀ 连续，但左、右导数分别为 -1 与 1，所以 B 错误。
同一反例中两个单侧导数都是有限数却不相等，双侧导数不存在，所以 D 错误。
pitfalls: 把必要条件和充分条件互换
只要求左右导数有限而忘记要求相等
把连续与可导当成等价概念
solution.verification: |x-x₀| 的函数值在 x₀ 连续，而差商从左、右分别恒趋于 -1、1，精确验证了反例。
solution.takeaway: 内点可导等价于左右导数都存在且相等；连续只是可导的必要条件。
solution.extension: 若 x₀ 是定义域端点，通常只讨论沿定义域方向的单侧导数，而不是双侧导数。

en.title: Logical Relations Involving Differentiability
en.prompt: Let x₀ be an interior point of the domain of f. Which statements are correct?
choices: A. If f′(x₀) exists, then f′₋(x₀) and f′₊(x₀) both exist and are equal
B. If f is continuous at x₀, then f′(x₀) must exist
C. If f′(x₀) exists, then f is continuous at x₀
D. If f′₋(x₀) and f′₊(x₀) are both finite, then f′(x₀) must exist

knowledge: relation between two-sided and one-sided derivatives
solution.analysis: For A and D, equality of the one-sided derivatives is decisive. For B and C, identify the correct direction of the implication from differentiability to continuity. The function |x-x₀| rejects both common false claims.
steps: If the two-sided difference-quotient limit f′(x₀) exists, its left and right limits exist and equal that same value; thus A is true.
Differentiability implies continuity, so C is true.
The function f(x)=|x-x₀| is continuous at x₀, but its left and right derivatives are -1 and 1; hence B is false.
In the same example both one-sided derivatives are finite but unequal, so the two-sided derivative does not exist; hence D is false.
pitfalls: interchanging a necessary condition and a sufficient condition
requiring the one-sided derivatives to be finite but not equal
treating continuity and differentiability as equivalent
solution.verification: For |x-x₀|, continuity at x₀ is immediate, while the left and right quotients tend exactly to -1 and 1, validating the counterexample.
solution.takeaway: At an interior point, differentiability is equivalent to existence and equality of both one-sided derivatives; continuity is only necessary.
solution.extension: At an endpoint of the domain, one normally studies the one-sided derivative from within the domain rather than a two-sided derivative.

zh.title: 用无穷小余项证明可导必连续
zh.prompt: 已知 f 在 x₀ 处可导。证明存在 α(Δx)→0，使 f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)=f′(x₀)Δx+α(Δx)Δx，并由此证明 f 在 x₀ 处连续。
zh.answer: 令 α(Δx)=[f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)]/Δx-f′(x₀)（Δx≠0），并令 α(0)=0，即得所需表示和连续性。

solution.analysis: 从差商趋于 f′(x₀) 出发，把二者之差命名为 α(Δx)。这个误差趋于 0，乘回 Δx 后得到函数增量的线性主部。
steps: 因 f 在 x₀ 可导，lim_{Δx→0}[f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)]/Δx=f′(x₀)。
当 Δx≠0 时定义 α(Δx)=[f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)]/Δx-f′(x₀)，并补充定义 α(0)=0。
由导数极限立刻得到 α(Δx)→0；移项并乘以 Δx，得到 f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)=f′(x₀)Δx+α(Δx)Δx。
当 Δx→0 时，f′(x₀)Δx→0，且 α(Δx)Δx→0，所以函数增量趋于 0，f 在 x₀ 连续。
pitfalls: 只写增量公式却不构造 α
没有证明 α(Δx)→0
把 α(Δx)Δx 错写成与 Δx 无关的常数
solution.verification: 将所得表达式除以 Δx（Δx≠0），又回到差商=f′(x₀)+α(Δx)，其极限确为 f′(x₀)。
solution.takeaway: 可导的核心不仅是连续，还意味着函数增量具有线性主部 f′(x₀)Δx 和更小的余项。
solution.extension: 这一增量表示也是后续定义微分 Δy=AΔx+o(Δx) 的直接基础。

en.title: Prove Differentiability Implies Continuity via an Infinitesimal Remainder
en.prompt: Suppose f is differentiable at x₀. Prove that some α(Δx)→0 satisfies f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)=f′(x₀)Δx+α(Δx)Δx, and use it to prove continuity at x₀.
en.answer: For Δx≠0, set α(Δx)=[f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)]/Δx-f′(x₀), and set α(0)=0. This gives the representation and continuity.

solution.analysis: Start from the difference quotient tending to f′(x₀), and name its error α(Δx). This error tends to 0; multiplying back by Δx gives the linear principal part of the function increment.
steps: Because f is differentiable at x₀, lim_{Δx→0}[f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)]/Δx=f′(x₀).
For Δx≠0 define α(Δx)=[f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)]/Δx-f′(x₀), and complete the definition by setting α(0)=0.
The derivative limit immediately gives α(Δx)→0. Rearranging and multiplying by Δx yields f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)=f′(x₀)Δx+α(Δx)Δx.
As Δx→0, both f′(x₀)Δx and α(Δx)Δx tend to 0, so the function increment tends to 0 and f is continuous at x₀.
pitfalls: stating the increment formula without constructing α
failing to prove α(Δx)→0
treating α(Δx)Δx as a constant independent of Δx
solution.verification: Dividing the representation by Δx for Δx≠0 recovers the quotient f′(x₀)+α(Δx), whose limit is indeed f′(x₀).
solution.takeaway: Differentiability provides more than continuity: the function increment has a linear principal part f′(x₀)Δx and a smaller remainder.
solution.extension: This representation directly motivates the later definition of a differential through Δy=AΔx+o(Δx).

zh.title: 连接点的参数匹配
zh.prompt: 设 f(x)={x², x≤1; ax+b, x>1}。求 a,b，使 f 在 x=1 处可导，并求 f′(1)。

solution.analysis: 可导必须先连续，再要求左右导数相等。连续条件决定 a+b，斜率匹配条件决定 a。
steps: 由左段及函数定义，f(1)=1；右极限为 lim_{x→1⁺}(ax+b)=a+b。
连续性要求 a+b=1，这是可导的必要条件。
左导数为 lim_{h→0⁻}[(1+h)²-1]/h=2；利用 a+b=1，右导数为 lim_{h→0⁺}[a(1+h)+b-1]/h=a。
令左右导数相等得 a=2，再由 a+b=1 得 b=-1；共同导数为 f′(1)=2。
pitfalls: 只匹配两段公式的函数值而不匹配斜率
在求右导数前漏用 a+b=1，导致差商中出现常数项
把 a+b=1 写成 a-b=1
solution.verification: 代入 a=2、b=-1，右段为 2x-1，在 x=1 取值 1、斜率 2，与左段 x² 的值和斜率都一致。
solution.takeaway: 分段函数在连接点可导需要两层匹配：先匹配函数值，再匹配左右斜率。
solution.extension: 若只要求连续，则所有满足 a+b=1 的参数都可以，不必要求 a=2。

en.title: Matching Parameters at a Junction
en.prompt: Let f(x)={x², x≤1; ax+b, x>1}. Find a,b so that f is differentiable at x=1, and find f′(1).

solution.analysis: Differentiability first requires continuity and then equality of the one-sided derivatives. Continuity determines a+b, while slope matching determines a.
steps: From the left branch and the definition, f(1)=1; the right-hand limit is lim_{x→1⁺}(ax+b)=a+b.
Continuity requires a+b=1, which is necessary for differentiability.
The left derivative is lim_{h→0⁻}[(1+h)²-1]/h=2. Using a+b=1, the right derivative is lim_{h→0⁺}[a(1+h)+b-1]/h=a.
Equality of the one-sided derivatives gives a=2; then a+b=1 gives b=-1, and f′(1)=2.
pitfalls: matching function values but not slopes
finding the right derivative without first using a+b=1, leaving a constant term in the quotient
writing a-b=1 instead of a+b=1
solution.verification: With a=2 and b=-1, the right branch is 2x-1, which has value 1 and slope 2 at x=1, matching the left branch x².
solution.takeaway: Differentiability at a piecewise junction requires two matches: function values first, then one-sided slopes.
solution.extension: If only continuity were required, every pair satisfying a+b=1 would work; a=2 would not be necessary.

zh.title: 求指定时刻的瞬时速度
zh.prompt: 质点的位置为 s(t)=t³-6t²+9t（m），t 以 s 为单位。用差商极限求 t=2 时的瞬时速度 v(2)=______。

solution.analysis: 按定义计算 [s(2+h)-s(2)]/h。展开后常数项应完全抵消，留下可约去的 h。
steps: 平均速度差商为 [s(2+h)-s(2)]/h=(-3h+h³)/h=-3+h²。
令 h→0，得到 v(2)=lim_{h→0}(-3+h²)=-3 m/s；负号表示此刻沿选定正方向的反方向运动。
pitfalls: 把位置 s(2)=2 m 当成速度
展开多项式时漏掉交叉项
答案遗漏速度单位或误解负号
solution.verification: 也可先由基本规则得到 s′(t)=3t²-12t+9，代入 t=2 得 -3，与定义计算一致。
solution.takeaway: 瞬时速度是位置关于时间的导数，数值的正负描述方向而不是速率的大小。
solution.extension: 在 t=2 附近的平均速度为 -3+h²；当 h 很小时，它确实接近 -3 m/s。

en.title: Instantaneous Velocity at a Specified Time
en.prompt: A particle has position s(t)=t³-6t²+9t meters, with t in seconds. Use a difference-quotient limit to find the instantaneous velocity at t=2, namely v(2)=______.

knowledge: directional meaning of a negative sign
solution.analysis: Compute [s(2+h)-s(2)]/h from the definition. After expansion, all constant terms should cancel, leaving a factor h.
steps: The average-velocity quotient is [s(2+h)-s(2)]/h=(-3h+h³)/h=-3+h².
Letting h→0 gives v(2)=lim_{h→0}(-3+h²)=-3 m/s; the negative sign indicates motion opposite the chosen positive direction.
pitfalls: using the position s(2)=2 m as the velocity
omitting cross terms in the expansion
dropping the velocity unit or misreading the negative sign
solution.verification: The basic rules also give s′(t)=3t²-12t+9, and substitution t=2 gives -3, matching the first-principles result.
solution.takeaway: Instantaneous velocity is the derivative of position with respect to time; its sign records direction, not merely speed.
solution.extension: The average velocity near t=2 is -3+h², which approaches -3 m/s for small h.

zh.title: 根式曲线的切线与法线
zh.prompt: 不用现成求导公式，由定义求曲线 y=√x 在点 (4,2) 处的导数，并写出切线与法线方程。

solution.analysis: 差商含两个根式，乘以共轭式有理化即可约去 h。导数非零，所以法线斜率存在且为 -1/f′(4)。
steps: 法线斜率为 -4，故法线为 y-2=-4(x-4)。
pitfalls: 有理化时只乘分子不乘分母
把 √(4+h) 的极限误当成 4
法线斜率漏写负号
solution.verification: 切线与法线均经过 (4,2)，斜率乘积 (1/4)(-4)=-1，且定义所得斜率为正，符合曲线在该点上升。
solution.takeaway: 根式差商优先用共轭式；得到切线斜率后，几何方程按点斜式完成。
solution.extension: 同样有理化可得 (√x)′=1/(2√x)，适用于 x>0。

en.title: Tangent and Normal to a Square-Root Curve
en.prompt: Without using a ready-made derivative formula, find the derivative of y=√x at (4,2) from the definition, and write the tangent and normal lines.

knowledge: normal slope as the negative reciprocal
solution.analysis: The quotient contains two radicals, so multiply by the conjugate to cancel h. The derivative is nonzero, so the normal slope exists and equals -1/f′(4).
steps: By definition, f′(4)=lim_{h→0}[√(4+h)-2]/h.
Rationalizing gives [(4+h)-4]/{h[√(4+h)+2]}=1/[√(4+h)+2].
Let h→0 to obtain f′(4)=1/(2+2)=1/4; hence the tangent is y-2=(1/4)(x-4).
The normal slope is -4, so the normal line is y-2=-4(x-4).
pitfalls: multiplying only the numerator by the conjugate
treating the limit of √(4+h) as 4
omitting the minus sign in the normal slope
solution.verification: Both lines pass through (4,2), their slopes multiply to (1/4)(-4)=-1, and the positive tangent slope agrees with the curve rising there.
solution.takeaway: Use the conjugate for a radical difference quotient, then convert the derivative into geometric line equations.
solution.extension: The same rationalization gives (√x)′=1/(2√x) for x>0.

zh.title: 检验可导必连续的逆命题
zh.prompt: 判断正误并给出严格理由：若 f 在 x₀ 处连续，则 f 在 x₀ 处可导。
zh.answer: 错误；例如 f(x)=|x-x₀| 在 x₀ 连续但不可导。

solution.analysis: 一个全称命题只需一个反例即可否定。选择在 x₀ 有尖角的绝对值函数，同时验证其连续性和不可导性。
steps: 令 f(x)=|x-x₀|，则 f(x₀)=0。
当 x→x₀ 时，|x-x₀|→0=f(x₀)，所以 f 在 x₀ 连续。
从左侧取 h→0⁻，差商 |h|/h=-1，因此 f′₋(x₀)=-1。
从右侧取 h→0⁺，差商 |h|/h=1，因此 f′₊(x₀)=1；两者不等，f 在 x₀ 不可导，原命题错误。
pitfalls: 只画图而不计算左右导数
把“可导蕴含连续”擅自改成双向等价
反例没有验证连续性
solution.verification: 该反例对任意指定 x₀ 都成立，因此确实否定了原命题的普遍性。
solution.takeaway: 连续排除了跳跃，却没有排除尖角；因此连续只是可导的必要条件，不是充分条件。
solution.extension: f(x)=|x-x₀|^{1/2} 也连续但在 x₀ 没有有限导数，呈现另一种失效方式。

en.title: Testing the Converse of Differentiability Implies Continuity
en.prompt: Decide whether the statement is true and justify rigorously: if f is continuous at x₀, then f is differentiable at x₀.
en.answer: False; for example, f(x)=|x-x₀| is continuous but not differentiable at x₀.

solution.analysis: One counterexample disproves a universal statement. Choose an absolute-value function with a corner at x₀, and verify both continuity and failure of differentiability.
steps: Let f(x)=|x-x₀|, so f(x₀)=0.
As x→x₀, |x-x₀|→0=f(x₀), so f is continuous at x₀.
For h→0⁻, the quotient |h|/h=-1, so f′₋(x₀)=-1.
For h→0⁺, the quotient |h|/h=1, so f′₊(x₀)=1. The values differ, so f is not differentiable at x₀ and the statement is false.
pitfalls: drawing a graph without calculating the one-sided derivatives
turning the one-way implication into an equivalence
giving a counterexample without checking continuity
solution.verification: The construction works for every prescribed x₀, so it genuinely disproves the universal claim.
solution.takeaway: Continuity excludes jumps but not corners; it is necessary, not sufficient, for differentiability.
solution.extension: The function f(x)=|x-x₀|^{1/2} is also continuous but has no finite derivative at x₀, showing a different failure mode.

zh.title: 证明平移绝对值在尖点不可导
zh.prompt: 设 a 为任意实数。证明 f(x)=|x-a| 在 x=a 处连续，但左导数为 -1、右导数为 1，因而不可导。
zh.answer: f 在 a 连续，且 f′₋(a)=-1、f′₊(a)=1，所以 f′(a) 不存在。

knowledge: 平移不改变绝对值尖角结构
solution.analysis: 以 h=x-a 表示对基点 a 的增量，问题就完全化为 |h| 在 0 附近的行为。
steps: f(a)=|a-a|=0；当 x→a 时，|x-a|→0，因此 lim_{x→a}f(x)=f(a)，f 在 a 连续。
差商为 [f(a+h)-f(a)]/h=|h|/h。
若 h→0⁺，则 |h|=h，差商为 1，所以 f′₊(a)=1；两侧不等，故 f′(a) 不存在。
pitfalls: 把基点 a 误认为必须等于 0
连续性验证中漏掉 f(a)
认为平移后尖角会消失
solution.verification: 令 u=x-a，图像只是 y=|u| 水平平移到顶点 (a,0)，左右斜率仍分别为 -1、1。
solution.takeaway: 处理平移后的局部性质时，用增量 h=x-a 可把基点移回 0。
solution.extension: 对 c|x-a|+d，若 c≠0，则在 x=a 仍不可导，左右导数分别为 -c 与 c。

en.title: Prove a Translated Absolute Value Is Not Differentiable at Its Corner
en.prompt: Let a be any real number. Prove that f(x)=|x-a| is continuous at x=a, but has left derivative -1 and right derivative 1 there, and hence is not differentiable.
en.answer: f is continuous at a, with f′₋(a)=-1 and f′₊(a)=1, so f′(a) does not exist.

knowledge: translation preserves the corner of an absolute-value graph
solution.analysis: Use h=x-a as the increment from the base point a. The local problem then becomes exactly the behavior of |h| near 0.
steps: Since f(a)=|a-a|=0 and |x-a|→0 as x→a, lim_{x→a}f(x)=f(a), so f is continuous at a.
The difference quotient is [f(a+h)-f(a)]/h=|h|/h.
For h→0⁻, |h|=-h, so the quotient is -1 and f′₋(a)=-1.
For h→0⁺, |h|=h, so the quotient is 1 and f′₊(a)=1. The values differ, so f′(a) does not exist.
pitfalls: assuming the base point a must be 0
omitting f(a) in the continuity check
thinking that translation removes the corner
solution.verification: With u=x-a, the graph is simply y=|u| shifted so its vertex is (a,0); the one-sided slopes remain -1 and 1.
solution.takeaway: For a translated local property, the increment h=x-a moves the base point back to 0.
solution.extension: For c|x-a|+d with c≠0, differentiability still fails at x=a; the one-sided derivatives are -c and c.

zh.title: 乘积法则与结果化简
zh.prompt: 求函数 y=(x²+1)(x³-2x) 的导数，并将结果化为多项式。

solution.analysis: 把两个因子分别记为 u、v，使用 (uv)′=u′v+uv′。最后展开核对，可以避免漏掉其中一项。
steps: 令 u=x²+1、v=x³-2x，则 u′=2x，v′=3x²-2。
由乘积法则，y′=2x(x³-2x)+(x²+1)(3x²-2)。
分别展开得到 2x⁴-4x² 与 3x⁴+x²-2。
合并同类项，y′=(2x⁴+3x⁴)+(-4x²+x²)-2=5x⁴-3x²-2。
pitfalls: 误写成 u′v′
只对一个因子求导
展开 (x²+1)(3x²-2) 时漏掉常数项 -2
solution.verification: 先展开原函数 y=x⁵-x³-2x，再逐项求导同样得到 5x⁴-3x²-2。
solution.takeaway: 乘积求导保留“两项交叉结构”；能展开时可用另一条路径交叉检查。
solution.extension: 若函数含三个因子，可逐次使用乘积法则，得到每次只对一个因子求导的三项和。

en.title: Product Rule and Simplification
en.prompt: Differentiate y=(x²+1)(x³-2x), and simplify the result to a polynomial.

solution.analysis: Name the two factors u and v and use (uv)′=u′v+uv′. Expanding afterward provides a useful check against a missing term.
steps: Let u=x²+1 and v=x³-2x. Then u′=2x and v′=3x²-2.
By the product rule, y′=2x(x³-2x)+(x²+1)(3x²-2).
The two expanded expressions are 2x⁴-4x² and 3x⁴+x²-2.
Combining like terms gives y′=(2x⁴+3x⁴)+(-4x²+x²)-2=5x⁴-3x²-2.
pitfalls: writing u′v′
differentiating only one factor
losing the constant term -2 when expanding (x²+1)(3x²-2)
solution.verification: Expanding first gives y=x⁵-x³-2x, whose termwise derivative is also 5x⁴-3x²-2.
solution.takeaway: A product derivative retains two cross terms; when expansion is possible, use it as an independent check.
solution.extension: For three factors, repeated use of the product rule gives a three-term sum in which one factor is differentiated at a time.

zh.title: 识别内外层并求导

solution.analysis: 外层是 sin u，内层是 u=3x²-1。先求外层对 u 的导数，再乘内层对 x 的导数。
steps: 设 u=3x²-1，则 y=sin u。
外层导数为 dy/du=cos u。
内层导数为 du/dx=6x。
由链式法则，y′=(dy/du)(du/dx)=cos(3x²-1)·6x=6x cos(3x²-1)。
pitfalls: 只写 cos(3x²-1) 而漏乘 6x
把 (sin u)′ 写成 -sin u
将内层常数 -1 错求成 -1
solution.verification: 在 x=0 时内层的变化率为 0，公式给出 y′(0)=0，符合复合变化率应含内层因子。
solution.takeaway: 链式法则可记作“外层导数保留内层，再乘内层导数”。
solution.extension: 若 y=sin³(3x²-1)，还需再增加一层幂函数链式求导。

en.title: Identify the Inner and Outer Functions
en.prompt: If y=sin(3x²-1), then y′=______.

solution.analysis: The outer function is sin u and the inner function is u=3x²-1. Differentiate the outer function with respect to u and multiply by the derivative of the inner function.
steps: Set u=3x²-1, so y=sin u.
The outer derivative is dy/du=cos u.
The inner derivative is du/dx=6x.
By the chain rule, y′=(dy/du)(du/dx)=cos(3x²-1)·6x=6x cos(3x²-1).
pitfalls: writing only cos(3x²-1) and omitting 6x
using -sin u as the derivative of sin u
differentiating the inner constant -1 as -1
solution.verification: At x=0 the inner rate is 0, and the formula gives y′(0)=0, as a composite rate should include the inner factor.
solution.takeaway: For the chain rule, differentiate the outer layer while keeping the inner expression, then multiply by the inner derivative.
solution.extension: For y=sin³(3x²-1), an additional outer power layer would also need the chain rule.

zh.title: 辨析四类求导公式
zh.prompt: 设各公式所需的可导、定义域、非零分母及反函数连续性条件均满足；对反函数公式，令 y₀=f(x₀) 且 f′(x₀)≠0。下列公式中正确的是哪些？

solution.analysis: A、B、D 是标准公式；C 的错误在于外层导数应在内层函数值 g(x) 处取值，而不是在 x 处取值。
steps: 乘积法则为 (fg)′=f′g+fg′，所以 A 正确。
在 g≠0 处，商法则为 (f/g)′=(f′g-fg′)/g²，所以 B 正确。
链式法则的正确形式是 (f∘g)′(x)=f′(g(x))g′(x)，故 C 一般错误。
在题设反函数条件下，(f⁻¹)′(y₀)=1/f′(x₀)，所以 D 正确。
pitfalls: 把乘积导数写成两个导数的乘积
商法则分子次序颠倒
链式法则中遗漏 f′ 的取值点 g(x)
solution.verification: 取 f(u)=u²、g(x)=x+1，则复合导数为 2(x+1)，而 C 给出 2x，二者不同，直接否定 C。
solution.takeaway: 公式记忆应包含结构和取值点，尤其链式法则中的 f′(g(x)) 不能简写错位。
solution.extension: 把商 f/g 写成 f·g⁻¹，再用乘积与链式法则，也可推出商法则。

en.title: Distinguish Four Differentiation Formulas
en.prompt: Assume all differentiability, domain, nonzero-denominator, and inverse-continuity conditions required by the formulas hold. For the inverse formula, let y₀=f(x₀) and f′(x₀)≠0. Which formulas are correct?

solution.analysis: A, B, and D are standard formulas. C is wrong because the derivative of the outer function must be evaluated at the inner value g(x), not at x.
steps: The product rule is (fg)′=f′g+fg′, so A is correct.
Where g≠0, the quotient rule is (f/g)′=(f′g-fg′)/g², so B is correct.
The correct chain rule is (f∘g)′(x)=f′(g(x))g′(x), so C is generally false.
Under the stated inverse-function conditions, (f⁻¹)′(y₀)=1/f′(x₀), so D is correct.
pitfalls: writing the derivative of a product as the product of derivatives
reversing the numerator in the quotient rule
omitting the evaluation point g(x) in the chain rule
solution.verification: Take f(u)=u² and g(x)=x+1. The composite derivative is 2(x+1), while C gives 2x, directly disproving C.
solution.takeaway: A formula includes both its algebraic structure and its evaluation points; f′(g(x)) in the chain rule is essential.
solution.extension: Writing f/g as f·g⁻¹ and applying the product and chain rules also derives the quotient rule.

zh.title: 有理函数的商法则
zh.prompt: 求 y=(x²+1)/(x-1) 的导数，并注明导数公式的适用范围。

solution.analysis: 把分子、分母分别看作 u、v，按“上导乘下减上乘下导，除以下平方”计算，并保留 x≠1。
steps: 化简分子：2x²-2x-x²-1=x²-2x-1。
所以 y′=(x²-2x-1)/(x-1)²；原函数与该求导式都只在 x≠1 时讨论。
pitfalls: 把分母写成 x-1 而不是 (x-1)²
分子两项顺序颠倒导致整体符号相反
答案漏掉 x≠1
solution.verification: 将原函数作代数除法得 y=x+1+2/(x-1)，求导为 1-2/(x-1)²，通分后仍是 (x²-2x-1)/(x-1)²。
solution.takeaway: 商法则不仅要算对分子次序，还要保留原分母不为零的定义域条件。
solution.extension: 可比较先作代数除法再求导与直接使用商法则的工作量。

en.title: Quotient Rule for a Rational Function
en.prompt: Differentiate y=(x²+1)/(x-1), and state where the derivative formula applies.

solution.analysis: Treat the numerator and denominator as u and v. Use the quotient rule in its ordered form and retain the restriction x≠1.
steps: Let u=x²+1 and v=x-1. Then u′=2x and v′=1.
By the quotient rule, y′=[2x(x-1)-(x²+1)·1]/(x-1)².
Simplify the numerator: 2x²-2x-x²-1=x²-2x-1.
Thus y′=(x²-2x-1)/(x-1)²; both the original function and this derivative are considered only for x≠1.
pitfalls: using x-1 instead of (x-1)² in the denominator
reversing the numerator terms and changing the overall sign
omitting x≠1
solution.verification: Polynomial division gives y=x+1+2/(x-1), whose derivative is 1-2/(x-1)²; combining fractions reproduces (x²-2x-1)/(x-1)².
solution.takeaway: For a quotient, preserve both the numerator order and the original nonzero-denominator condition.
solution.extension: Compare the work required by algebraic division followed by differentiation with direct use of the quotient rule.

zh.title: 乘积嵌套在商中
zh.prompt: 在 x>0 且 x≠1 上，求 y=(x²+1)ln x/(x−1) 的导数，并给出一个通分后的结果。

solution.analysis: 先把分子视为一个整体 N=(x²+1)ln x 求导，再对 N/(x−1) 使用商法则，能减少漏项。
steps: 设 N(x)=(x²+1)ln x，则 y=N(x)/(x−1)。
由乘积法则，N′(x)=2xln x+(x²+1)/x。
代入 N 与 N′，得到 y′={[2xln x+(x²+1)/x](x−1)−(x²+1)ln x}/(x−1)²。
合并含 ln x 的项：2x(x−1)−(x²+1)=x²−2x−1，故得到所给答案。
pitfalls: 分子求导时漏掉 (x²+1)/x
商法则分子次序颠倒
在 x=1 处使用不成立的公式
solution.verification: 保留未完全化简式并重新展开，可逐项恢复最终分子；两式的定义域同为 x>0、x≠1。
solution.takeaway: 复杂商式先为分子命名，再分层使用乘积法则和商法则。
solution.extension: 若分母改为 x−a，只需把商法则中的 x−1 相应替换为 x−a。

en.title: A Product Nested Inside a Quotient
en.prompt: For x>0 and x≠1, differentiate y=(x²+1)ln x/(x−1), and give a result over a common denominator.

solution.analysis: First differentiate the numerator as a single function N=(x²+1)ln x, then apply the quotient rule to N/(x−1). This organization prevents missing terms.
steps: Let N(x)=(x²+1)ln x, so y=N(x)/(x−1).
The product rule gives N′(x)=2xln x+(x²+1)/x.
The quotient rule gives y′=[N′(x)(x−1)−N(x)]/(x−1)².
Substitution yields y′={[2xln x+(x²+1)/x](x−1)−(x²+1)ln x}/(x−1)².
For the logarithmic terms, 2x(x−1)−(x²+1)=x²−2x−1, which gives the stated answer.
pitfalls: Omitting (x²+1)/x from the numerator derivative
Reversing the quotient-rule numerator
Using the formula at x=1
solution.verification: Expanding the partially simplified form reproduces the final numerator term by term, and both forms have domain x>0, x≠1.
solution.takeaway: Name a complicated numerator first, then apply product and quotient rules layer by layer.
solution.extension: If the denominator is changed to x−a, replace each occurrence of x−1 in the quotient-rule setup by x−a.

zh.title: 反正弦与平方根的复合
zh.prompt: 在 0<x<1 上，y=arcsin√x 的导数是哪一项？

solution.analysis: 外层是 arcsin u，内层是 u=√x。分母中的 1−u² 可化为 1−x，但还要乘上 u′。
steps: 设 u=√x，则 y=arcsin u。
外层导数为 dy/du=1/√(1−u²)。
内层导数为 du/dx=1/(2√x)。
代入 u²=x，得到 y′=1/[2√x√(1−x)]，故选 B。
pitfalls: 把 1−u² 错化为 1−√x
误加反正弦导数的负号
solution.verification: 在 0<x<1 上，两个根式均为正，函数随 x 增大时导数为正，与公式符号一致。
solution.takeaway: 反三角复合求导时，先保留中间变量，最后再化简根式。
solution.extension: 对 y=arcsin√(ax+b)，还需再乘内层 ax+b 的导数 a。

en.title: A Composite of Arcsine and a Square Root
en.prompt: For 0<x<1, which expression is the derivative of y=arcsin√x?

solution.analysis: The outer function is arcsin u and the inner function is u=√x. The quantity 1−u² becomes 1−x, but the factor u′ must still be included.
steps: Set u=√x, so y=arcsin u.
The outer derivative is dy/du=1/√(1−u²).
The inner derivative is du/dx=1/(2√x).
By the chain rule, y′=1/[2√x√(1−u²)].
Since u²=x, y′=1/[2√x√(1−x)], so the answer is B.
pitfalls: Omitting the factor 1/(2√x)
Replacing 1−u² by 1−√x
Adding an incorrect negative sign to the arcsine derivative
solution.verification: For 0<x<1 both radicals are positive, so the derivative is positive, consistent with the function increasing with x.
solution.takeaway: For an inverse-trigonometric composite, keep the inner variable until all chain-rule factors are present.
solution.extension: For y=arcsin√(ax+b), one must also multiply by the derivative a of ax+b.

zh.title: 四条求导法则辨析
zh.prompt: 设所涉及函数在相应点可导，且各表达式有意义。下列说法中正确的是哪些？
choices: D. 若 f 存在可导反函数且 f′(f⁻¹(y))≠0，则 (f⁻¹)′(y)=1/f′(f⁻¹(y))

solution.analysis: 逐项核对公式的结构和使用条件。B 把乘积法则错误地写成两个导数的乘积，其余三项均是标准公式。
steps: A 是链式法则：先求外层导数并在 v(x) 处取值，再乘内层导数，因此 A 正确。
B 错误；正确的乘积法则是 (uv)′=u′v+uv′。
C 的分子次序、分母平方及条件 v(x)≠0 均正确，因此 C 正确。
D 在对应点原函数导数非零时给出了正确的反函数导数公式，因此 D 正确。
综上，正确选项为 A、C、D。
pitfalls: 把乘积法则记成 u′v′
商法则漏掉分母平方
反函数公式中漏写对应点 f⁻¹(y)
solution.verification: 取 u=v=x 可立刻检验 B：左边 (x²)′=2x，而右边为 1。
solution.takeaway: 记公式时同时记住其结构与条件，比只记符号更可靠。
solution.extension: 尝试用乘积法则和 (1/v)′=−v′/v² 推导商法则。

en.title: Distinguishing Four Differentiation Rules
en.prompt: Assume the functions involved are differentiable at the relevant points and all expressions are defined. Which statements are correct?
choices: D. If f has a differentiable inverse and f′(f⁻¹(y))≠0, then (f⁻¹)′(y)=1/f′(f⁻¹(y))

solution.analysis: Check both the structure and the conditions of each formula. Statement B incorrectly replaces the product rule by a product of derivatives; the other three are standard formulas.
steps: A is the chain rule: differentiate the outer function at v(x), then multiply by the inner derivative, so A is correct.
B is false; the correct product rule is (uv)′=u′v+uv′.
C has the correct numerator order, squared denominator, and condition v(x)≠0, so C is correct.
D is the correct inverse derivative formula when the original derivative at the corresponding point is nonzero.
Therefore the correct selections are A, C, and D.
pitfalls: Remembering the product rule as u′v′
Omitting the squared denominator in the quotient rule
Omitting the corresponding point f⁻¹(y) in the inverse formula
solution.verification: Taking u=v=x immediately disproves B: the left side is (x²)′=2x, while the proposed right side is 1.
solution.takeaway: A differentiation formula is safest when its structure and its conditions are remembered together.
solution.extension: Derive the quotient rule from the product rule and (1/v)′=−v′/v².

zh.title: 对数包裹的三角平方
zh.prompt: 求 y=ln[1+sin²(3x)] 的导数，并按由外到内的顺序写出各层。

solution.analysis: 共有 ln、1+平方、sin、3x 四层。求导时从最外层向内层依次乘入导数因子。
steps: 设 u=1+sin²(3x)，则 y=ln u，所以 y′=u′/u。
设 v=sin(3x)，则 u=1+v²，从而 u′=2vv′。
由链式法则 v′=cos(3x)·3。
合并得到 y′=6sin(3x)cos(3x)/[1+sin²(3x)]。
利用 2sin A cos A=sin 2A，还可写成 3sin(6x)/[1+sin²(3x)]。
pitfalls: 漏掉最内层因子 3
把 sin²(3x) 的导数写成 2sin(3x)
对整个括号误用 ln 的导数
solution.verification: 在 x=0 处，原函数关于小增量的第一阶变化系数为 0；所得公式代入 x=0 也为 0。
solution.takeaway: 多层复合函数可通过逐层命名稳定地列出全部链式因子。
solution.extension: 若把 3x 改为一般可导函数 φ(x)，最后一个因子 3 应替换为 φ′(x)。

en.title: A Trigonometric Square Inside a Logarithm
en.prompt: Differentiate y=ln[1+sin²(3x)], listing the layers from outside to inside.

solution.analysis: There are four layers: ln, addition and squaring, sine, and 3x. Differentiate from the outside inward, multiplying the derivative contributed by every layer.
steps: Set u=1+sin²(3x), so y=ln u and y′=u′/u.
Set v=sin(3x), so u=1+v² and u′=2vv′.
The chain rule gives v′=cos(3x)·3.
Combining the factors gives y′=6sin(3x)cos(3x)/[1+sin²(3x)].
Using 2sin A cos A=sin 2A, this may also be written as 3sin(6x)/[1+sin²(3x)].
pitfalls: Missing the innermost factor 3
Writing the derivative of sin²(3x) as 2sin(3x)
Misapplying the derivative of ln to the whole expression
solution.verification: At x=0, the first-order change of the original function is zero, and the derived formula also evaluates to zero.
solution.takeaway: Naming each layer of a composite function is a reliable way to retain every chain-rule factor.
solution.extension: If 3x is replaced by a differentiable φ(x), replace the last factor 3 by φ′(x).

zh.title: 底数与指数都含变量
zh.prompt: 求 y=(x²+1)ˢⁱⁿˣ 的导数。要求使用对数求导，并说明其定义域。
zh.answer: y′=(x²+1)ˢⁱⁿˣ[cos x·ln(x²+1)+2xsin x/(x²+1)]，定义域为全体实数。

solution.analysis: 底数 x²+1 恒正，因此可对等式两边取自然对数，把变量指数转化为乘积，再求导。
steps: 因为 x²+1>0 对所有实数成立，所以 y>0 且原函数在 ℝ 上有定义。
两边取对数得 ln y=sin x·ln(x²+1)。
对 x 求导：y′/y=cos x·ln(x²+1)+sin x·2x/(x²+1)。
两边乘以 y，得到 y′=y[cos x·ln(x²+1)+2xsin x/(x²+1)]。
代回 y=(x²+1)ˢⁱⁿˣ，得到所给答案。
pitfalls: 直接套用普通幂函数公式
取对数后把右边误写成 sin x+ln(x²+1)
最后忘记乘回 y
solution.verification: 在 x=0 处，y=1，括号内两项均为 0，所以 y′(0)=0；原函数在 0 附近的底数为偶函数且指数在 0 处为 0，与此相容。
solution.takeaway: 正底数的变量幂优先取对数，把“指数位置的变量”移到乘法位置。
solution.extension: 对一般 y=u(x)ᵛ⁽ˣ⁾ 且 u>0，有 y′=y[v′ln u+vu′/u]。

en.title: Both Base and Exponent Depend on x
en.prompt: Differentiate y=(x²+1)ˢⁱⁿˣ using logarithmic differentiation, and state its domain.
en.answer: y′=(x²+1)ˢⁱⁿˣ[cos x·ln(x²+1)+2xsin x/(x²+1)], with domain all real x.

solution.analysis: The base x²+1 is always positive, so taking natural logarithms converts the variable exponent into a product that can be differentiated normally.
steps: Since x²+1>0 for every real x, y>0 and the original function is defined on ℝ.
Take logarithms: ln y=sin x·ln(x²+1).
Differentiate: y′/y=cos x·ln(x²+1)+sin x·2x/(x²+1).
Multiply by y to obtain y′=y[cos x·ln(x²+1)+2xsin x/(x²+1)].
Substitute y=(x²+1)ˢⁱⁿˣ to obtain the stated answer.
pitfalls: Applying the ordinary power rule directly
Changing the product into a sum after taking logarithms
Forgetting to multiply back by y
solution.verification: At x=0, y=1 and both terms in brackets vanish, so y′(0)=0, consistent with the local structure of the original function.
solution.takeaway: For a variable power with positive base, logarithms move the variable exponent into an ordinary product.
solution.extension: For y=u(x)ᵛ⁽ˣ⁾ with u>0, y′=y[v′ln u+vu′/u].

zh.title: 从定义证明反函数求导公式
zh.prompt: 设 f 在 x₀ 处可导且 f′(x₀)≠0，f 在 x₀ 附近一一对应；其反函数 g 在 y₀=f(x₀) 处连续。用导数定义证明 g′(y₀)=1/f′(x₀)。
zh.answer: 令 x=g(y)，利用 (g(y)−g(y₀))/(y−y₀)=(x−x₀)/(f(x)−f(x₀)) 并取极限，即得 g′(y₀)=1/f′(x₀)。

solution.analysis: 核心是把反函数的差商改写为原函数差商的倒数。g 在 y₀ 处连续保证 y→y₀ 时 x=g(y)→x₀。
steps: 由 y₀=f(x₀) 与 g=f⁻¹，知 g(y₀)=x₀。
令 y≠y₀ 且 x=g(y)。一一对应保证 x≠x₀，并且 y=f(x)。
反函数差商可改写为 [g(y)−g(y₀)]/(y−y₀)=(x−x₀)/[f(x)−f(x₀)]。
由于 g 在 y₀ 连续，当 y→y₀ 时 x=g(y)→x₀；上式右边是原函数差商的倒数。
原函数差商趋于 f′(x₀)≠0，因此其倒数趋于 1/f′(x₀)。
依导数定义，g′(y₀)=1/f′(x₀)，证毕。
pitfalls: 未说明 y→y₀ 会推出 x→x₀
忽略 f′(x₀)≠0 才能取倒数
把 y₀ 与 x₀ 混为同一自变量
solution.verification: 以 f(x)=2x+3 为例，f′=2，反函数 g(y)=(y−3)/2 的导数确为 1/2。
solution.takeaway: 反函数求导公式本质上是对应增量比值互为倒数。
solution.extension: 若 f′(x₀)=0，差商倒数可能无有限极限，需回到定义单独判断反函数。

en.title: Proving the Inverse Derivative Formula from the Definition
en.prompt: Suppose f is differentiable at x₀ with f′(x₀)≠0 and is one-to-one near x₀. Its inverse g is continuous at y₀=f(x₀). Prove from the derivative definition that g′(y₀)=1/f′(x₀).
en.answer: Set x=g(y), rewrite (g(y)−g(y₀))/(y−y₀) as (x−x₀)/(f(x)−f(x₀)), and take the limit to obtain g′(y₀)=1/f′(x₀).

solution.analysis: The key is to rewrite the inverse difference quotient as the reciprocal of the original difference quotient. Continuity of g at y₀ ensures that x=g(y) approaches x₀ when y approaches y₀.
steps: From y₀=f(x₀) and g=f⁻¹, we have g(y₀)=x₀.
For y≠y₀, set x=g(y). One-to-one correspondence gives x≠x₀ and y=f(x).
Rewrite the inverse difference quotient as [g(y)−g(y₀)]/(y−y₀)=(x−x₀)/[f(x)−f(x₀)].
Because g is continuous at y₀, y→y₀ implies x=g(y)→x₀; the right side is the reciprocal of the original difference quotient.
That original quotient tends to f′(x₀)≠0, so its reciprocal tends to 1/f′(x₀).
By the derivative definition, g′(y₀)=1/f′(x₀), as required.
pitfalls: Failing to justify that y→y₀ implies x→x₀
Ignoring the nonzero condition before taking a reciprocal
Confusing the inputs x₀ and y₀
solution.verification: For f(x)=2x+3, f′=2 and the inverse g(y)=(y−3)/2 indeed has derivative 1/2.
solution.takeaway: The inverse derivative formula comes directly from reciprocal ratios of corresponding increments.
solution.extension: If f′(x₀)=0, the reciprocal quotient may have no finite limit, so the inverse must be examined from its definition.

zh.title: 确定分段函数中的两个参数

knowledge: 连续是可导的必要条件
solution.analysis: 先用连续性连接两段函数值，再令左右导数相等；这两条独立条件恰好确定 a、b。
steps: 左极限为 a+b；连续性要求 a+b=2。
左导数为 a，右段 x²+1 在 x=1 处的导数为 2。
可导要求左右导数相等，所以 a=2。
代入 a+b=2 得 b=0；两条件同时满足时 f 在 1 处可导。
pitfalls: 只令左右导数相等而不检查连续
把右导数算成 1
左极限漏掉 b
solution.verification: 代入后左段为 2x，右段为 x²+1；在 x=1 处函数值均为 2，左右导数均为 2。
solution.takeaway: 分段点可导必须同时满足函数值接上和斜率接上。
solution.extension: 若只要求在 x=1 连续，则参数只需满足 a+b=2，并不唯一。

en.title: Determining Two Parameters in a Piecewise Function
en.prompt: Let f(x)={ax+b for x<1; x²+1 for x≥1}. For f to be differentiable at x=1, a=________ and b=________.

solution.analysis: First connect the two function values by continuity, then equate the left and right derivatives. These two independent conditions determine a and b.
steps: The right-hand piece gives f(1)=1²+1=2.
The left-hand limit is a+b, so continuity requires a+b=2.
The left derivative is a, while the derivative of x²+1 at x=1 is 2.
Differentiability requires equal one-sided derivatives, hence a=2.
Substituting into a+b=2 gives b=0; both conditions then hold.
pitfalls: Equating derivatives without first checking continuity
Computing the right derivative as 1
Omitting b from the left limit
solution.verification: After substitution, the pieces are 2x and x²+1; both have value 2 and derivative 2 at x=1.
solution.takeaway: At a joining point, differentiability requires both matching values and matching slopes.
solution.extension: If only continuity at x=1 is required, the single condition a+b=2 leaves infinitely many choices.

zh.title: 指数余弦乘积的二、三阶导数
zh.prompt: 设 y=e²ˣcos x，求 y″ 与 y‴。

solution.analysis: 每次求导后仍保持 e²ˣ 与正弦、余弦线性组合相乘的形式，宜先保留该结构再整理系数。
steps: 先求一阶导数：y′=e²ˣ(2cos x−sin x)。
对 y′ 再用乘积法则，y″=e²ˣ[2(2cos x−sin x)+(−2sin x−cos x)]。
整理得 y″=e²ˣ(3cos x−4sin x)。
再次求导，y‴=e²ˣ[2(3cos x−4sin x)+(−3sin x−4cos x)]。
合并余弦和正弦系数，得 y‴=e²ˣ(2cos x−11sin x)。
pitfalls: 每一阶都漏掉 (e²ˣ)′中的因子 2
正弦求导符号写反
尚未完成乘积求导就合并系数
solution.verification: 在 x=0 处，公式给 y″(0)=3、y‴(0)=2；由逐阶未化简式代入也得到同样数值。
solution.takeaway: 指数与正弦、余弦的乘积连续求导后，函数族保持封闭，只需更新两个系数。
solution.extension: 可用系数对 (A,B)↦(2A+B,−A+2B) 记录 e²ˣ(Acos x+Bsin x) 求导后的变化。

en.title: Second and Third Derivatives of an Exponential-Cosine Product
en.prompt: Let y=e²ˣcos x. Find y″ and y‴.
en.answer: y″=e²ˣ(3cos x−4sin x), and y‴=e²ˣ(2cos x−11sin x).

solution.analysis: After every differentiation, the expression remains e²ˣ times a linear combination of sine and cosine. Preserve this structure and update the coefficients.
steps: First differentiate: y′=e²ˣ(2cos x−sin x).
Apply the product rule again: y″=e²ˣ[2(2cos x−sin x)+(−2sin x−cos x)].
Simplification gives y″=e²ˣ(3cos x−4sin x).
Differentiate once more: y‴=e²ˣ[2(3cos x−4sin x)+(−3sin x−4cos x)].
Combining coefficients gives y‴=e²ˣ(2cos x−11sin x).
pitfalls: Missing the factor 2 from (e²ˣ)′ at each stage
Using the wrong sign for the derivative of sine
Combining coefficients before completing the product rule
solution.verification: At x=0, the formulas give y″(0)=3 and y‴(0)=2; the unsimplified stage-by-stage expressions give the same values.
solution.takeaway: Products of an exponential with a sine-cosine combination stay in the same function family under differentiation.
solution.extension: The coefficient update for e²ˣ(Acos x+Bsin x) can be recorded as (A,B)↦(2A+B,−A+2B).

zh.title: 乘积的 n 阶导数是否只有两项
zh.prompt: 判断并说明理由：对任意 n≥2，若 u、v 有所需阶导数，则 (uv)⁽ⁿ⁾=u⁽ⁿ⁾v+uv⁽ⁿ⁾。
zh.answer: 错误。还存在分配给两个因子的中间导数项。

solution.analysis: 只需检查 n=2 即可。对乘积法则再求一次导数会出现两个相同的 u′v′ 项。
steps: 由一阶乘积法则，(uv)′=u′v+uv′。
再求导得 (uv)″=u″v+u′v′+u′v′+uv″。
因此 (uv)″=u″v+2u′v′+uv″，原公式漏掉中间项。
取 u=v=x²，则 (uv)″=(x⁴)″=12x²。
原命题右边为 2x²+2x²=4x²，不相等，所以命题错误。
pitfalls: 把一阶乘积法则机械推广成首尾两项
二次求导时漏掉重复的 u′v′
未用最小阶数 n=2 快速检验
solution.verification: 当 u 或 v 是常数时中间项会消失，但这只是特殊情形，不能证明一般公式。
solution.takeaway: 乘积的高阶导数要考虑 n 次求导在两个因子之间的所有分配方式。
solution.extension: n 阶完整公式中的系数是二项式系数 C(n,k)。

en.title: Does the nth Derivative of a Product Have Only Two Terms?
en.prompt: True or false, with justification: For every n≥2, if u and v have the needed derivatives, then (uv)⁽ⁿ⁾=u⁽ⁿ⁾v+uv⁽ⁿ⁾.
en.answer: False. There are intermediate terms in which derivatives are distributed between both factors.

solution.analysis: It is enough to inspect n=2. Differentiating the product rule once more produces two identical u′v′ terms.
steps: The first-order product rule is (uv)′=u′v+uv′.
Differentiating again gives (uv)″=u″v+u′v′+u′v′+uv″.
Thus (uv)″=u″v+2u′v′+uv″, so the proposed formula misses a middle term.
Take u=v=x²; then (uv)″=(x⁴)″=12x².
The proposed right side is 2x²+2x²=4x², so the statement is false.
pitfalls: Extending the first-order product rule to only two endpoint terms
Missing the repeated u′v′ term
Failing to test the smallest case n=2
solution.verification: The middle terms vanish when one factor is constant, but that special case does not establish the general formula.
solution.takeaway: A higher derivative of a product must account for every distribution of the n differentiations between the two factors.
solution.extension: In the complete nth-order formula, the coefficients are the binomial coefficients C(n,k).

zh.title: 指数与正弦之和的高阶导数
zh.prompt: 设 y=sin(2x)+e³ˣ，求 y″ 与 y‴。

solution.analysis: 两项可以分别连续求导。每求一次 sin(2x) 都出现因子 2，而 e³ˣ 每次出现因子 3。
steps: 一阶导数为 y′=2cos(2x)+3e³ˣ。
再次求导，(2cos(2x))′=−4sin(2x)，(3e³ˣ)′=9e³ˣ。
因此 y″=−4sin(2x)+9e³ˣ。
对二阶导数再求导：[−4sin(2x)]′=−8cos(2x)，(9e³ˣ)′=27e³ˣ。
故 y‴=−8cos(2x)+27e³ˣ。
pitfalls: 每一阶只乘一次内层系数
cos 求导的负号遗漏
把 3e³ˣ 的导数仍写成 3e³ˣ
solution.verification: 在 x=0 处，y″(0)=9、y‴(0)=−8+27=19；代入逐阶未化简式得到相同结果。
solution.takeaway: 线性组合可逐项求高阶导数，复合函数的内层系数会在每一阶重复出现。
solution.extension: 一般地，[sin(ax)]⁽ⁿ⁾=aⁿsin(ax+nπ/2)，(eᵇˣ)⁽ⁿ⁾=bⁿeᵇˣ。

en.title: Higher Derivatives of an Exponential Plus a Sine
en.prompt: Let y=sin(2x)+e³ˣ. Find y″ and y‴.

solution.analysis: The two terms can be differentiated separately. Each differentiation of sin(2x) contributes a factor 2, while each differentiation of e³ˣ contributes a factor 3.
steps: The first derivative is y′=2cos(2x)+3e³ˣ.
Differentiate again: (2cos(2x))′=−4sin(2x), and (3e³ˣ)′=9e³ˣ.
Hence y″=−4sin(2x)+9e³ˣ.
Differentiate the second derivative: [−4sin(2x)]′=−8cos(2x), and (9e³ˣ)′=27e³ˣ.
Therefore y‴=−8cos(2x)+27e³ˣ.
pitfalls: Multiplying by the inner coefficient only once overall
Dropping the negative sign from differentiating cosine
Leaving the derivative of 3e³ˣ as 3e³ˣ
solution.verification: At x=0, y″(0)=9 and y‴(0)=−8+27=19, matching the unsimplified stage-by-stage expressions.
solution.takeaway: Higher derivatives of a linear combination are taken termwise, and each order repeats the inner chain factor.
solution.extension: In general, [sin(ax)]⁽ⁿ⁾=aⁿsin(ax+nπ/2) and (eᵇˣ)⁽ⁿ⁾=bⁿeᵇˣ.

zh.title: 一次因式倒数的 n 阶导数
zh.prompt: 对任意整数 n≥0，用数学归纳法证明：若 y=1/(x−a)，x≠a，则 y⁽ⁿ⁾=(−1)ⁿn!/(x−a)ⁿ⁺¹。
zh.answer: 公式成立；由 n 阶公式再求一次导数即可得到 n+1 阶公式。

solution.analysis: 先验证 n=0 的起点，再假设 n=k 成立。对假设等式求导，系数 k! 与幂指数 k+1 会合成 (k+1)!。
steps: 当 n=0 时，右边为 (−1)⁰0!/(x−a)=1/(x−a)=y，起点成立。
假设 n=k 时 y⁽ᵏ⁾=(−1)ᵏk!(x−a)⁻ᵏ⁻¹。
整理符号与阶乘得 y⁽ᵏ⁺¹⁾=(−1)ᵏ⁺¹(k+1)!/(x−a)ᵏ⁺²。
这正是把 n 替换为 k+1 后的公式，因此归纳步骤成立。
由数学归纳法，公式对所有 n≥0 成立。
pitfalls: 起点从 n=1 开始却忘记题目包含 n=0
幂指数求导后没有减 1
把 (k+1)k! 未整理为 (k+1)!
solution.verification: 取 n=1、2，公式分别给 −1/(x−a)² 与 2/(x−a)³，和直接求导一致。
solution.takeaway: 高阶导数公式的归纳步骤通常就是对第 n 阶结果再求一次导数。
solution.extension: 将 x−a 换成 bx+c 时，每次求导还会多产生一个因子 b。

en.title: The nth Derivative of the Reciprocal of a Linear Factor
en.prompt: For every integer n≥0, prove by induction that if y=1/(x−a), x≠a, then y⁽ⁿ⁾=(−1)ⁿn!/(x−a)ⁿ⁺¹.
en.answer: The formula holds; differentiating the nth-order formula once produces the formula of order n+1.

solution.analysis: Verify the base case n=0, then assume the result for n=k. Differentiating the assumed identity combines k! with the exponent k+1 to form (k+1)!.
steps: For n=0, the right side is (−1)⁰0!/(x−a)=1/(x−a)=y, so the base case holds.
Assume that y⁽ᵏ⁾=(−1)ᵏk!(x−a)⁻ᵏ⁻¹.
Differentiate this identity: y⁽ᵏ⁺¹⁾=(−1)ᵏk!·[−(k+1)](x−a)⁻ᵏ⁻².
Combining signs and factorials gives y⁽ᵏ⁺¹⁾=(−1)ᵏ⁺¹(k+1)!/(x−a)ᵏ⁺².
This is exactly the claimed formula with n replaced by k+1, so the induction step holds.
Therefore the formula is valid for every n≥0.
pitfalls: Starting at n=1 even though n=0 is included
Failing to decrease the power by one
Not simplifying (k+1)k! to (k+1)!
solution.verification: For n=1 and n=2, the formula gives −1/(x−a)² and 2/(x−a)³, matching direct differentiation.
solution.takeaway: For a higher-derivative formula, the induction step is often just one more differentiation.
solution.extension: If x−a is replaced by bx+c, each differentiation contributes an additional factor b.

zh.title: 指数型隐函数的一阶导数
zh.prompt: 曲线 e^{xy}+x+y=1 通过点 (0,0)。求一般的 y′，并求该点的切线斜率。

solution.analysis: 最内层 xy 的导数为 y+xy′；外层指数函数保持 e^{xy} 因子。随后收集 y′。
steps: 对 e^{xy} 求导，得到 e^{xy}(y+xy′)。
对 x+y 求导，得到 1+y′；右侧常数 1 的导数为 0。
收集 y′ 得 (x e^{xy}+1)y′=−(y e^{xy}+1)。
pitfalls: 把 d(e^{xy})/dx 写成 e^{xy}xy′
漏掉 xy 中 x 的导数贡献 y
代入 e^0 时写成 0
solution.takeaway: 隐式复合函数要由外向内使用链式法则，内层若为乘积还需继续求导。
solution.extension: 切线方程为 y=−x；若求法线，其斜率为 1。

en.title: First Derivative of an Exponential Implicit Curve
en.prompt: The curve e^{xy}+x+y=1 passes through (0,0). Find the general expression for y′ and the tangent slope at that point.

solution.analysis: The derivative of the inner product xy is y+xy′, and the outer exponential contributes e^{xy}. Then collect y′.
steps: Differentiate e^{xy} to obtain e^{xy}(y+xy′).
Differentiate x+y to obtain 1+y′; the derivative of the constant 1 is 0.
Thus e^{xy}(y+xy′)+1+y′=0.
Collecting y′ gives (x e^{xy}+1)y′=−(y e^{xy}+1).
Therefore y′=−[y e^{xy}+1]/[x e^{xy}+1], and at (0,0) it equals −1.
pitfalls: Writing d(e^{xy})/dx as e^{xy}xy′
Omitting the y term from d(xy)/dx
Treating e^0 as 0
solution.verification: (0,0) satisfies e^0+0+0=1. Substituting y′=−1 into the differentiated relation gives 0+1−1=0.
solution.takeaway: For an implicit composite, apply the chain rule from outside inward and differentiate any inner product completely.
solution.extension: The tangent is y=−x, while the normal slope is 1.

zh.title: 三角型隐函数求导
zh.prompt: 曲线 sin(x+y)=xy 通过 (0,0)。求一般的 y′，并写出该点的切线方程。
zh.answer: y′=[y−cos(x+y)]/[cos(x+y)−x]；在 (0,0) 处 y′=−1，切线为 y=−x。

solution.analysis: 等式两侧都含 y(x)。左侧先求外层正弦，右侧对 xy 用乘积法则。
steps: 对左侧求导，得到 cos(x+y)(1+y′)。
对右侧 xy 求导，得到 y+xy′。
展开并整理：cos(x+y)+cos(x+y)y′=y+xy′。
收集 y′ 得 [cos(x+y)−x]y′=y−cos(x+y)。
所以 y′=[y−cos(x+y)]/[cos(x+y)−x]；代入 (0,0) 得 y′=−1，切线为 y=−x。
pitfalls: 把 d[sin(x+y)]/dx 写成 cos(x+y)
把 d(xy)/dx 写成 xy′
整理分母时把 cos(x+y)−x 写反
solution.verification: (0,0) 满足 sin0=0；导数关系在该点变为 1·(1+y′)=0，直接给出 y′=−1。
solution.takeaway: 隐式等式两侧都要完整求导，不能把任何含 y 的部分当常数。
solution.extension: 若 cos(x+y)−x=0，显式分式失效，应检查竖直切线或局部表示。

en.title: Differentiating a Trigonometric Implicit Curve
en.prompt: The curve sin(x+y)=xy passes through (0,0). Find the general expression for y′ and the tangent line at that point.
en.answer: y′=[y−cos(x+y)]/[cos(x+y)−x]; at (0,0), y′=−1 and the tangent is y=−x.

solution.analysis: Both sides contain y(x). Differentiate the outer sine on the left and use the product rule on xy.
steps: Differentiate the left side to obtain cos(x+y)(1+y′).
Differentiate xy to obtain y+xy′.
Expand: cos(x+y)+cos(x+y)y′=y+xy′.
Collect y′ to get [cos(x+y)−x]y′=y−cos(x+y).
Hence y′=[y−cos(x+y)]/[cos(x+y)−x]; at (0,0), y′=−1 and the tangent is y=−x.
pitfalls: Omitting the factor 1+y′
Writing d(xy)/dx as xy′
Reversing the sign of cos(x+y)−x
solution.verification: (0,0) satisfies sin0=0, and the differentiated equation there is 1·(1+y′)=0, so y′=−1.
solution.takeaway: Differentiate every y-containing expression on both sides; none of it is constant with respect to x.
solution.extension: If cos(x+y)−x=0, the explicit fraction fails and local vertical behavior must be checked.

zh.title: 参数曲线的一阶导数与切线
zh.prompt: 参数曲线 x=t²+1，y=t³−t。在 t=1 时求 dy/dx，并写出切线方程。

solution.analysis: 先分别求 dx/dt 与 dy/dt，再在 dx/dt≠0 时相除。切线还需要先算出 t=1 对应的坐标。
steps: dx/dt=2t，dy/dt=3t²−1。
当 t=1 时，dx/dt=2≠0，dy/dt=2。
因此 dy/dx=(dy/dt)/(dx/dt)=2/2=1。
点斜式给出 y−0=1(x−2)，即 y=x−2。
pitfalls: 把 dy/dx 写成 dx/dt 除以 dy/dt
只求斜率而漏算参数点
未检查 dx/dt 是否为 0
solution.verification: 在 t=1 附近取小增量，dx≈2dt、dy≈2dt，因此 Δy/Δx≈1，与导数一致。
solution.takeaway: 参数曲线的斜率是两个参数变化率之比，前提是 dx/dt≠0。
solution.extension: 在 t=0 时 dx/dt=0、dy/dt=−1，曲线具有竖直切线。

en.title: First Derivative and Tangent of a Parametric Curve
en.prompt: For x=t²+1 and y=t³−t, find dy/dx at t=1 and write the tangent line.
en.answer: dy/dx=1; the point is (2,0), and the tangent is y=x−2.

knowledge: First derivative of a parametric curve
solution.analysis: Differentiate x and y with respect to t, then divide when dx/dt≠0. The tangent line also requires the point corresponding to t=1.
steps: dx/dt=2t and dy/dt=3t²−1.
At t=1, dx/dt=2≠0 and dy/dt=2.
Thus dy/dx=(dy/dt)/(dx/dt)=2/2=1.
The parameter point is x=1²+1=2 and y=1³−1=0.
Point-slope form gives y−0=1(x−2), or y=x−2.
pitfalls: Reversing the ratio for dy/dx
Finding the slope but not the parameter point
