Failing to check dx/dt≠0
solution.verification: Near t=1, dx≈2dt and dy≈2dt, so Δy/Δx≈1.
solution.takeaway: A parametric slope is the ratio of the two rates with respect to the parameter, provided dx/dt is nonzero.
solution.extension: At t=0, dx/dt=0 and dy/dt=−1, so the curve has a vertical tangent.

zh.title: 参数导数公式与数值
zh.prompt: 若 x=t²，y=t⁴+t，则在 dx/dt≠0 时 dy/dx=____；在 t=1 时其值为____。

solution.analysis: 先填写通式，再分别求两个参数导数。t=1 时 dx/dt 非零，可合法相除。
steps: 参数曲线的一阶导数公式为 dy/dx=(dy/dt)/(dx/dt)。
这里 dx/dt=2t。
dy/dt=4t³+1。
在 t=1 时，dx/dt=2，dy/dt=5。
所以 dy/dx=5/2，两空依次为 (dy/dt)/(dx/dt) 与 5/2。
pitfalls: 把公式写成两导数相乘
把 d(t⁴)/dt 写成 4t
忽略 t=0 时分母为 0
solution.verification: 在 t=1 处，x 的瞬时变化率为 2，y 的瞬时变化率为 5，故每单位 x 变化对应 5/2 单位 y 变化。
solution.takeaway: 参数导数是相对于同一参数的两个变化率之比。
solution.extension: 在 t=0 时该比值公式分母为 0，需另行判断切线方向。

en.title: The Parametric Derivative Formula and Its Value
en.prompt: If x=t² and y=t⁴+t, then when dx/dt≠0, dy/dx=____; at t=1 its value is ____.

solution.analysis: State the general formula first, then differentiate x and y separately. At t=1, dx/dt is nonzero, so division is valid.
steps: The first parametric derivative is dy/dx=(dy/dt)/(dx/dt).
Here dx/dt=2t.
Also dy/dt=4t³+1.
At t=1, dx/dt=2 and dy/dt=5.
Thus dy/dx=5/2, so the blanks are (dy/dt)/(dx/dt) and 5/2.
pitfalls: Multiplying the two derivatives
Differentiating t⁴ as 4t
Ignoring the zero denominator at t=0
solution.verification: At t=1, x changes at rate 2 and y at rate 5, so the y-change per unit x-change is 5/2.
solution.takeaway: A parametric derivative is the ratio of two rates measured with respect to the same parameter.
solution.extension: At t=0 the denominator vanishes, so the tangent direction must be analyzed separately.

zh.title: 参数曲线的竖直切线条件
zh.prompt: 设参数曲线在 t=t₀ 处的导数存在。下列哪组条件最直接表明该点具有竖直切线？
choices: D. dx/dt=0 且 dy/dt=0，且无需进一步分析

solution.analysis: 参数速度向量为 (dx/dt,dy/dt)。其水平分量为 0 而竖直分量非零时，切线方向竖直。
steps: 参数曲线的瞬时方向由向量 (dx/dt,dy/dt) 给出。
若 dx/dt=0、dy/dt≠0，该向量平行于 y 轴，因此切线竖直。
B 对应水平切线，因为方向向量平行于 x 轴。
C 给出有限斜率 (dy/dt)/(dx/dt)=1。
D 中速度向量为零向量，不能仅凭一阶导数判断切线，故答案为 A。
pitfalls: 把水平与竖直切线条件颠倒
认为 0/0 自动表示竖直切线
忽略 dy/dt≠0 的条件
solution.verification: 对 x=t²、y=t，在 t=0 时 dx/dt=0、dy/dt=1，消去参数得 x=y²，原点处切线确为 x=0。
solution.takeaway: 参数曲线的切线方向先看速度向量，不应机械把 0 当作普通分母。
solution.extension: 若 dx/dt=dy/dt=0，通常需研究更低阶非零变化项，本题不给出自动结论。

en.title: Condition for a Vertical Tangent of a Parametric Curve
en.prompt: Suppose the parameter derivatives exist at t=t₀. Which condition most directly indicates a vertical tangent?
choices: D. dx/dt=0 and dy/dt=0, with no further analysis needed

knowledge: Tangent direction of a parametric curve
solution.analysis: The velocity vector is (dx/dt,dy/dt). A zero horizontal component and nonzero vertical component give a vertical direction.
steps: The instantaneous direction of a parametric curve is determined by (dx/dt,dy/dt).
If dx/dt=0 and dy/dt≠0, this vector is parallel to the y-axis, so the tangent is vertical.
Condition B gives a horizontal tangent.
Condition C gives the finite slope (dy/dt)/(dx/dt)=1.
In D the velocity vector is zero, so first derivatives alone are inconclusive; therefore A is correct.
pitfalls: Reversing horizontal and vertical conditions
Assuming 0/0 automatically means vertical
Omitting the condition dy/dt≠0
solution.verification: For x=t²,y=t at t=0, dx/dt=0 and dy/dt=1. Eliminating t gives x=y², whose tangent at the origin is x=0.
solution.takeaway: Read a parametric tangent from the velocity vector rather than treating zero as an ordinary denominator.
solution.extension: If both parameter derivatives vanish, lower-order nonzero changes must be studied; no automatic conclusion is available.

zh.title: 膨胀球体的体积变化率
zh.prompt: 一个球形气球的半径以 2 cm/s 的速率增加。当半径为 5 cm 时，球体积增加多快？

solution.analysis: 半径 r=r(t)，体积 V=(4/3)πr³。先对 t 求导，再代入 r 与 dr/dt。
steps: 设 r 的单位为 cm、t 的单位为 s，已知 dr/dt=2 cm/s。
球体积满足 V=(4/3)πr³。
对 t 求导，dV/dt=4πr²·dr/dt。
代入 r=5 与 dr/dt=2，得到 dV/dt=4π·25·2。
所以 dV/dt=200π cm³/s，正号表示体积增加。
pitfalls: 把 dV/dt 写成 4πr² 而漏掉 dr/dt
把半径 5 当作直径
体积率单位写成 cm/s
solution.verification: 量纲为 cm²·cm/s=cm³/s；所有因子为正，结果与气球膨胀相符。
solution.takeaway: 几何公式对时间求导时，每个随时间变化的长度都要带上相应时间导数。
solution.extension: 若半径以同样速率减小，则 dr/dt=−2 cm/s，体积率为 −200π cm³/s。

en.title: Volume Rate of an Expanding Sphere
en.prompt: The radius of a spherical balloon increases at 2 cm/s. How fast is its volume increasing when the radius is 5 cm?

solution.analysis: Let r=r(t) and V=(4/3)πr³. Differentiate with respect to t before inserting r and dr/dt.
steps: Use cm for r and s for t; the given rate is dr/dt=2 cm/s.
The sphere volume is V=(4/3)πr³.
Differentiate in time: dV/dt=4πr²·dr/dt.
Substitute r=5 and dr/dt=2 to obtain dV/dt=4π·25·2.
Thus dV/dt=200π cm³/s; the positive sign indicates increasing volume.
pitfalls: Omitting dr/dt
Treating 5 as the diameter
Using cm/s for a volume rate
solution.verification: The dimension is cm²·cm/s=cm³/s, and the positive sign agrees with expansion.
solution.takeaway: When differentiating a geometric formula in time, attach the appropriate time derivative to every changing length.
solution.extension: If the radius decreases at the same speed, dr/dt=−2 cm/s and dV/dt=−200π cm³/s.

zh.title: 一元函数可微与可导
zh.prompt: 判断并说明理由：对一元函数 y=f(x)，在一点可微与在该点可导是等价的，而且微分系数就是 f′(x)。
zh.answer: 正确。一元函数可微意味着 Δy=AΔx+o(Δx)，除以 Δx 后导数存在且等于 A；反之可导立即给出同一分解。

solution.analysis: 等价性的桥梁是增量分解 Δy=AΔx+o(Δx)。除以 Δx 可得到差商极限。
steps: 若 f 在点 x 可微，则存在常数 A，使 Δy=AΔx+o(Δx)。
当 Δx≠0 时除以 Δx，得到 Δy/Δx=A+o(Δx)/Δx。
令 Δx→0，第二项趋于 0，所以导数存在且 f′(x)=A。
反之，若 f′(x) 存在，则 Δy/Δx−f′(x)→0。
令余项 α(Δx)=Δy−f′(x)Δx，可得 α(Δx)/Δx→0，因此 Δy=f′(x)Δx+o(Δx)，即 f 可微。
所以命题正确，微分为 dy=f′(x)dx。
pitfalls: 把多元函数的情形无条件套到一元函数
只说教材结论而不给增量分解
把可微误解为函数值很小
solution.verification: 两方向都由同一差商极限严格推出，且常数 A 被唯一确定为 f′(x)。
solution.takeaway: 对一元函数，可导与可微等价；微分系数没有新数值，就是该点导数。
solution.extension: 虽然可微与可导等价，但函数连续只是不足以推出可导，例如 |x| 在 0 连续却不可导。

en.title: Differentiability and Existence of a Derivative in One Variable
en.prompt: True or false, with justification: For a one-variable function y=f(x), differentiability at a point is equivalent to existence of the derivative there, and the differential coefficient is f′(x).
en.answer: True. Differentiability means Δy=AΔx+o(Δx); division by Δx yields a derivative equal to A, and conversely a derivative gives the same decomposition.

solution.analysis: The bridge is the increment decomposition Δy=AΔx+o(Δx). Dividing by Δx produces the difference-quotient limit.
steps: If f is differentiable at x, there is a constant A with Δy=AΔx+o(Δx).
For Δx≠0, divide by Δx: Δy/Δx=A+o(Δx)/Δx.
As Δx→0, the second term tends to 0, so f′(x) exists and equals A.
Conversely, if f′(x) exists, then Δy/Δx−f′(x)→0.
Let α(Δx)=Δy−f′(x)Δx. Then α(Δx)/Δx→0, so Δy=f′(x)Δx+o(Δx).
Thus the statement is true and dy=f′(x)dx.
pitfalls: Transferring multivariable subtleties to the one-variable case
Citing the result without the increment decomposition
Interpreting differentiable as numerically small
solution.verification: Both directions follow from the same difference-quotient limit, and A is uniquely determined as f′(x).
solution.takeaway: For one variable, existence of a derivative and differentiability are equivalent; the differential coefficient is the derivative.
solution.extension: Continuity alone is insufficient: |x| is continuous at 0 but not differentiable there.

zh.title: 对数复合函数的微分
zh.prompt: 设 y=ln(1+x²)。求 dy，并计算 x=1、dx=0.02 时的 dy。

solution.analysis: 先用链式法则求导，再乘 dx。基点 x=1 时微分系数恰为 1。
steps: 令 u=1+x²，则 y=ln u。
dy=(1/u)du，且 du=2x dx。
所以 dy=[2x/(1+x²)]dx。
pitfalls: 把 d ln u 写成 ln u·du
链式法则漏掉 2x
用 x+dx 代替基点 x 计算系数
solution.takeaway: 复合函数的微分可按形式不变性逐层计算：dy=(1/u)du。
solution.extension: 若 dx=−0.02，则 dy=−0.02，表示局部对数值减小。

en.title: Differential of a Logarithmic Composite
en.prompt: Let y=ln(1+x²). Find dy, and evaluate it at x=1 with dx=0.02.
en.answer: dy=[2x/(1+x²)]dx; at x=1 and dx=0.02, dy=0.02.

solution.analysis: Apply the chain rule and then multiply by dx. At x=1, the differential coefficient equals 1.
steps: Let u=1+x², so y=ln u.
Then dy=(1/u)du and du=2x dx.
Therefore dy=[2x/(1+x²)]dx.
At x=1, the coefficient is 2/(1+1)=1.
pitfalls: Writing d ln u as ln u·du
Omitting the factor 2x
Evaluating the coefficient at x+dx instead of the base point
solution.verification: The exact increment ln(1+1.02²)−ln2≈0.019998, close to dy=0.02.
solution.takeaway: The form-invariance of differentials lets us work layer by layer: dy=(1/u)du.
solution.extension: If dx=−0.02, then dy=−0.02, indicating a local decrease.

zh.title: 用微分近似平方根
zh.prompt: 只用微分线性化，在 x₀=4 附近近似计算 √4.04。

solution.analysis: 选择容易计算的基点 4，令 Δx=0.04。用 f(x₀+Δx)≈f(x₀)+f′(x₀)Δx。
pitfalls: 把基点选成 4.04 导致失去简化意义
用等号声称近似值精确
solution.verification: 2.01²=4.0401，与 4.04 只差 0.0001，说明近似合理，但这不是由本题方法给出的严格误差界。
solution.takeaway: 线性近似优先选择函数值与导数都易算、且接近目标的基点。
solution.extension: 同法可用 x₀=9 近似 √9.06。

en.title: Approximating a Square Root with Differentials
en.prompt: Using only differential linearization near x₀=4, approximate √4.04.

solution.analysis: Choose the convenient base point 4 and use Δx=0.04 in f(x₀+Δx)≈f(x₀)+f′(x₀)Δx.
steps: Let f(x)=√x, choose x₀=4, and set Δx=4.04−4=0.04.
At the base point, f′(4)=1/4.
The differential is dy=f′(4)Δx=(1/4)(0.04)=0.01.
pitfalls: Choosing 4.04 as the base point
Using f′(4)=1/2
Using an equality sign for an approximation
solution.verification: 2.01²=4.0401, only 0.0001 from 4.04. This supports the approximation but is not a rigorous error bound from linearization alone.
solution.takeaway: Choose a nearby base point where both the function and derivative are easy to evaluate.
solution.extension: The same method can approximate √9.06 from x₀=9.

zh.title: 微分估计的正确陈述
zh.prompt: 设 y=f(x) 在 x 处可微且 y≠0。下列说法哪些正确？多选。
choices: B. dy 关于 dx 是线性的
C. 对任意有限 dx 都有 Δy=dy
D. dy/y 可作为相对增量 Δy/y 的一阶估计

solution.analysis: 可微只保证在小增量下，非线性余项相对于 Δx 可忽略；它不把所有有限增量都变成精确线性。
steps: A 正确，这是可微定义 Δy=f′(x)Δx+o(Δx) 与 dy=f′(x)dx 的直接结果。
B 正确：在基点固定时，dy=f′(x)dx 对 dx 是线性函数。
C 错误：非线性函数通常有非零余项，例如 x² 的增量多出 (Δx)²。
D 正确：当 y≠0 时，Δy/y≈dy/y，后者是相对变化的一阶估计。
因此选择 A、B、D。
pitfalls: 把一阶近似当作恒等式
忽略相对微分要求 y≠0
把 o(Δx) 误认为固定常数
solution.verification: 对 y=x²，Δy=2xΔx+(Δx)²、dy=2xΔx；这同时验证 A、B 并反驳 C。
solution.takeaway: 微分保留一阶线性信息；相对微分则把这一信息按当前函数值归一化。
solution.extension: 若 f 本身是线性函数，则 C 也成立，因为余项恒为 0。

en.title: Correct Statements about Differential Estimates
en.prompt: Let y=f(x) be differentiable at x with y≠0. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.
choices: B. dy is linear in dx
C. Δy=dy for every finite dx
D. dy/y is a first-order estimate of the relative increment Δy/y

solution.analysis: Differentiability says that the nonlinear remainder is negligible relative to a small Δx; it does not make every finite increment exactly linear.
steps: A is true from Δy=f′(x)Δx+o(Δx) and dy=f′(x)dx.
B is true because, at a fixed base point, dy=f′(x)dx is linear in dx.
C is false for nonlinear functions; for x² an extra term (Δx)² remains.
D is true because, when y≠0, Δy/y≈dy/y gives a first-order relative-change estimate.
Therefore A, B, and D are correct.
pitfalls: Treating a first-order approximation as an identity
Ignoring y≠0 for a relative differential
Treating o(Δx) as a fixed constant
solution.verification: For y=x², Δy=2xΔx+(Δx)² and dy=2xΔx; this confirms A and B while disproving C.
solution.takeaway: The differential retains first-order linear information; the relative differential normalizes it by the current function value.
solution.extension: If f is linear, then C also holds because the remainder is identically zero.

zh.title: 振荡函数在原点的可导性
zh.prompt: 设 f(x)={x²sin(1/x), x≠0; 0, x=0}。判断 f 在 0 处是否可导，并求完整的导函数 f′(x)。
zh.answer: f 在 0 处可导，f′(0)=0；x≠0 时 f′(x)=2x sin(1/x)-cos(1/x)

solution.analysis: 原点不能直接套用 x≠0 的公式，必须从定义出发；非零点再用乘积法则与链式法则。
steps: 原点差商为 [f(h)-f(0)]/h=h sin(1/h)，其中 h≠0。
因为 |h sin(1/h)|≤|h|→0，所以差商极限存在，f′(0)=0。
当 x≠0 时，对 x²sin(1/x) 使用乘积法则：第一项为 2x sin(1/x)。
链式求第二项：x²·cos(1/x)·(-1/x²)=-cos(1/x)，故 f′(x)=2x sin(1/x)-cos(1/x)。
pitfalls: 把 x≠0 的求导式直接代入 x=0
认为 sin(1/h) 无极限就断言乘积无极限
链式求导遗漏 -1/x²
solution.verification: 原点差商的绝对值被 |h| 控制，严格趋于 0；非零点公式中两项分别对应乘积法则的两部分。
solution.takeaway: 特殊点先用定义；振荡因子即使无极限，乘上足够小的因子仍可能产生导数。
solution.extension: 继续考察 x→0 时 f′(x) 是否趋于 f′(0)，可以区分“可导”与“导函数连续”。

en.title: Differentiability of an Oscillatory Function at the Origin
en.prompt: Let f(x)={x²sin(1/x), x≠0; 0, x=0}. Decide whether f is differentiable at 0, and find the complete derivative f′(x).
en.answer: f is differentiable at 0 with f′(0)=0; for x≠0, f′(x)=2x sin(1/x)-cos(1/x)

knowledge: using the definition at a special point
solution.analysis: The formula for x≠0 cannot simply be used at the origin; first principles are required there. At nonzero points, use the product and chain rules.
steps: At the origin the difference quotient is [f(h)-f(0)]/h=h sin(1/h) for h≠0.
Since |h sin(1/h)|≤|h|→0, the quotient has a limit and f′(0)=0.
For x≠0, applying the product rule to x²sin(1/x) gives the first term 2x sin(1/x).
The chain-rule contribution is x²·cos(1/x)·(-1/x²)=-cos(1/x), so f′(x)=2x sin(1/x)-cos(1/x).
pitfalls: substituting x=0 into the derivative formula for x≠0
declaring no limit merely because sin(1/h) oscillates
omitting -1/x² in the chain rule
solution.verification: The absolute value of the origin quotient is bounded by |h|, which rigorously tends to 0; the two nonzero-point terms correspond exactly to the two product-rule contributions.
solution.takeaway: Use the definition at exceptional points; an oscillatory factor without a limit may still yield a derivative when multiplied by a sufficiently small factor.
solution.extension: Examining whether f′(x) tends to f′(0) as x→0 distinguishes differentiability from continuity of the derivative.

zh.title: 偶函数在原点可导时的斜率
zh.prompt: 设 f 是偶函数，且 f 在 x=0 处可导。证明 f′(0)=0。
zh.answer: 利用 f(-h)=f(h) 比较左右差商，可得 f′(0)=-f′(0)，故 f′(0)=0。

knowledge: 导数存在时左右极限相等
solution.analysis: 偶性使左侧函数增量与右侧函数增量相同，但分母符号相反，因此两个单侧导数互为相反数；可导又要求它们相等。
pitfalls: 只用偶性就断言导数一定存在
变量替换 h=-t 后漏掉分母负号
没有使用可导带来的左右相等
solution.verification: 例如 f(x)=x²、cos x 都是偶函数并在 0 可导，它们在 0 的导数确实为 0；而 |x| 提醒我们可导假设不可省略。
solution.takeaway: 对称性控制单侧斜率的关系；偶函数的左右斜率互为相反数，可导时只能共同为 0。
solution.extension: 若 f 是奇函数且在 0 可导，f′(0) 不必为 0，例如 f(x)=x。

en.title: Slope of an Even Function at the Origin
en.prompt: Suppose f is even and differentiable at x=0. Prove that f′(0)=0.
en.answer: Using f(-h)=f(h) to compare the one-sided quotients gives f′(0)=-f′(0), hence f′(0)=0.

knowledge: equality of one-sided limits when the derivative exists
solution.analysis: Evenness makes the left and right function increments equal, while their denominators have opposite signs. Thus the one-sided derivatives are opposites; differentiability also requires them to be equal.
steps: The right derivative is f′₊(0)=lim_{h→0⁺}[f(h)-f(0)]/h.
In the left derivative set h=-t with t→0⁺: f′₋(0)=lim_{t→0⁺}[f(-t)-f(0)]/(-t).
Evenness gives f(-t)=f(t), so f′₋(0)=-lim_{t→0⁺}[f(t)-f(0)]/t=-f′₊(0).
Since f is differentiable at 0, f′₋(0)=f′₊(0)=f′(0). Therefore f′(0)=-f′(0), and f′(0)=0.
pitfalls: claiming existence of the derivative from evenness alone
losing the minus sign after substituting h=-t
not using equality of the one-sided derivatives
solution.verification: The even functions f(x)=x² and cos x both have derivative 0 at the origin, while |x| shows why the differentiability assumption cannot be removed.
solution.takeaway: Symmetry controls one-sided slopes: an even function has opposite one-sided slopes at 0, so differentiability forces both to be 0.
solution.extension: For an odd function differentiable at 0, the derivative need not be 0; f(x)=x is an example.

zh.title: 识别不对称割线的极限
zh.prompt: 已知 f 在 x₀ 处可导。下列极限中，哪一个必等于 f′(x₀)？

solution.analysis: 在不对称的两个函数值之间加减 f(x₀)，把一个差商拆成两个标准导数差商，并跟踪各自的系数。
steps: 对 A 的分子加减 f(x₀)：f(x₀+2h)-f(x₀-h)=[f(x₀+2h)-f(x₀)]+[f(x₀)-f(x₀-h)]。
除以 3h 后，第一项可写成 (2/3)·[f(x₀+2h)-f(x₀)]/(2h)，其极限为 (2/3)f′(x₀)。
两项相加为 f′(x₀)，故 A 正确；同理 B、C、D 的极限系数分别为 3/2、2、2，一般不等于 f′(x₀)。
pitfalls: 看到 h→0 就忽略分母系数
第二项改写时丢失两个负号
把 x₀+2h 的增量误认为 h
solution.verification: 取 f(x)=x，四个极限依次为 1、3/2、2、2，而 f′(x₀)=1，只有 A 符合。
solution.takeaway: 变形差商的关键是以 f(x₀) 为中介拆分，并让每个分母与其真实增量匹配。
solution.extension: 若分子为 f(x₀+ah)-f(x₀-bh)，分母取 (a+b)h（a,b>0），极限同样为 f′(x₀)。

en.title: Recognizing the Limit of an Asymmetric Secant
en.prompt: Suppose f is differentiable at x₀. Which limit must equal f′(x₀)?

knowledge: adding and subtracting a common base value
solution.analysis: Insert and subtract f(x₀) between the two asymmetric function values. This splits the expression into standard derivative quotients whose coefficients must be tracked.
steps: For A, insert f(x₀): f(x₀+2h)-f(x₀-h)=[f(x₀+2h)-f(x₀)]+[f(x₀)-f(x₀-h)].
After division by 3h, the first term is (2/3)·[f(x₀+2h)-f(x₀)]/(2h), whose limit is (2/3)f′(x₀).
The second term is (1/3)·[f(x₀)-f(x₀-h)]/h=(1/3)·[f(x₀-h)-f(x₀)]/(-h), whose limit is (1/3)f′(x₀).
Their sum is f′(x₀), so A is correct. The corresponding coefficients for B, C, and D are 3/2, 2, and 2, respectively.
pitfalls: ignoring denominator coefficients merely because h→0
losing the two minus signs in the second term
treating 2h as though the increment were h
solution.verification: For f(x)=x, the four limits are 1,3/2,2,2, while f′(x₀)=1; only A works.
solution.takeaway: For a modified quotient, split at f(x₀) and match every denominator to its actual input increment.
solution.extension: For a,b>0, [f(x₀+ah)-f(x₀-bh)]/[(a+b)h] also tends to f′(x₀).

zh.title: 移动尖点与参数分类
zh.prompt: 设 f_{a,b}(x)=|x-a|+bx，其中 a,b∈R。确定所有使 f_{a,b} 在 x=0 处可导的参数对 (a,b)，并求相应的 f′_{a,b}(0)。
zh.answer: 当且仅当 a≠0 时可导；此时 f′_{a,b}(0)=b-sgn(a)，其中 sgn(a)=1（a>0），sgn(a)=-1（a<0）

solution.analysis: 关键不是 b，而是绝对值尖点 x=a 是否恰好落在考察点 0。a≠0 时，0 的小邻域只落在绝对值的一侧；a=0 时线性项无法消除左右斜率之差 2。
steps: 若 a>0，取 0 的充分小邻域使 x-a<0，则 |x-a|=a-x，故 f_{a,b}(x)=a+(b-1)x，f′_{a,b}(0)=b-1。
若 a<0，取 0 的充分小邻域使 x-a>0，则 |x-a|=x-a，故 f_{a,b}(x)=-a+(b+1)x，f′_{a,b}(0)=b+1。
上述两种情形都可写成 f′_{a,b}(0)=b-sgn(a)，且任意 b 均允许。
若 a=0，则差商为 [|h|+bh]/h；左极限为 b-1，右极限为 b+1，二者相差 2，不可能相等。
因此可导的充要条件是 a≠0，b 不受限制；导数如上。
pitfalls: 认为选择某个 b 可以抹平 |x| 的尖角
a<0 时把 |x-a| 的局部形式写反
只给充分条件而未排除 a=0
solution.verification: 取 a=2 时导数为 b-1；取 a=-2 时导数为 b+1；当 a=0 时无论 b 取何值，左右导数之差恒为 2。
solution.takeaway: 绝对值函数是否影响某点可导，取决于尖点是否位于该点；普通线性项只会同时平移两侧斜率。
solution.extension: 把考察点改为 x=c，则可导的充要条件变为 a≠c。

en.title: A Moving Corner and Parameter Classification
en.prompt: Let f_{a,b}(x)=|x-a|+bx, where a,b∈R. Determine all pairs (a,b) for which f_{a,b} is differentiable at x=0, and find f′_{a,b}(0).
en.answer: Differentiable exactly when a≠0; then f′_{a,b}(0)=b-sgn(a), where sgn(a)=1 for a>0 and sgn(a)=-1 for a<0

solution.analysis: The decisive issue is not b but whether the corner x=a coincides with the test point 0. If a≠0, a small neighborhood of 0 stays on one side of the corner. If a=0, a linear term cannot remove the slope jump of 2.
steps: If a>0, choose a sufficiently small neighborhood of 0 where x-a<0. Then |x-a|=a-x, so f_{a,b}(x)=a+(b-1)x and f′_{a,b}(0)=b-1.
If a<0, choose a sufficiently small neighborhood where x-a>0. Then |x-a|=x-a, so f_{a,b}(x)=-a+(b+1)x and f′_{a,b}(0)=b+1.
Both cases can be written as f′_{a,b}(0)=b-sgn(a), and every b is allowed.
If a=0, the quotient is [|h|+bh]/h. Its left limit is b-1 and its right limit is b+1, which always differ by 2.
Therefore a≠0 is necessary and sufficient, with b unrestricted and the derivative as stated.
pitfalls: thinking that a suitable b can smooth the corner of |x|
using the wrong local expression for |x-a| when a<0
giving only a sufficient condition without excluding a=0
solution.verification: For a=2 the derivative is b-1; for a=-2 it is b+1. When a=0, the one-sided derivatives differ by 2 for every b.
solution.takeaway: An absolute value affects differentiability at a point only when its corner lies there; adding a linear term shifts both one-sided slopes equally.
solution.extension: If the test point is changed to x=c, differentiability holds exactly when a≠c.

zh.title: 在对应点求反函数导数
zh.prompt: 设 f(x)=x³+x，且 g=f⁻¹。已知 g 在 y=2 处可导，求 g′(2)。

solution.analysis: 先寻找满足 f(x₀)=2 的原函数点 x₀，再在该点求 f′，最后取倒数。
steps: 解对应关系 f(x₀)=2，即 x₀³+x₀=2；代入 x₀=1 得 1+1=2，所以 g(2)=1。
原函数导数为 f′(x)=3x²+1。
pitfalls: 直接把 y=2 代入 f′(x)
把反函数 f⁻¹ 误解为倒数 1/f
忘记先确认对应的 x₀
solution.verification: 局部增量满足 Δy≈4Δx，因此反向看 Δx≈(1/4)Δy，与 g′(2)=1/4 一致。
solution.takeaway: 反函数导数要在一对对应点上取倒数：先由 y₀ 找 x₀=g(y₀)，再计算 1/f′(x₀)。
solution.extension: 若要求 g′(0)，对应点为 x₀=0，结果为 g′(0)=1。

en.title: Derivative of an Inverse at a Corresponding Point
en.prompt: Let f(x)=x³+x and g=f⁻¹. Given that g is differentiable at y=2, find g′(2).

solution.analysis: First find x₀ satisfying f(x₀)=2, then evaluate f′ at that point and take the reciprocal.
steps: Solve f(x₀)=2, or x₀³+x₀=2. Since 1+1=2, x₀=1 and g(2)=1.
The derivative of the original function is f′(x)=3x²+1.
At the corresponding point x₀=1, f′(1)=3+1=4≠0.
The inverse-function formula gives g′(2)=1/f′(g(2))=1/f′(1)=1/4.
pitfalls: substituting y=2 directly into f′(x)
confusing the inverse function f⁻¹ with the reciprocal 1/f
failing to find the corresponding x₀ first
solution.verification: Locally Δy≈4Δx, so in the reverse direction Δx≈(1/4)Δy, consistent with g′(2)=1/4.
solution.takeaway: An inverse derivative is a reciprocal at corresponding points: find x₀=g(y₀), then compute 1/f′(x₀).
solution.extension: For g′(0), the corresponding point is x₀=0, giving g′(0)=1.

en: adding and subtracting an intermediate term

zh.title: 从定义证明乘积法则
zh.prompt: 设 u、v 都在 x₀ 处可导。仅从导数定义出发，证明 (uv)′(x₀)=u′(x₀)v(x₀)+u(x₀)v′(x₀)。

solution.analysis: 在乘积增量中加减 u(x₀+h)v(x₀)，使其分裂成一个 u 的差商和一个 v 的差商。可导还保证 u(x₀+h)→u(x₀)。
steps: 按定义，(uv)′(x₀)=lim_{h→0}[u(x₀+h)v(x₀+h)-u(x₀)v(x₀)]/h。
在分子中加减 u(x₀+h)v(x₀)，得到 u(x₀+h)[v(x₀+h)-v(x₀)]+v(x₀)[u(x₀+h)-u(x₀)]。
除以 h 后，差商成为 u(x₀+h)·[v(x₀+h)-v(x₀)]/h+v(x₀)·[u(x₀+h)-u(x₀)]/h。
u 在 x₀ 可导，所以在 x₀ 连续，故 u(x₀+h)→u(x₀)；两个差商分别趋于 v′(x₀)、u′(x₀)。
分别取极限并相加，得到 (uv)′(x₀)=u(x₀)v′(x₀)+v(x₀)u′(x₀)，与待证公式相同。
pitfalls: 直接把乘积差写成两个差的乘积
加减中间项后因子配错
使用 u(x₀+h)→u(x₀) 却不说明可导蕴含连续
solution.verification: 取 u(x)=x²、v(x)=x³，公式给出 2x·x³+x²·3x²=5x⁴，与 (x⁵)′=5x⁴ 一致。
solution.takeaway: 证明运算法则的常用技巧是加入合适的中间项，把复杂增量拆成已知差商。
solution.extension: 采用类似分解并处理分母变化，可从定义证明商法则。

en.title: Prove the Product Rule from First Principles
en.prompt: Suppose u and v are differentiable at x₀. Using only the definition of the derivative, prove (uv)′(x₀)=u′(x₀)v(x₀)+u(x₀)v′(x₀).

knowledge: sum and product laws for limits
solution.analysis: Add and subtract u(x₀+h)v(x₀) in the product increment. This produces one difference quotient for u and one for v. Differentiability also gives u(x₀+h)→u(x₀).
steps: By definition, (uv)′(x₀)=lim_{h→0}[u(x₀+h)v(x₀+h)-u(x₀)v(x₀)]/h.
Add and subtract u(x₀+h)v(x₀) in the numerator to obtain u(x₀+h)[v(x₀+h)-v(x₀)]+v(x₀)[u(x₀+h)-u(x₀)].
After division by h, the quotient is u(x₀+h)·[v(x₀+h)-v(x₀)]/h+v(x₀)·[u(x₀+h)-u(x₀)]/h.
Since u is differentiable at x₀, it is continuous there, so u(x₀+h)→u(x₀). The two difference quotients tend to v′(x₀) and u′(x₀).
Taking limits term by term gives (uv)′(x₀)=u(x₀)v′(x₀)+v(x₀)u′(x₀), which is the desired formula.
pitfalls: splitting a difference of products into a product of differences
mismatching factors after adding the intermediate term
using u(x₀+h)→u(x₀) without invoking differentiability-implies-continuity
solution.verification: For u(x)=x² and v(x)=x³, the formula gives 2x·x³+x²·3x²=5x⁴, agreeing with (x⁵)′=5x⁴.
solution.takeaway: A standard way to prove an operation rule is to insert a suitable intermediate term and split a complicated increment into known difference quotients.
solution.extension: A related decomposition, together with control of the changing denominator, proves the quotient rule from first principles.

zh.title: 多层复合与商的综合求导
zh.prompt: 求 y=e^{sin(x²)}/(1+x³) 的导数，并注明定义域。

solution.analysis: 分子含 e^{sin(x²)} 的两层复合，分母是多项式。先分别求分子、分母的导数，再使用商法则。
steps: 令 u(x)=e^{sin(x²)}、v(x)=1+x³，则 y=u/v，且定义域要求 x≠-1。
对 u 逐层求导：u′=e^{sin(x²)}·[sin(x²)]′=e^{sin(x²)}·2x cos(x²)。
分母导数为 v′=3x²。
商法则给出 y′=[u′v-uv′]/v²。
代入并提取公因子，得到 y′=e^{sin(x²)}[2x cos(x²)(1+x³)-3x²]/(1+x³)²，x≠-1。
pitfalls: 求 e^{sin(x²)} 的导数时漏掉 cos(x²) 或 2x
商法则分子次序写反
忘记排除 x=-1
solution.verification: 在 x=0 时公式给出 y′(0)=0；直接观察分子内层 x² 在 0 的导数为 0、分母导数也为 0，与结果一致。
solution.takeaway: 复杂表达式先画清层次：内部链式求导完成后，再进入外部的乘积或商法则。
solution.extension: 也可把函数写成 e^{sin(x²)}(1+x³)⁻¹，用乘积与链式法则得到同一结果。

en.title: Combined Multilayer Chain and Quotient Rules
en.prompt: Differentiate y=e^{sin(x²)}/(1+x³), and state its domain.

solution.analysis: The numerator e^{sin(x²)} has two nested layers, and the denominator is a polynomial. Differentiate them separately, then apply the quotient rule.
steps: Let u(x)=e^{sin(x²)} and v(x)=1+x³, so y=u/v and the domain requires x≠-1.
Differentiate u layer by layer: u′=e^{sin(x²)}·[sin(x²)]′=e^{sin(x²)}·2x cos(x²).
The denominator derivative is v′=3x².
The quotient rule gives y′=[u′v-uv′]/v².
Substitute and factor to obtain y′=e^{sin(x²)}[2x cos(x²)(1+x³)-3x²]/(1+x³)² for x≠-1.
pitfalls: omitting cos(x²) or 2x when differentiating e^{sin(x²)}
reversing the quotient-rule numerator
forgetting to exclude x=-1
solution.verification: At x=0 the formula gives y′(0)=0. The inner function x² and the denominator both have derivative 0 there, which agrees with the result.
solution.takeaway: Map the layers first: finish all inner chain rules before applying an outer product or quotient rule.
solution.extension: Writing the function as e^{sin(x²)}(1+x³)⁻¹ and using the product and chain rules gives the same derivative.

zh.title: 从平均速度到瞬时方向
zh.prompt: 质点的位置为 s(t)=t³-3t²+2t（m），t 以 s 为单位。(1) 求区间 [1,1+h]（h≠0）上的平均速度；(2) 由定义求 v(1)；(3) 写出位置—时间曲线在 (1,s(1)) 处的切线；(4) 解释 v(1) 的符号。

solution.analysis: 四问共用同一个差商。先精确展开 s(1+h)-s(1)，再分别把差商解释为平均速度、极限和切线斜率。
steps: 区间 [1,1+h] 的平均速度为 [s(1+h)-s(1)]/h=(-h+h³)/h=-1+h² m/s。
令 h→0，得到瞬时速度 v(1)=lim_{h→0}(-1+h²)=-1 m/s。
位置—时间曲线的切点为 (1,0)，斜率为 -1，所以切线为 s-0=-1(t-1)，即 s=-(t-1)。
速度为负表示在 t=1 的瞬间，位置沿预先规定的正坐标方向的反方向变化；它不表示距离为负。
pitfalls: 把 h 只允许取正值而忽略双侧瞬时速度
混淆坐标 s 与速率 |v|
切线中把横轴变量误写成 x 而不说明
solution.verification: 平均速度 -1+h² 在 h→0⁺ 与 h→0⁻ 时都趋于 -1，说明双侧瞬时速度一致；切线斜率也等于 -1。
solution.takeaway: 同一差商可同时连接代数极限、物理变化率和图像切线三种含义。
solution.extension: 比较 h=0.1 与 h=-0.1 的平均速度，二者均为 -0.99 m/s，体现其对瞬时速度的逼近。

en.title: From Average Velocity to Instantaneous Direction
en.prompt: A particle has position s(t)=t³-3t²+2t meters, with t in seconds. (1) Find the average velocity on [1,1+h] for h≠0. (2) Use the definition to find v(1). (3) Write the tangent to the position-time curve at (1,s(1)). (4) Interpret the sign of v(1).
en.answer: (1) -1+h² m/s; (2) v(1)=-1 m/s; (3) s=-(t-1); (4) the particle is moving in the negative direction at that instant

solution.analysis: All four parts use the same quotient. First expand s(1+h)-s(1) exactly, then interpret the quotient as an average velocity, a limit, and a tangent slope.
steps: Compute s(1)=1-3+2=0 and expand s(1+h)=(1+h)³-3(1+h)²+2(1+h)=-h+h³.
The average velocity on [1,1+h] is [s(1+h)-s(1)]/h=(-h+h³)/h=-1+h² m/s.
Let h→0 to obtain the instantaneous velocity v(1)=lim_{h→0}(-1+h²)=-1 m/s.
The point on the position-time graph is (1,0) and the slope is -1, so its tangent is s-0=-1(t-1), or s=-(t-1).
The negative velocity means that at t=1 the position is changing opposite the chosen positive coordinate direction; it does not mean that distance is negative.
pitfalls: allowing only positive h and missing the two-sided instantaneous velocity
confusing position s with speed |v|
using x for the horizontal variable without explaining it
solution.verification: The average velocity -1+h² tends to -1 from both h→0⁺ and h→0⁻, so the two-sided instantaneous velocity agrees; the tangent slope is also -1.
solution.takeaway: One difference quotient connects an algebraic limit, a physical rate, and a graphical tangent slope.
solution.extension: For h=0.1 and h=-0.1, the average velocity is -0.99 m/s in both cases, illustrating approximation to the instantaneous value.

zh.title: “无穷大导数”的错误
zh.prompt: 函数 f(x)=√x 的定义域为 [0,+∞)。某同学写道：“f′(0)=lim_{h→0}[√h-0]/h=lim_{h→0}1/√h=+∞，所以 f′(0)=+∞。”指出这段推理中的所有关键错误，并给出正确结论。
zh.answer: h 只能从右侧趋于 0；右差商无界而不是趋于有限实数，因此通常意义下 f′(0) 不存在，不能写成 f′(0)=+∞。

knowledge: 定义域端点的单侧增量
竖直切线与有限导数的区别
solution.analysis: 错误有两层：允许的增量方向受定义域限制；即使右侧差商趋于 +∞，它也不是有限导数值。
steps: 因为 f 只在 x≥0 有定义，以 0 为基点时必须有 h≥0；差商只能考察 h→0⁺，不能写无方向的 h→0。
对 h>0，差商 [√h-0]/h=1/√h，且当 h→0⁺ 时它无界增大。
通常的导数定义要求差商收敛到一个有限实数；+∞ 描述无界行为，不是一个可接受的导数值。
因此正确结论是：f 在端点 0 没有有限右导数，通常意义下 f′(0) 不存在；图像可描述为在原点具有竖直切线趋势，但不能据此写 f′(0)=+∞。
pitfalls: 在端点使用不存在于定义域内的负增量
把无穷符号当作普通实数
把“竖直切线”与“存在有限导数”混为一谈
solution.verification: 取 h=10⁻²、10⁻⁴、10⁻⁶，差商依次为 10、100、1000，显示其无界而非趋于有限数。
solution.takeaway: 导数判断先检查允许的趋近方向，再检查差商是否趋于有限实数。
solution.extension: 对 f(x)=x^{1/3} 在 0 的双侧差商也无界为正，同样没有有限导数。

en.title: The Error in an “Infinite Derivative”
en.prompt: The function f(x)=√x has domain [0,+∞). A student writes: “f′(0)=lim_{h→0}[√h-0]/h=lim_{h→0}1/√h=+∞, so f′(0)=+∞.” Identify every key error and give the correct conclusion.
en.answer: Only h→0⁺ is allowed; the right-hand quotient is unbounded rather than convergent to a finite real number. Thus f′(0) does not exist in the usual sense, and one must not write f′(0)=+∞.

knowledge: one-sided increments at a domain endpoint
a derivative must be a finite real number
solution.analysis: There are two errors: the domain restricts the direction of the increment, and even the right-hand quotient tends to +∞ rather than to a finite derivative value.
steps: Because f is defined only for x≥0, an increment from the base point 0 must satisfy h≥0; only h→0⁺ is admissible, not an unrestricted h→0.
For h>0, the quotient is [√h-0]/h=1/√h, which grows without bound as h→0⁺.
The usual derivative definition requires convergence of the quotient to a finite real number; +∞ records unbounded behavior and is not an acceptable derivative value.

Therefore f has no finite right derivative at the endpoint 0, and f′(0) does not exist in the usual sense. The graph may be described as having a vertical-tangent tendency at the origin, but this does not justify f′(0)=+∞.
pitfalls: using negative increments that leave the domain
treating the infinity symbol as an ordinary real number
confusing a vertical tangent with existence of a finite derivative
solution.verification: For h=10⁻²,10⁻⁴,10⁻⁶, the quotients are 10,100,1000, showing unbounded growth rather than convergence to a finite number.
solution.takeaway: When testing a derivative, first check the permitted direction of approach and then require a finite quotient limit.
solution.extension: For f(x)=x^{1/3}, the two-sided quotient at 0 is also unbounded and positive, so there is again no finite derivative.

zh.title: 公式与定义域同时判断
zh.prompt: 下列求导公式在所注明的定义域上正确的是哪些？

knowledge: 指数函数与根式定义域
solution.analysis: 本题不仅核对公式，还核对端点与参数条件。B 唯一错误在于反余弦导数缺少负号。
steps: A 正确：在 x>0 与 x<0 两个区间分别求导都得到 1/x。
B 错误：正确公式是 (arccos x)′=−1/√(1−x²)，定义在 −1<x<1。
C 正确：正底数指数函数的导数为自身乘 ln a；给定条件保证通常的指数函数定义。
因此正确选项是 A、C、D。
pitfalls: 忽略 arccos 的负号
把根式端点也算作导数公式的有限取值点
忘记指数函数底数条件
solution.verification: arccos x 随 x 增大而减小，所以其导数应为负，这可快速排除 B。
solution.takeaway: 基本导数公式必须与符号、参数条件和导数存在的区间一起记忆。
solution.extension: 比较 arcsin x 与 arccos x 的导数，可验证两者之和的导数为 0。

en.title: Checking Both Formula and Domain
en.prompt: Which differentiation formulas are correct on the indicated domains?

solution.analysis: Both the formulas and their endpoint or parameter conditions must be checked. The only error is the missing negative sign in B.
steps: A is correct: differentiating separately on x>0 and x<0 gives 1/x on both intervals.
B is false: the correct formula is (arccos x)′=−1/√(1−x²) for −1<x<1.
C is correct: the derivative of a positive-base exponential is itself times ln a under the stated conditions.
D is correct because the chain rule gives (1/2)(1−x²)^(−1/2)(−2x)=−x/√(1−x²).
Thus the correct selections are A, C, and D.
pitfalls: Missing the negative sign for arccosine
Including radical endpoints where the displayed derivative is not finite
Forgetting the base conditions for an exponential
solution.verification: Because arccos x decreases as x increases, its derivative must be negative; this immediately rules out B.
solution.takeaway: A basic derivative formula should be remembered together with its sign, parameter restrictions, and derivative domain.
solution.extension: Compare the derivatives of arcsin x and arccos x to verify that the derivative of their sum is zero.

zh.title: 四层复合函数的链式求导
zh.prompt: 求 y=arctan[eˢⁱⁿ⁽ˣ²⁾] 的导数，并用分层变量说明每个因子的来源。

solution.analysis: 从外到内依次是 arctan、e 的幂、sin、x²。为避免漏项，给每一层单独命名并把四个导数因子相乘。
steps: 设 u=eˢⁱⁿ⁽ˣ²⁾，则 y=arctan u，故 dy/du=1/(1+u²)。
设 v=sin(x²)，则 u=eᵛ，故 du/dv=eᵛ。
设 w=x²，则 v=sin w，故 dv/dw=cos w。
最内层有 dw/dx=2x。
链式相乘得 y′=[1/(1+u²)]eᵛcos w·2x，代回即得答案。
pitfalls: 把 arctan 的分母写成 1+u
指数求导后漏保留 eᵛ
漏掉 cos(x²) 或 2x
solution.verification: 当 x=0 时，公式含因子 2x，故 y′(0)=0；原函数只通过 x² 依赖 x，是偶函数，这与 0 处导数为 0 相符。
solution.takeaway: 深层复合函数的导数是沿唯一依赖链逐层相乘，分层变量能防止遗漏。
solution.extension: 若最内层 x² 改为 φ(x)，只需把最后的 2x 替换为 φ′(x)。

en.title: Chain Rule for a Four-Layer Composite
en.prompt: Differentiate y=arctan[eˢⁱⁿ⁽ˣ²⁾], using layer variables to explain the source of every factor.

solution.analysis: From outside to inside, the layers are arctangent, exponential, sine, and x². Naming each layer makes the four derivative factors explicit.
steps: Let u=eˢⁱⁿ⁽ˣ²⁾, so y=arctan u and dy/du=1/(1+u²).
Let v=sin(x²), so u=eᵛ and du/dv=eᵛ.
Let w=x², so v=sin w and dv/dw=cos w.
For the innermost layer, dw/dx=2x.
Multiplying along the chain gives y′=[1/(1+u²)]eᵛcos w·2x; substitution yields the answer.
pitfalls: Writing 1+u instead of 1+u² for arctangent
Dropping eᵛ after differentiating the exponential
Missing cos(x²) or 2x
solution.verification: At x=0 the formula contains the factor 2x and gives y′(0)=0. The original function depends on x through x² and is even, consistent with this value.
solution.takeaway: For a deeply nested function, multiply one derivative from every layer along its dependency chain.
solution.extension: If x² is replaced by φ(x), replace only the final factor 2x by φ′(x).

zh.title: 证明实数幂的求导公式
zh.prompt: 设 α 为任意实数。利用 x^α=e^{αln x}，证明在 x>0 上 (x^α)′=αx^{α−1}。
zh.answer: 将 x^α 写成 e^{αln x} 后用链式法则，得 (x^α)′=e^{αln x}·α/x=αx^{α−1}。

solution.analysis: 任意实数指数不能只依赖整数幂的重复乘法解释。在 x>0 上用指数和对数定义实数幂，再按复合函数求导。
steps: 对 x>0，实数幂可写成 x^α=e^{αln x}，右边各函数均有定义且可导。
令 u(x)=αln x，则 x^α=eᵘ。
由链式法则，(eᵘ)′=eᵘu′，而 u′=α/x。
因此 (x^α)′=e^{αln x}·α/x=x^α·α/x。
利用 x^α/x=x^{α−1}，得到 (x^α)′=αx^{α−1}，证毕。
pitfalls: 忘记证明限定在 x>0
把 (αln x)′写成 αln x
在最后一步错误处理指数
solution.takeaway: 指数—对数表示把任意实数幂的求导统一归结为链式法则。
solution.extension: 对正函数 u(x)，同样可得 [u(x)]^α 的导数为 αu^{α−1}u′。

en.title: Proving the Derivative Rule for Real Powers
en.prompt: Let α be any real number. Using x^α=e^{αln x}, prove that (x^α)′=αx^{α−1} for x>0.
en.answer: Write x^α as e^{αln x} and apply the chain rule: (x^α)′=e^{αln x}·α/x=αx^{α−1}.

solution.analysis: For an arbitrary real exponent, repeated multiplication is not an adequate definition. On x>0, use the exponential-logarithmic representation and differentiate it as a composite function.
steps: For x>0, define x^α=e^{αln x}; all functions on the right are defined and differentiable.
Let u(x)=αln x, so x^α=eᵘ.
The chain rule gives (eᵘ)′=eᵘu′, and u′=α/x.
Hence (x^α)′=e^{αln x}·α/x=x^α·α/x.
Since x^α/x=x^{α−1}, we obtain (x^α)′=αx^{α−1}.
pitfalls: Forgetting that the proof is restricted to x>0
Writing (αln x)′ as αln x
Combining exponents incorrectly in the final step
solution.verification: For α=1/2 the result is (√x)′=1/(2√x); for α=−1 it is (1/x)′=−1/x², matching the basic formulas.
solution.takeaway: The exponential-logarithmic representation reduces differentiation of every real power to the chain rule.
solution.extension: For a positive differentiable u(x), the same argument gives ([u(x)]^α)′=αu^{α−1}u′.

zh.title: 三参数分段函数的可导分类
zh.prompt: 设 f(x)={x²+ax+b，x<1；c ln x+2，x≥1}。求所有使 f 在 x=1 处可导的实参数三元组 (a,b,c)，并写出此时 f′(1)。

solution.analysis: 三个参数只受连续与左右导数相等两条方程约束，因此答案应是一族三元组，而不是唯一数值。
steps: 右段给出 f(1)=c ln1+2=2。
左极限为 1+a+b；连续性要求 1+a+b=2，即 a+b=1。
左导数为 2x+a，在 x=1 处为 2+a。
右导数为 c/x，在 x=1 处为 c；可导要求 c=2+a。
令 a=t，则 b=1−t、c=t+2，其中 t 为任意实数。
在这些参数下，公共左右导数为 t+2，所以 f′(1)=t+2。
pitfalls: 把 ln1 误认为 1
认为三个参数必须有唯一解
只检查连续而不检查左右导数
solution.verification: 代入参数族后，左侧函数值 1+t+1−t=2，右侧函数值 2；左导数 2+t 与右导数 c=t+2 完全相同。
solution.takeaway: 参数数量多于独立条件数量时，应明确写出自由参数及完整解集。

en.title: Differentiability Classification for a Three-Parameter Piecewise Function
en.prompt: Let f(x)={x²+ax+b for x<1; c ln x+2 for x≥1}. Find all real triples (a,b,c) for which f is differentiable at x=1, and give f′(1).

solution.analysis: The three parameters are constrained by only two independent equations—continuity and equal one-sided derivatives—so the answer is a family rather than one triple.
steps: The right-hand piece gives f(1)=c ln1+2=2.
The left-hand limit is 1+a+b, so continuity requires 1+a+b=2, or a+b=1.
The left derivative is 2x+a, which equals 2+a at x=1.
The right derivative is c/x, which equals c at x=1; differentiability requires c=2+a.
Set a=t. Then b=1−t and c=t+2, where t is any real number.
For these parameters, the common one-sided derivative is t+2, so f′(1)=t+2.
pitfalls: Treating ln1 as 1
Assuming three parameters must have a unique solution
Checking continuity without checking one-sided derivatives
solution.verification: After substitution, the left value is 1+t+1−t=2 and the right value is 2; the left derivative 2+t equals the right derivative c=t+2.
solution.takeaway: When there are more parameters than independent conditions, state the free parameter and the complete solution family.
solution.extension: If f′(1)=0 is also required, then t=−2 and the unique triple is (a,b,c)=(−2,3,0).

zh.title: 由反函数公式推出反正切导数
zh.prompt: 把 arctan x 看作 tan y 在 (−π/2,π/2) 上的反函数，证明 (arctan x)′=1/(1+x²)。
zh.answer: 若 y=arctan x，则由反函数公式 y′=1/sec²y=cos²y=1/(1+tan²y)=1/(1+x²)。

solution.analysis: 正切在指定区间上一一对应且导数 sec²y 始终非零，可以直接应用反函数求导公式，再把结果全部化为 x。
steps: 令 F(y)=tan y，并把定义域限制为 (−π/2,π/2)，此时 F 的反函数为 g(x)=arctan x。
在该区间内 F′(y)=sec²y>0，因而反函数求导公式适用。
若 y=g(x)=arctan x，则 g′(x)=1/F′(y)=1/sec²y。
利用 1/sec²y=cos²y=1/(1+tan²y)。
又因 tan y=x，所以 g′(x)=1/(1+x²)，对所有实数 x 成立。
pitfalls: 未限定 tan 的一一对应区间
把反函数导数写成 sec²x
最后没有把 y 替换为 x
solution.verification: 在 x=0 处，arctan 图像切线斜率为 1，公式给出 1/(1+0)=1。
solution.takeaway: 反三角函数的导数可由原三角函数的导数取对应点倒数得到。
solution.extension: 用同样方法从 sin 在 [−π/2,π/2] 上的反函数推出 arcsin 的导数公式。

en.title: Deriving the Derivative of Arctangent from the Inverse Formula
en.prompt: View arctan x as the inverse of tan y on (−π/2,π/2), and prove that (arctan x)′=1/(1+x²).
en.answer: If y=arctan x, the inverse formula gives y′=1/sec²y=cos²y=1/(1+tan²y)=1/(1+x²).

solution.analysis: Tangent is one-to-one on the specified interval and its derivative sec²y is never zero there. Apply the inverse derivative formula and then express the result entirely in x.
steps: Let F(y)=tan y with domain restricted to (−π/2,π/2); its inverse is g(x)=arctan x.
On this interval, F′(y)=sec²y>0, so the inverse derivative formula applies.
If y=g(x)=arctan x, then g′(x)=1/F′(y)=1/sec²y.
Use 1/sec²y=cos²y=1/(1+tan²y).
Since tan y=x, we obtain g′(x)=1/(1+x²) for every real x.
pitfalls: Failing to restrict tangent to a one-to-one interval
Writing the inverse derivative as sec²x
Failing to replace y by an expression in x
solution.verification: At x=0, the arctangent graph has slope 1, and the formula gives 1/(1+0)=1.
solution.takeaway: An inverse-trigonometric derivative is obtained by taking the reciprocal of the original trigonometric derivative at the corresponding point.
solution.extension: Use the same method with sine on [−π/2,π/2] to derive the derivative of arcsine.

zh.title: 自然对数的 n 阶导数
zh.prompt: 对 x>0，先求 ln x 的前四阶导数，再写出其 n 阶导数公式（n≥1）。

solution.analysis: 连续求导后，分母幂次每次增加 1，符号交替，系数依次形成 0!、1!、2!、3!。
steps: 一阶导数为 (ln x)′=1/x。
二阶与三阶导数分别为 −1/x²、2/x³。
四阶导数为 −6/x⁴。
观察到第 n 阶的符号为 (−1)ⁿ⁻¹，分母为 xⁿ，系数为 (n−1)!。
pitfalls: 把系数写成 n!
把符号写成 (−1)ⁿ
分母幂次与导数阶数错位
solution.verification: 代入 n=1 得 1/x，代入 n=4 得 −3!/x⁴=−6/x⁴，均与直接计算吻合。
solution.takeaway: 先列出少量低阶导数，可同时识别符号、阶乘和幂次三条规律。
solution.extension: 把 ln x 改为 ln(ax+b)，每阶还会出现 aⁿ，并把 x 替换为 ax+b。

en.title: The nth Derivative of the Natural Logarithm
en.prompt: For x>0, compute the first four derivatives of ln x and then state its nth derivative for n≥1.

solution.analysis: With each differentiation, the denominator power increases by one, the sign alternates, and the coefficients form 0!, 1!, 2!, and 3!.
steps: The first derivative is (ln x)′=1/x.
The second and third derivatives are −1/x² and 2/x³.
The fourth derivative is −6/x⁴.
The nth sign is (−1)ⁿ⁻¹, the denominator is xⁿ, and the coefficient is (n−1)!.
Thus (ln x)⁽ⁿ⁾=(−1)ⁿ⁻¹(n−1)!/xⁿ for n≥1.
pitfalls: Using n! instead of (n−1)!
Using (−1)ⁿ for the sign
Shifting the denominator power away from the derivative order
solution.verification: At n=1 the formula gives 1/x, and at n=4 it gives −3!/x⁴=−6/x⁴, matching the direct calculations.
solution.takeaway: A few low-order derivatives reveal the sign, factorial, and power patterns simultaneously.
solution.extension: For ln(ax+b), each order also contributes aⁿ and replaces x by ax+b.

zh.title: 指数余弦乘积的统一 n 阶公式
zh.prompt: 设 a²+b²>0，r=√(a²+b²)，并取 θ 使 cosθ=a/r、sinθ=b/r。用数学归纳法证明：y=eᵃˣcos(bx+φ) 满足 y⁽ⁿ⁾=rⁿeᵃˣcos(bx+φ+nθ)。
zh.answer: 公式对所有整数 n≥0 成立；归纳步骤利用 a cosψ−b sinψ=r cos(ψ+θ)。

solution.analysis: 一次求导会把相位增加固定角 θ，并把振幅乘以固定因子 r。证明这一更新规则后即可归纳到任意阶。
steps: 当 n=0 时，右边为 eᵃˣcos(bx+φ)=y，公式成立。
由 cosθ=a/r、sinθ=b/r，有 a cosψ−b sinψ=r cos(ψ+θ)。
假设 n=k 时 y⁽ᵏ⁾=rᵏeᵃˣcos(bx+φ+kθ)。
令 ψ=bx+φ+kθ，对归纳假设求导得 y⁽ᵏ⁺¹⁾=rᵏeᵃˣ[a cosψ−b sinψ]。
用辅助角恒等式化简为 y⁽ᵏ⁺¹⁾=rᵏ⁺¹eᵃˣcos(bx+φ+(k+1)θ)。
归纳步骤成立，因此公式对所有 n≥0 成立。
pitfalls: 辅助角中 sinθ 的符号取错
每次求导漏掉振幅因子 r
未排除 a=b=0 导致 θ 无法按题设定义
solution.verification: 取 n=1，公式给 reᵃˣcos(bx+φ+θ)=eᵃˣ[a cos(bx+φ)−b sin(bx+φ)]，正是直接求导结果。
solution.takeaway: 某些函数族连续求导只会发生固定的振幅缩放和相位平移。
solution.extension: 把 cos 换成 sin，可得到 y⁽ⁿ⁾=rⁿeᵃˣsin(bx+φ+nθ)。

en.title: A Unified nth-Derivative Formula for an Exponential-Cosine Product
en.prompt: Let a²+b²>0, r=√(a²+b²), and choose θ so that cosθ=a/r and sinθ=b/r. Prove by induction that y=eᵃˣcos(bx+φ) satisfies y⁽ⁿ⁾=rⁿeᵃˣcos(bx+φ+nθ).
en.answer: The formula holds for every integer n≥0; the induction step uses a cosψ−b sinψ=r cos(ψ+θ).

solution.analysis: One differentiation increases the phase by the fixed angle θ and multiplies the amplitude by the fixed factor r. Establishing this update proves the general formula inductively.
steps: For n=0, the right side is eᵃˣcos(bx+φ)=y, so the base case holds.
From cosθ=a/r and sinθ=b/r, a cosψ−b sinψ=r cos(ψ+θ).
Assume y⁽ᵏ⁾=rᵏeᵃˣcos(bx+φ+kθ).
Set ψ=bx+φ+kθ and differentiate the induction hypothesis to get y⁽ᵏ⁺¹⁾=rᵏeᵃˣ[a cosψ−b sinψ].
The auxiliary-angle identity gives y⁽ᵏ⁺¹⁾=rᵏ⁺¹eᵃˣcos(bx+φ+(k+1)θ).
Thus the induction step holds, proving the formula for all n≥0.
pitfalls: Choosing the wrong sign for sinθ
Missing the factor r at each differentiation
Failing to exclude a=b=0, for which θ is not defined as stated
solution.verification: At n=1, the formula gives reᵃˣcos(bx+φ+θ)=eᵃˣ[a cos(bx+φ)−b sin(bx+φ)], exactly the direct derivative.
solution.takeaway: For some closed function families, successive differentiation produces a fixed amplitude scaling and phase shift.
solution.extension: Replacing cosine by sine gives y⁽ⁿ⁾=rⁿeᵃˣsin(bx+φ+nθ).

zh.title: x²sin x 的一般阶导数
zh.prompt: 设 y=x²sin x。对 n≥2，求 y⁽ⁿ⁾ 的显式公式，并用 n=2 检验。

solution.analysis: 将 n 次求导分配给 x² 与 sin x。因为 x² 的三阶及更高阶导数为 0，完整求和只剩三项。
steps: 乘积高阶导数公式给 y⁽ⁿ⁾=Σ_{k=0}ⁿC(n,k)(x²)⁽ᵏ⁾(sin x)⁽ⁿ⁻ᵏ⁾。
由于 (x²)⁽⁰⁾=x²、(x²)′=2x、(x²)″=2，而 k≥3 时导数为 0，只保留 k=0,1,2。
使用 (sin x)⁽ᵐ⁾=sin(x+mπ/2)。
三项分别为 x²sin(x+nπ/2)、2nxsin[x+(n−1)π/2]、C(n,2)·2sin[x+(n−2)π/2]。
因 2C(n,2)=n(n−1)，合并得到答案。
取 n=2，公式化为 −x²sin x+4xcos x+2sin x，与直接两次求导一致。
pitfalls: 求和中把 k 与 n−k 的角色调换后未同步改相位
漏掉二项式系数
把 2C(n,2) 错化简
solution.verification: 直接计算 y′=2xsin x+x²cos x，再求导得 y″=2sin x+4xcos x−x²sin x，与 n=2 检验完全相同。
solution.takeaway: 多项式乘其他函数的高阶导数会因多项式高阶导数归零而截断为有限项。
solution.extension: 把 x² 换成 xᵐ，公式将保留 k=0,1,…,m 共 m+1 项。

en.title: The General Derivative of x²sin x
en.prompt: Let y=x²sin x. For n≥2, find an explicit formula for y⁽ⁿ⁾ and check it at n=2.

solution.analysis: Distribute the n differentiations between x² and sin x. Because the third and higher derivatives of x² vanish, the full sum reduces to only three terms.
steps: The higher product formula gives y⁽ⁿ⁾=Σ_{k=0}ⁿC(n,k)(x²)⁽ᵏ⁾(sin x)⁽ⁿ⁻ᵏ⁾.
Since (x²)⁽⁰⁾=x², (x²)′=2x, (x²)″=2, and derivatives for k≥3 vanish, retain only k=0,1,2.
Use (sin x)⁽ᵐ⁾=sin(x+mπ/2).
The three terms are x²sin(x+nπ/2), 2nxsin[x+(n−1)π/2], and C(n,2)·2sin[x+(n−2)π/2].
Because 2C(n,2)=n(n−1), these terms give the stated formula.
At n=2 it becomes −x²sin x+4xcos x+2sin x, matching direct differentiation.
pitfalls: Switching k and n−k without adjusting the phase
Omitting the binomial coefficients
Simplifying 2C(n,2) incorrectly
solution.verification: Directly, y′=2xsin x+x²cos x and y″=2sin x+4xcos x−x²sin x, exactly the n=2 specialization.
solution.takeaway: For a polynomial times another function, the higher-product sum terminates because sufficiently high polynomial derivatives vanish.
solution.extension: Replacing x² by xᵐ leaves k=0,1,…,m, for a total of m+1 terms.

zh.title: 先拆分再求有理函数高阶导数

knowledge: 一次因式倒数的高阶导数
solution.analysis: 直接反复使用商法则会迅速复杂化。先把有理函数拆成两个一次因式倒数，再逐项套用统一公式。
steps: 逐项求导并保留系数，得 y⁽ⁿ⁾=(−1)ⁿn!/3·[1/(x−1)ⁿ⁺¹−1/(x+2)ⁿ⁺¹]。
pitfalls: 部分分式系数符号写反
把两个分母的平移量混淆
n 阶公式的分母幂漏加 1
solution.verification: 取 n=0，公式立即恢复原部分分式；将两项通分又得到原函数。
solution.takeaway: 线性因式可分解的有理函数，高阶求导的关键通常在求导前的代数拆分。
solution.extension: 若分母含重复线性因式，还需加入 1/(x−a)² 等项，并分别使用负整数幂公式。

en.title: Decompose Before Taking Higher Derivatives of a Rational Function
en.prompt: Let y=1/[(x−1)(x+2)], x≠1,−2. Find y⁽ⁿ⁾ for n≥0.

knowledge: Higher derivatives of reciprocal linear factors
solution.analysis: Repeated quotient rules would become complicated. First split the rational function into two reciprocal linear factors, then apply one standard formula termwise.
steps: Setting x=1 gives A=1/3, and setting x=−2 gives B=−1/3.
Differentiate termwise to obtain y⁽ⁿ⁾=(−1)ⁿn!/3·[1/(x−1)ⁿ⁺¹−1/(x+2)ⁿ⁺¹].
pitfalls: Reversing a partial-fraction sign
Confusing the shifts in the two denominators
Omitting the +1 in the denominator power
solution.verification: At n=0, the formula returns the partial-fraction expression, which combines back to the original function.
solution.takeaway: For a rational function with linear factors, algebraic decomposition before differentiation is often the key to an nth-order formula.
solution.extension: Repeated linear factors require terms such as 1/(x−a)², each handled by the negative-integer power rule.

zh.title: 二次隐式曲线的二阶导数
zh.prompt: 曲线 x²+xy+y²=7 通过点 (1,2)。求该点的 y′ 与 y″。

solution.analysis: 先保留一阶导数关系，再对整条关系求导。第二次求导时 xy′ 与 2yy′ 都需要乘积法则。
steps: 一次求导得 2x+y+xy′+2yy′=0，即 y′=−(2x+y)/(x+2y)。
对 2x+y+xy′+2yy′=0 再求导，得到 2+y′+y′+xy″+2(y′)²+2yy″=0。
pitfalls: 第二次求导漏掉 (y′)²
把 d(xy′)/dx 写成 xy″
求 y″ 前重新代入原方程而遗漏一阶关系
solution.takeaway: 隐函数二阶导数应从未过早化简的一阶关系继续求导，并保留所有乘积项。
solution.extension: 可先得到一般式 y″=−[2+2y′+2(y′)²]/(x+2y)，再在任意允许点代值。

en.title: Second Derivative of a Quadratic Implicit Curve
en.prompt: The curve x²+xy+y²=7 passes through (1,2). Find y′ and y″ at that point.

solution.analysis: Keep the first derivative relation and differentiate the entire relation again. Both xy′ and 2yy′ require the product rule.
steps: The first derivative relation is 2x+y+xy′+2yy′=0, so y′=−(2x+y)/(x+2y).
Differentiate the relation again to get 2+y′+y′+xy″+2(y′)²+2yy″=0.
Combine terms: 2+2y′+2(y′)²+(x+2y)y″=0.
Substitute x=1,y=2,y′=−4/5 to obtain 2−8/5+32/25+5y″=0.
The first three terms equal 42/25, so y″=−42/125.
pitfalls: Omitting (y′)² in the second differentiation
Writing d(xy′)/dx as only xy″
Discarding the first derivative relation too early
solution.verification: (1,2) satisfies the curve, and 42/25+5(−42/125)=0 in the second derivative relation.
solution.takeaway: For a second implicit derivative, differentiate the uncompressed first derivative relation and retain every product-rule term.
solution.extension: The general form is y″=−[2+2y′+2(y′)²]/(x+2y) wherever the denominator is nonzero.

zh.title: 参数曲线的二阶导数
zh.prompt: 参数曲线 x=t²+1，y=t³。在 t=1 时求 dy/dx 与 d²y/dx²。

knowledge: 对 t 求导后再除以 dx/dt
solution.analysis: 二阶导数不是 (d²y/dt²)/(d²x/dt²)。应先把 dy/dx 作为 t 的函数求导，再除以 dx/dt。
steps: dx/dt=2t，dy/dt=3t²。
对 t 求导，d/dt(dy/dx)=3/2。
使用 d²y/dx²=[d/dt(dy/dx)]/(dx/dt)，得到 d²y/dx²=(3/2)/(2t)=3/(4t)。
在 t=1 时，dy/dx=3/2，d²y/dx²=3/4。
pitfalls: 把二阶导数写成 (d²y/dt²)/(d²x/dt²)
化简 dy/dx 时错误约去 t=0 的情形
第二次忘记除以 dx/dt
solution.verification: 消去参数有 y=(x−1)^{3/2}，在 x=2 对该表达式按已学求导规则可得一阶 3/2、二阶 3/4。
solution.takeaway: 参数二阶导数的顺序是先求 dy/dx，再对 t 求导，最后除以 dx/dt。
solution.extension: 一般公式为 d²y/dx²=[x′(t)y″(t)−y′(t)x″(t)]/[x′(t)]³，前提 x′(t)≠0。

en.title: Second Derivative of a Parametric Curve
en.prompt: For x=t²+1 and y=t³, find dy/dx and d²y/dx² at t=1.

knowledge: Differentiate with respect to t and divide by dx/dt
solution.analysis: The second derivative is not (d²y/dt²)/(d²x/dt²). First differentiate dy/dx as a function of t, then divide by dx/dt.
steps: dx/dt=2t and dy/dt=3t².
For t≠0, dy/dx=(3t²)/(2t)=3t/2.
Differentiate with respect to t: d/dt(dy/dx)=3/2.
Use d²y/dx²=[d/dt(dy/dx)]/(dx/dt)=(3/2)/(2t)=3/(4t).
At t=1, dy/dx=3/2 and d²y/dx²=3/4.
pitfalls: Using (d²y/dt²)/(d²x/dt²)
Canceling t without noting t≠0
Forgetting the second division by dx/dt
solution.verification: Eliminating t gives y=(x−1)^{3/2}; at x=2, ordinary differentiation gives 3/2 and 3/4.
solution.takeaway: For a second parametric derivative: find dy/dx, differentiate it with respect to t, then divide by dx/dt.
solution.extension: Equivalently, d²y/dx²=[x′(t)y″(t)−y′(t)x″(t)]/[x′(t)]³ when x′(t)≠0.

zh.title: 相关变化率的建模原则
zh.prompt: 关于相关变化率问题，下列说法哪些正确？多选。
choices: A. 应先写出随时间成立的几何或物理关系，再对时间 t 求导
B. 若某长度正在减小，则在选定正方向下其变化率应取负值
C. 体积变化率 dV/dt 的单位应是长度³/时间
D. 可在求导前把当前数值代入并视为常数，因为只关心这一瞬间

solution.analysis: 所有几何量都是时间函数。当前数值只能在对关系求导之后代入，否则会错误地把正在变化的量当常数。
steps: A 正确：先建立对一段时间都成立的关系，才能通过链式法则连接各变化率。
B 正确：变化率带方向，减小量在所选正方向下应为负。
C 正确：体积的量纲为长度³，除以时间后得到长度³/时间。
D 错误：若先把变量替成当前常数，求导会把其变化率错误消掉。
因此正确选项为 A、B、C。
pitfalls: 只写变化率绝对值而忽略方向
在求导前过早代入瞬时数值
把面积率或体积率单位仍写成长度/时间
solution.verification: 以 V=(4/3)πr³ 为例，若先代入 r=5 就得到常数体积并错误给出导数 0；正确做法先得 dV/dt=4πr²dr/dt。
solution.takeaway: 相关变化率的固定流程是关系、对时间求导、代入瞬时数据、检查符号与单位。
solution.extension: 选定相反正方向会同时改变某些速率的符号，但只要前后一致，物理结论不变。

en.title: Modeling Principles for Related Rates
en.prompt: Which statements about related-rate problems are correct? Select all that apply.
choices: A. First write a geometric or physical relation valid over time, then differentiate with respect to t
B. If a length is decreasing, its rate is negative under the chosen positive direction
C. The unit of dV/dt is length³/time
D. Current numerical values may be substituted before differentiation and treated as constants because only one instant matters

solution.analysis: Every geometric quantity is a function of time. Instantaneous values should be inserted only after differentiating, or a changing quantity may be frozen incorrectly.
steps: A is correct: a relation valid over time allows the chain rule to connect the rates.
B is correct: a decreasing quantity has a negative signed rate under the chosen positive direction.
C is correct because volume has dimension length³, so its rate has dimension length³/time.
D is false: substituting first can turn a changing variable into a constant and erase its rate.
Therefore A, B, and C are correct.
pitfalls: Ignoring the sign of a directed rate
Substituting instantaneous values too early
Giving an area or volume rate the unit length/time
solution.verification: For V=(4/3)πr³, substituting r=5 first makes V look constant and falsely gives derivative 0; differentiating first gives dV/dt=4πr²dr/dt.
solution.takeaway: Use the fixed sequence: relation, differentiate in time, substitute instantaneous data, then check sign and units.
solution.extension: Choosing the opposite positive direction changes some signs, but consistent use leaves the physical conclusion unchanged.

zh.title: 圆锥水面的半径与体积变化
zh.prompt: 倒置圆锥形容器中水面形成相似圆锥，始终满足 h=3r，其中 h、r 单位为 cm。水深以 dh/dt=6 cm/min 增加。当 h=6 cm 时，求 dr/dt 与 dV/dt。

solution.analysis: 相似关系先把 r 与 h 联系起来。可将体积化为 h 的单变量函数，避免同时处理两个未知速率。
steps: 由 h=3r，得 r=h/3；对时间求导得 dr/dt=(1/3)dh/dt=2 cm/min。
当 h=6 cm 时，r=6/3=2 cm。
水体积 V=(1/3)πr²h；代入 r=h/3，得到 V=πh³/27。
对时间求导：dV/dt=(πh²/9)·dh/dt。
代入 h=6 与 dh/dt=6，得到 dV/dt=(π·36/9)·6=24π cm³/min。
两个结果均为正，符合水深和水量都增加的情境。
pitfalls: 把容器口半径当作水面半径常数
漏用相似关系 h=3r
圆锥体积漏掉 1/3
体积率单位写成 cm/min
solution.verification: 直接对 V=(1/3)πr²h 求导并代入 r=2,h=6,dr/dt=2,dh/dt=6，也得到 (1/3)π[2rh r′+r²h′]=24π。
solution.takeaway: 相似容器相关变化率先用几何比例减少变量，再对时间求导最稳妥。
solution.extension: 若相似关系改为 h=kr，则 V=πh³/(3k²)，可由同一方法求体积率。

en.title: Radius and Volume Rates in a Conical Water Surface
en.prompt: Water in an inverted conical tank forms similar cones satisfying h=3r, with h and r in cm. The depth increases at dh/dt=6 cm/min. When h=6 cm, find dr/dt and dV/dt.

solution.analysis: Use similarity to connect r and h. Expressing volume as a function of h alone avoids two unknown rates.
steps: From h=3r, r=h/3. Differentiate to get dr/dt=(1/3)dh/dt=2 cm/min.
When h=6 cm, r=6/3=2 cm.
The water volume is V=(1/3)πr²h. Substituting r=h/3 gives V=πh³/27.
Differentiate in time: dV/dt=(πh²/9)·dh/dt.
With h=6 and dh/dt=6, dV/dt=(π·36/9)·6=24π cm³/min.
Both rates are positive, consistent with increasing depth and volume.
pitfalls: Treating the tank's rim radius as the current water radius
Omitting h=3r
Dropping the factor 1/3 in cone volume
Using cm/min for a volume rate
solution.verification: Differentiating V=(1/3)πr²h directly and substituting r=2,h=6,r′=2,h′=6 also gives 24π.
solution.takeaway: For similar-container related rates, reduce the variables with geometry before differentiating in time.
solution.extension: If h=kr, then V=πh³/(3k²), and the same method gives its rate.

zh.title: 滑动梯子的线速度与角速度
zh.prompt: 一架 10 m 长的梯子靠墙，底端以 dx/dt=0.6 m/s 沿地面远离墙移动。设底端离墙为 x、顶端高度为 y、梯子与地面夹角为 θ。当 x=6 m 时，求 dy/dt 与 dθ/dt。

solution.analysis: 长度固定给出 x²+y²=100；角速度可由 x=10cosθ 求得。负号应与顶端下滑、夹角变小一致。
steps: 对 x²+y²=100 关于 t 求导，得到 2x dx/dt+2y dy/dt=0。
由 x=10cosθ，对 t 求导得 dx/dt=−10sinθ·dθ/dt。
两个负号分别表示梯顶下降与夹角减小。
pitfalls: 把梯长 10 当成随时间变化
求 y 时取负根
角速度单位漏写 rad/s
忽略负号的物理含义
solution.verification: 也可用 y=10sinθ 求导：dy/dt=10cosθ·θ′=10(0.6)(−0.075)=−0.45 m/s，与前式一致。
solution.takeaway: 相关变化率结果要同时通过第二条关系、符号和单位三重核对。
solution.extension: 若底端改为向墙移动，则 dx/dt<0，顶端速度和角速度的符号同时反转。

en.title: Linear and Angular Rates of a Sliding Ladder
en.prompt: A 10 m ladder leans against a wall. Its foot moves away from the wall at dx/dt=0.6 m/s. Let x be the foot's distance from the wall, y the top height, and θ the angle with the ground. When x=6 m, find dy/dt and dθ/dt.

solution.analysis: The fixed length gives x²+y²=100. The angular rate follows from x=10cosθ. Negative signs should match a falling top and decreasing angle.
steps: When x=6, x²+y²=100 gives y=√(100−36)=8 m.
Differentiate x²+y²=100 in time: 2x dx/dt+2y dy/dt=0.
Substitute x=6,y=8,dx/dt=0.6 to get dy/dt=−(6/8)(0.6)=−0.45 m/s.
From x=10cosθ, differentiation gives dx/dt=−10sinθ·dθ/dt.
The two negative signs indicate that the top falls and the angle decreases.
pitfalls: Treating the 10 m length as variable
Taking a negative height
Omitting rad/s for angular velocity
Ignoring the physical meaning of signs
solution.verification: Using y=10sinθ gives dy/dt=10cosθ·θ′=10(0.6)(−0.075)=−0.45 m/s, confirming the result.
solution.takeaway: Check a related-rate answer with a second relation, its sign, and its units.
solution.extension: If the foot moves toward the wall, dx/dt<0 and both the top rate and angular rate reverse sign.

zh.title: 可分隐式方程的一般导数公式
zh.prompt: 设 φ、ψ 可导，y=y(x) 满足 φ(x)+ψ(y)=C，并且 ψ′(y)≠0。证明 y′=−φ′(x)/ψ′(y)，并说明条件 ψ′(y)≠0 的作用。
zh.answer: 对等式求导得 φ′(x)+ψ′(y)y′=0；因 ψ′(y)≠0 可相除，故 y′=−φ′(x)/ψ′(y)。

solution.analysis: ψ(y) 是 ψ 与 y(x) 的复合。证明的唯一除法步骤需要 ψ′(y) 非零。
steps: 从恒等关系 φ(x)+ψ(y(x))=C 出发。
对 x 求导，φ(x) 给出 φ′(x)。
由链式法则，ψ(y(x)) 的导数为 ψ′(y)y′；常数 C 的导数为 0。
因 ψ′(y)≠0，可除以该量，得到 y′=−φ′(x)/ψ′(y)。
若 ψ′(y)=0，上述除法失效，有限的 y′ 未必存在，可能出现竖直切线或需更细分析。
pitfalls: 把 d[ψ(y)]/dx 写成 ψ′(y) 而漏掉 y′
未使用或未解释非零条件
把 C 当作 x 的函数
solution.verification: 取 φ(x)=x²、ψ(y)=y²、C=25，公式给 y′=−2x/(2y)=−x/y，与圆的隐式求导一致。
solution.takeaway: 一般隐函数公式来自一次链式求导；分母非零既保证代数可解，也对应局部有限斜率。
solution.extension: 若改求 x 对 y 的导数，并且 φ′(x)≠0，可对称得到 dx/dy=−ψ′(y)/φ′(x)。

en.title: A General Derivative Formula for a Separable Implicit Equation
en.prompt: Let φ and ψ be differentiable, and suppose y=y(x) satisfies φ(x)+ψ(y)=C with ψ′(y)≠0. Prove y′=−φ′(x)/ψ′(y), and explain the role of ψ′(y)≠0.
en.answer: Differentiation gives φ′(x)+ψ′(y)y′=0. Since ψ′(y)≠0, division yields y′=−φ′(x)/ψ′(y).

solution.analysis: The term ψ(y) is a composition of ψ with y(x). The only division in the proof requires ψ′(y) to be nonzero.
steps: Start with the identity φ(x)+ψ(y(x))=C.
Differentiate φ(x) to obtain φ′(x).
By the chain rule, d[ψ(y(x))]/dx=ψ′(y)y′, while dC/dx=0.
Therefore φ′(x)+ψ′(y)y′=0.
Since ψ′(y)≠0, divide to get y′=−φ′(x)/ψ′(y).
If ψ′(y)=0, this division fails; a finite y′ may not exist, and vertical behavior may require separate analysis.
pitfalls: Omitting y′ from d[ψ(y)]/dx
Failing to use or explain the nonzero condition
Treating C as a variable function
solution.verification: For φ(x)=x², ψ(y)=y², and C=25, the formula gives y′=−2x/(2y)=−x/y, matching the circle calculation.
solution.takeaway: The general implicit formula comes from one chain-rule differentiation; the nonzero denominator permits a finite local slope.
solution.extension: If x is differentiated with respect to y and φ′(x)≠0, symmetry gives dx/dy=−ψ′(y)/φ′(x).

zh.title: 圆面积的绝对与相对误差估计
zh.prompt: 圆的半径测得 r=10 cm，可能的绝对测量误差满足 |dr|≤0.02 cm。用微分估计面积 A=πr² 的最大绝对误差与最大相对误差。

solution.analysis: 面积微分 dA=2πrdr。取绝对值并使用给定的最大 |dr|，再除以 A 得相对误差。
steps: 面积函数为 A=πr²，因此 dA=2πrdr。
相对微分为 dA/A=(2πrdr)/(πr²)=2dr/r。
因此最大相对误差估计为 2|dr|/r=2·0.02/10=0.004。
把 0.004 化为百分比得到 0.4%。
pitfalls: 绝对误差忘记取绝对值
把面积误差单位写成 cm
使用直径代替半径
solution.verification: 量纲 2πrdr 为 cm²；相对误差无单位。半径相对误差为 0.2%，面积约为其 2 倍，即 0.4%。
solution.takeaway: 幂函数 y=x^n 的相对微分满足 dy/y=n·dx/x，可快速估计相对误差放大倍数。
solution.extension: 球体积 V=(4/3)πr³ 的相对误差估计为 |dV|/V≈3|dr|/r。

en.title: Absolute and Relative Error Estimates for a Circle's Area
en.prompt: A circle's radius is measured as r=10 cm with possible absolute measurement error |dr|≤0.02 cm. Use differentials to estimate the maximum absolute and relative errors in A=πr².

solution.analysis: Use dA=2πrdr. Take absolute values with the maximum |dr|, then divide by A for the relative error.
steps: For A=πr², the differential is dA=2πrdr.
At r=10 cm with |dr|≤0.02 cm, |dA|≈2π·10·0.02=0.4π cm².
The relative differential is dA/A=(2πrdr)/(πr²)=2dr/r.
Thus the maximum relative estimate is 2|dr|/r=2·0.02/10=0.004.
As a percentage, 0.004=0.4%.
pitfalls: Forgetting absolute values for maximum error
Using cm instead of cm²
Writing 0.004 as 4%
Using diameter in place of radius
solution.verification: The dimension of 2πrdr is cm², while relative error is dimensionless. A 0.2% radius error produces approximately a 0.4% area error.
solution.takeaway: For y=x^n, dy/y=n·dx/x, which quickly shows the relative-error amplification factor.
solution.extension: For V=(4/3)πr³, the relative error estimate is |dV|/V≈3|dr|/r.

zh.title: 近似倒数平方根
zh.prompt: 用 x₀=1 处的微分线性化近似计算 1/√0.98，并明确说明该方法是否给出严格误差界。
zh.answer: 1/√0.98≈1.01；本章的微分线性化只给出一阶近似，不自动提供严格误差界。

steps: 因此 1/√0.98≈1.01；这里只使用一阶线性化，没有得到严格的误差上界。
pitfalls: 忽略 Δx 为负
负幂求导指数错误
把近似号写成等号
虚构本章未证明的余项界
solution.verification: 计算 1.01²·0.98≈0.999698，接近 1，支持近似值合理；该核对不是严格误差证明。
solution.takeaway: 微分近似给出局部线性预测，合理性可数值核对，但严格误差控制需要额外理论。

en.title: Approximating a Reciprocal Square Root
en.prompt: Use differential linearization at x₀=1 to approximate 1/√0.98, and state whether this method provides a rigorous error bound.
en.answer: 1/√0.98≈1.01; differential linearization in this chapter gives a first-order approximation but no automatic rigorous error bound.

solution.analysis: Let f(x)=x^{−1/2}. The target 0.98 differs from the base point 1 by −0.02.
steps: Linearization gives f(0.98)≈f(1)+dy=1.01.
Therefore 1/√0.98≈1.01. First-order linearization alone does not supply a rigorous error bound.
pitfalls: Missing the negative sign of Δx
Differentiating the negative power incorrectly
Using equality instead of approximation
Inventing an unproved remainder bound
solution.verification: 1.01²·0.98≈0.999698, close to 1, supporting the approximation; this numerical check is not a rigorous error proof.
solution.takeaway: Differentials give a local linear prediction; numerical checks assess plausibility, while rigorous error control requires additional theory.
solution.extension: The same linearization gives 1/√1.03≈0.985.

zh.title: 五次幂的线性预测与实际偏差
zh.prompt: 设 y=x⁵。用 x₀=1、dx=0.02 的微分近似 (1.02)⁵，并给出预测的相对增量。再用直接乘法得到精确值 1.1040808032，计算近似值与精确值之差，并解释为什么这不构成本章中的误差上界。

solution.analysis: 基点函数值为 1，故绝对微分与相对微分数值相同。精确差值可事后比较，但单个样本差值不是对邻域内所有点的误差上界。
steps: 对 y=x⁵，有 dy=5x⁴dx；在 x₀=1、dx=0.02 时，dy=5·1⁴·0.02=0.10。
相对微分 dy/y=5dx/x；在 x=1 时为 5·0.02=0.10，即约 10%。
这个差值只描述本次输入的实际偏差，不能自动推出其他增量下都小于该数。
本章微分线性化未提供统一余项估计，因此应把 1.10 写成近似值而非带严格误差界的结论。
pitfalls: 将近似值 1.10 写成精确等式
把事后差值当作普遍误差上界
忘记基点 y=1
solution.takeaway: 微分给一阶预测；实际差值可以评价这一次近似，却不能代替一般的误差理论。
solution.extension: 把 dx 改为 0.01 时，线性预测为 1.05，可再直接乘法观察增量减半后偏差如何变化。

en.title: Linear Prediction and Actual Discrepancy for a Fifth Power
en.prompt: Let y=x⁵. Using x₀=1 and dx=0.02, approximate (1.02)⁵ by differentials and give the predicted relative increment. Then use the exact value 1.1040808032 from direct multiplication to find exact minus approximate, and explain why this is not an error bound supplied by this chapter.
en.answer: (1.02)⁵≈1.10; the relative increment is about 0.10=10%; exact minus approximate is 0.0040808032.

solution.analysis: The base value is 1, so the numerical absolute and relative differentials coincide. A post hoc discrepancy at one input is not a uniform bound over a neighborhood.
steps: For y=x⁵, dy=5x⁴dx. At x₀=1 with dx=0.02, dy=5·1⁴·0.02=0.10.
The linear approximation is (1.02)⁵≈1⁵+0.10=1.10.
The relative differential is dy/y=5dx/x=5·0.02=0.10, or about 10%.
Using the given exact value, exact minus approximate is 1.1040808032−1.10=0.0040808032.
This difference describes only this input and does not show that all nearby errors are below the same number.
Linearization in this chapter supplies no uniform remainder estimate here, so 1.10 remains an approximation without a rigorous bound.
pitfalls: Writing 10% as 0.10%
Using equality for 1.10
Treating a post hoc discrepancy as a general bound
Forgetting that the base value is 1
solution.verification: Direct multiplication gives (1.02)²=1.0404, (1.02)⁴=1.08243216, and then 1.1040808032.
solution.takeaway: A differential gives a first-order prediction; the observed discrepancy evaluates one case but does not replace an error theory.
solution.extension: With dx=0.01, the linear prediction is 1.05; direct multiplication can be used to observe how the discrepancy changes.

zh.title: 参数幂尖点的完整判定
zh.prompt: 判断正误并证明：对 α>0，函数 f_α(x)=|x|^α 在 x=0 处可导，当且仅当 α>1；可导时 f′_α(0)=0。

solution.analysis: 原点差商恰好是 |h|^α/h。按 α-1 的正、零、负三种情形讨论，就能同时证明充分性和必要性。
steps: 由 f_α(0)=0，原点差商为 |h|^α/h=sgn(h)|h|^{α-1}。
若 α>1，则 |sgn(h)|h|^{α-1}|=|h|^{α-1}→0，所以双侧极限存在且 f′_α(0)=0。
若 α=1，则 h→0⁺ 时差商为 1，h→0⁻ 时为 -1，左右极限不等。
若 0<α<1，则 h→0⁺ 时差商 h^{α-1} 无界增大，而 h→0⁻ 时为 -|h|^{α-1}，不存在有限双侧极限。
三种情形穷尽 α>0，因此可导当且仅当 α>1，且导数必为 0。
pitfalls: 只证明 α>1 时可导而未证明其他参数不行
在 α=1 时把左右符号忽略
把无界差商误当成有限导数
solution.verification: α=2 给出 x²，在 0 导数为 0；α=1 给出 |x| 的尖角；α=1/2 给出更陡的根式尖点，均与分类一致。
solution.takeaway: 参数型可导问题常由差商中的临界指数决定；这里临界值正是 α=1。
solution.extension: 若改为 c|x|^α（c≠0），可导的参数范围不变，只是非零点导数按 c 缩放。

en.title: Complete Classification of a Parameterized Power Corner
en.prompt: Decide whether the statement is true and prove it: for α>0, f_α(x)=|x|^α is differentiable at x=0 if and only if α>1; when differentiable, f′_α(0)=0.

solution.analysis: The origin quotient is exactly |h|^α/h. Splitting according to whether α-1 is positive, zero, or negative proves both sufficiency and necessity.
steps: Since f_α(0)=0, the origin quotient is |h|^α/h=sgn(h)|h|^{α-1}.
If α>1, its absolute value is |h|^{α-1}→0, so the two-sided limit exists and f′_α(0)=0.
If α=1, the quotient is 1 for h→0⁺ and -1 for h→0⁻, so the one-sided limits differ.
If 0<α<1, the quotient h^{α-1} grows without bound for h→0⁺ and equals -|h|^{α-1} for h→0⁻, so no finite two-sided limit exists.
These cases exhaust α>0, proving differentiability exactly for α>1, with derivative 0.
pitfalls: proving only sufficiency for α>1
ignoring the opposite signs when α=1
treating an unbounded quotient as a finite derivative
solution.verification: For α=2 the function is x² and has derivative 0 at 0; α=1 gives the corner |x|; α=1/2 gives an even steeper radical corner, matching the classification.
solution.takeaway: In a parameterized differentiability problem, a critical exponent in the difference quotient often controls the answer; here it is α=1.
solution.extension: For c|x|^α with c≠0, the differentiability range is unchanged; derivatives away from the corner are simply scaled by c.

zh.title: 割线趋稳而邻近切线失控
zh.prompt: 设 f(x)={x²sin(1/x²), x≠0; 0, x=0}。(1) 证明 f 在 0 连续；(2) 证明 f 在 0 可导并写出原点切线；(3) 求 x≠0 时的 f′(x)；(4) 构造 x_n→0⁺，说明 f′(x) 在 0 不连续。
zh.answer: f 在 0 连续且 f′(0)=0，原点切线 y=0；x≠0 时 f′(x)=2x sin(1/x²)-(2/x)cos(1/x²)；可取 x_n=(1/(2πn))^{1/2}

solution.analysis: 函数值与原点差商分别由 x²、|x| 控制，因此连续且可导；但非零点导数含 1/x 放大项，可沿特定数列显示其无界。
steps: 由 |f(x)|=|x²sin(1/x²)|≤x²→0=f(0)，故 f 在 0 连续。
原点差商为 f(h)/h=h sin(1/h²)，绝对值不超过 |h|，所以 f′(0)=0；切点为 (0,0)，切线为 y=0。
当 x≠0 时，乘积与链式法则给出 f′(x)=2x sin(1/x²)+x²cos(1/x²)(-2/x³)=2x sin(1/x²)-(2/x)cos(1/x²)。
于是 f′(x_n)=-2/x_n→-∞，不可能趋于 f′(0)=0；所以导函数在 0 不连续，尽管原点切线确实存在。
pitfalls: 从 sin(1/x²) 振荡直接误判 f 不连续
用 x≠0 的导数公式代入 0
只说 f′ 振荡而不给能验证的数列
solution.verification: 割线斜率 f(x)/x=x sin(1/x²) 被 |x| 控制而趋于 0；所构造数列上的邻近切线斜率却趋于 -∞，两种结论并不矛盾。
solution.takeaway: 某点可导只控制通向该点的割线斜率，不保证附近各点的导数趋于该点导数。
solution.extension: 比较 x²sin(1/x) 与本题函数，观察振荡频率改变后非零点导数中放大因子的差异。

en.title: Stable Secants but Uncontrolled Nearby Tangents
en.prompt: Let f(x)={x²sin(1/x²), x≠0; 0, x=0}. (1) Prove continuity at 0. (2) Prove differentiability at 0 and write the tangent there. (3) Find f′(x) for x≠0. (4) Construct x_n→0⁺ showing that f′ is not continuous at 0.
en.answer: f is continuous at 0 with f′(0)=0 and tangent y=0; for x≠0, f′(x)=2x sin(1/x²)-(2/x)cos(1/x²); one may take x_n=(1/(2πn))^{1/2}

knowledge: disproving a limit by a sequence
solution.analysis: The function value and the origin quotient are controlled by x² and |x|, so continuity and differentiability hold. However, the nonzero-point derivative contains a 1/x amplification, which becomes unbounded along a selected sequence.
steps: Since |f(x)|=|x²sin(1/x²)|≤x²→0=f(0), f is continuous at 0.
The origin quotient is f(h)/h=h sin(1/h²), whose absolute value is at most |h|. Thus f′(0)=0, and the tangent through (0,0) is y=0.
For x≠0, the product and chain rules give f′(x)=2x sin(1/x²)+x²cos(1/x²)(-2/x³)=2x sin(1/x²)-(2/x)cos(1/x²).
Take x_n=(1/(2πn))^{1/2}. Then x_n→0⁺, 1/x_n²=2πn, sin(2πn)=0, and cos(2πn)=1.
Hence f′(x_n)=-2/x_n→-∞, so it cannot tend to f′(0)=0. Therefore f′ is not continuous at 0 even though the tangent there exists.
pitfalls: declaring f discontinuous merely because sin(1/x²) oscillates
substituting 0 into the derivative formula valid only for x≠0
claiming oscillation without supplying a verifiable sequence
solution.verification: The secant slope f(x)/x=x sin(1/x²) is bounded by |x| and tends to 0, while the nearby tangent slopes along the constructed sequence tend to -∞; these facts are compatible.
solution.takeaway: Differentiability at one point controls secants ending at that point, not convergence of derivatives at nearby points.
solution.extension: Compare x²sin(1/x) with the present function and observe how changing the oscillation rate changes the amplification term in the nonzero-point derivative.

zh.title: 多法则嵌套后的结构化简
zh.prompt: 求 y=arctan[(eˣ-1)/(eˣ+1)] 的导数，并将结果化为不含复合分式的形式。

solution.analysis: 先令 u=(eˣ-1)/(eˣ+1)，使用 y′=u′/(1+u²)。u′ 与 1+u² 具有相同的分母，约去后结果会显著简化。
steps: 设 u=(eˣ-1)/(eˣ+1)，则 y=arctan u，且 y′=u′/(1+u²)。
由商法则，u′=[eˣ(eˣ+1)-(eˣ-1)eˣ]/(eˣ+1)²=2eˣ/(eˣ+1)²。
由于 eˣ+1>0 且 e^{2x}+1>0，原函数与导数对所有 x∈R 都有定义。
pitfalls: 把 (arctan u)′ 写成 1/(1+u)
商法则中漏掉两个 eˣ 项
未先通分 1+u² 就进行错误约分
solution.takeaway: 嵌套求导后不要急于展开；寻找 u′ 与 1+u² 的公共结构可大幅简化。
solution.extension: 把 eˣ 换成任意正函数 w(x)，可按同一结构求 arctan[(w-1)/(w+1)] 的导数。

en.title: Structural Simplification after Nested Rules
en.prompt: Differentiate y=arctan[(eˣ-1)/(eˣ+1)], and simplify the result so that it contains no compound fraction.

solution.analysis: Set u=(eˣ-1)/(eˣ+1) and use y′=u′/(1+u²). The expressions u′ and 1+u² share the same denominator, which cancels cleanly.
steps: Let u=(eˣ-1)/(eˣ+1), so y=arctan u and y′=u′/(1+u²).
By the quotient rule, u′=[eˣ(eˣ+1)-(eˣ-1)eˣ]/(eˣ+1)²=2eˣ/(eˣ+1)².
Dividing gives y′={2eˣ/(eˣ+1)²}/{2(e^{2x}+1)/(eˣ+1)²}=eˣ/(e^{2x}+1).
Because eˣ+1>0 and e^{2x}+1>0, both the function and its derivative are defined for every x∈R.
pitfalls: using 1/(1+u) as the derivative of arctan u
losing exponential terms in the quotient rule
canceling incorrectly before placing 1+u² over a common denominator
solution.verification: At x=0, u=0 and u′=1/2, so y′(0)=1/2. The simplified formula also gives 1/(1+1)=1/2.
solution.takeaway: After nested differentiation, look for shared structure before expanding; here the denominators of u′ and 1+u² cancel completely.
solution.extension: Replace eˣ by any positive differentiable function w(x) and apply the same structure to arctan[(w-1)/(w+1)].

zh.title: 从定义证明反函数求导公式
zh.prompt: 设 f 在 x₀ 的某邻域 U 上一一对应，其值域包含 y₀=f(x₀) 的一个邻域，并在该值域上有反函数 x=g(y)。已知 f 在 x₀ 可导、f′(x₀)≠0，并且 y→y₀ 时 g(y)→x₀。证明 g′(y₀)=1/f′(x₀)。

solution.analysis: 反函数的 y 增量与原函数的 x 增量描述同一对点。把 g 的差商写成 f 的差商的倒数，并利用 f′(x₀)≠0。
steps: 令 Δy=y-y₀，且 Δx=g(y)-g(y₀)=g(y)-x₀；因 g 是反函数，有 Δy=f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)。
当 y→y₀ 时，由题设 Δx→0；并且在 y≠y₀ 时，反函数的单值性保证 Δx≠0。
反函数差商可写为 [g(y)-g(y₀)]/(y-y₀)=Δx/[f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)]。
将其写成倒数：Δx/[f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)]={ [f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)]/Δx }⁻¹。
括号内当 Δx→0 时趋于 f′(x₀)≠0，所以倒数极限存在并等于 1/f′(x₀)，即 g′(y₀)=1/f′(x₀)。
pitfalls: 把反函数与倒数函数混淆
未说明 Δy→0 会使对应 Δx→0
在 f′(x₀)=0 时仍擅自取倒数
solution.verification: 若 f(x)=3x+2，则 g(y)=(y-2)/3；公式给出 g′=1/3，与直接求导一致。
solution.takeaway: 反函数求导公式本质上是同一局部变化率从“Δy/Δx”切换到“Δx/Δy”。
solution.extension: 在具体题中应先定位对应点 x₀=g(y₀)，再使用该公式，而不是把 y₀ 直接代入 f′。

en.title: Prove the Inverse-Function Derivative Formula from First Principles
en.prompt: Suppose f is one-to-one on a neighborhood U of x₀, its image contains a neighborhood of y₀=f(x₀), and it has inverse x=g(y) on that image. Assume f is differentiable at x₀, f′(x₀)≠0, and g(y)→x₀ as y→y₀. Prove g′(y₀)=1/f′(x₀).

knowledge: reciprocal law for a nonzero limit
solution.analysis: The y-increment for the inverse and the x-increment for the original function describe the same pair of points. Rewrite the quotient for g as the reciprocal of the quotient for f and use f′(x₀)≠0.
steps: Let Δy=y-y₀ and Δx=g(y)-g(y₀)=g(y)-x₀. Since g is the inverse, Δy=f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀).
As y→y₀, the assumption gives Δx→0. For y≠y₀, the single-valued inverse relation also gives Δx≠0.
The inverse difference quotient is [g(y)-g(y₀)]/(y-y₀)=Δx/[f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)].
Rewrite it as a reciprocal: Δx/[f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)]={ [f(x₀+Δx)-f(x₀)]/Δx }⁻¹.
The expression in braces tends to f′(x₀)≠0 as Δx→0, so the reciprocal tends to 1/f′(x₀). Hence g′(y₀)=1/f′(x₀).
pitfalls: confusing an inverse function with a reciprocal function
not explaining why Δy→0 makes the corresponding Δx→0
taking a reciprocal even when f′(x₀)=0
solution.verification: For f(x)=3x+2, the inverse is g(y)=(y-2)/3. The formula gives g′=1/3, agreeing with direct differentiation.
solution.takeaway: The inverse derivative formula switches the same local rate from Δy/Δx to its reciprocal Δx/Δy.
solution.extension: In an application, first locate x₀=g(y₀); do not substitute y₀ directly into f′.

zh.title: 三次多项式与指数函数乘积的 n 阶导数
zh.prompt: 设 y=x³e²ˣ。求 n≥3 时的 y⁽ⁿ⁾，答案中不保留求和号。

solution.analysis: 把 n 次求导分配给 x³ 与 e²ˣ。x³ 的四阶导数为零，因此只需写出分配给多项式 0、1、2、3 次的四项。
steps: 由乘积高阶导数公式，y⁽ⁿ⁾=Σ_{k=0}ⁿC(n,k)(x³)⁽ᵏ⁾(e²ˣ)⁽ⁿ⁻ᵏ⁾。
有 (x³)⁽⁰⁾=x³、(x³)′=3x²、(x³)″=6x、(x³)‴=6，且 k≥4 时为 0。
同时 (e²ˣ)⁽ᵐ⁾=2ᵐe²ˣ，所以只保留 k=0,1,2,3。
四项依次为 2ⁿx³e²ˣ、3n2ⁿ⁻¹x²e²ˣ、6C(n,2)2ⁿ⁻²xe²ˣ、6C(n,3)2ⁿ⁻³e²ˣ。
利用 6C(n,2)=3n(n−1)、6C(n,3)=n(n−1)(n−2)，提取 e²ˣ 即得答案。
条件 n≥3 保证四项中的阶数与二项式系数均按所写形式适用。
pitfalls: 把指数项写成 2ᵏ而不是 2ⁿ⁻ᵏ
漏掉二项式系数
x³ 的三阶导数误写成 3
solution.verification: 取 n=3，公式给 e²ˣ(8x³+36x²+36x+6)；从 y″=e²ˣ(4x³+12x²+6x) 再求一次导数也得到该式。
solution.takeaway: 多项式乘指数函数的 n 阶导数是有限和，项数由多项式次数决定而不随 n 增长。
solution.extension: 把 x³ 替换为任意三次多项式，可利用线性性对各幂次分别套用同一结构。

en.title: The nth Derivative of a Cubic Times an Exponential
en.prompt: Let y=x³e²ˣ. For n≥3, find y⁽ⁿ⁾ with no summation sign in the answer.

solution.analysis: Distribute the n differentiations between x³ and e²ˣ. The fourth derivative of x³ is zero, so only the cases of assigning 0, 1, 2, or 3 derivatives to the polynomial remain.
steps: The higher product formula gives y⁽ⁿ⁾=Σ_{k=0}ⁿC(n,k)(x³)⁽ᵏ⁾(e²ˣ)⁽ⁿ⁻ᵏ⁾.
We have (x³)⁽⁰⁾=x³, (x³)′=3x², (x³)″=6x, (x³)‴=6, and all terms with k≥4 vanish.
Also, (e²ˣ)⁽ᵐ⁾=2ᵐe²ˣ, so retain only k=0,1,2,3.
The four terms are 2ⁿx³e²ˣ, 3n2ⁿ⁻¹x²e²ˣ, 6C(n,2)2ⁿ⁻²xe²ˣ, and 6C(n,3)2ⁿ⁻³e²ˣ.
Use 6C(n,2)=3n(n−1) and 6C(n,3)=n(n−1)(n−2), then factor out e²ˣ to obtain the answer.
The condition n≥3 makes all four displayed terms and coefficients directly applicable.
pitfalls: Using 2ᵏ instead of 2ⁿ⁻ᵏ
Omitting the binomial coefficients
Writing the third derivative of x³ as 3
solution.verification: At n=3, the formula gives e²ˣ(8x³+36x²+36x+6); differentiating y″=e²ˣ(4x³+12x²+6x) once more gives the same result.
solution.takeaway: The nth derivative of a polynomial times an exponential is a finite sum whose number of terms is controlled by the polynomial degree.
solution.extension: For any cubic polynomial in place of x³, apply the same structure termwise by linearity.

zh.title: 归纳证明乘积的高阶导数公式
zh.prompt: 设 u、v 具有所需阶导数。用数学归纳法证明：对 n≥0，(uv)⁽ⁿ⁾=Σ_{k=0}ⁿC(n,k)u⁽ᵏ⁾v⁽ⁿ⁻ᵏ⁾。
zh.answer: 公式成立；归纳步骤对求和逐项求导，并用 C(n,k)+C(n,k−1)=C(n+1,k) 合并同类项。

solution.analysis: 对 n 阶公式求导时，每一项产生两项。把所有含 u⁽ᵏ⁾v⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁻ᵏ⁾ 的项对齐后，相邻二项式系数恰好相加为下一行系数。
steps: 当 n=0 时，右边只有 C(0,0)uv=uv，与左边相同，起点成立。
假设 n 阶公式成立，即 (uv)⁽ⁿ⁾=Σ_{k=0}ⁿC(n,k)u⁽ᵏ⁾v⁽ⁿ⁻ᵏ⁾。
两边求导，每项用乘积法则，得到 Σ_{k=0}ⁿC(n,k)[u⁽ᵏ⁺¹⁾v⁽ⁿ⁻ᵏ⁾+u⁽ᵏ⁾v⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁻ᵏ⁾]。
将第一组求和改指标 j=k+1，它覆盖 j=1,…,n+1；第二组覆盖 j=0,…,n。
端点 j=0、n+1 的系数均为 1；中间项系数为 C(n,j−1)+C(n,j)=C(n+1,j)。
因此 (uv)⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁾=Σ_{j=0}ⁿ⁺¹C(n+1,j)u⁽ʲ⁾v⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁻ʲ⁾，即 n+1 阶公式。
由数学归纳法，结论对所有 n≥0 成立。
pitfalls: 改指标后求和上下限不随之改变
忽略两个端点项
把二项式系数递推的两个下标写反
solution.verification: 令 n=2，公式给 u″v+2u′v′+uv″，与对普通乘积法则再求一次导数完全一致。
solution.takeaway: 莱布尼茨公式中的二项式系数来自每次求导在两个因子间分配的组合数。
solution.extension: 若 u 是 m 次多项式，则 u⁽ᵏ⁾在 k>m 时为 0，公式自动截断为至多 m+1 项。

en.title: Inductive Proof of the Higher Product Formula
en.prompt: Suppose u and v have the required derivatives. Prove by induction that for n≥0, (uv)⁽ⁿ⁾=Σ_{k=0}ⁿC(n,k)u⁽ᵏ⁾v⁽ⁿ⁻ᵏ⁾.
en.answer: The formula holds. Differentiate the sum termwise and combine coefficients using C(n,k)+C(n,k−1)=C(n+1,k).

solution.analysis: Differentiating the nth-order formula splits every term into two. After aligning all terms of the form u⁽ᵏ⁾v⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁻ᵏ⁾, neighboring binomial coefficients combine into the next row.
steps: For n=0, the right side is the single term C(0,0)uv=uv, so the base case holds.
Assume (uv)⁽ⁿ⁾=Σ_{k=0}ⁿC(n,k)u⁽ᵏ⁾v⁽ⁿ⁻ᵏ⁾.
Differentiate termwise and apply the product rule to obtain Σ_{k=0}ⁿC(n,k)[u⁽ᵏ⁺¹⁾v⁽ⁿ⁻ᵏ⁾+u⁽ᵏ⁾v⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁻ᵏ⁾].
Reindex the first sum with j=k+1, which covers j=1,…,n+1; the second covers j=0,…,n.
The endpoint coefficients at j=0 and j=n+1 are 1, while each interior coefficient is C(n,j−1)+C(n,j)=C(n+1,j).
Hence (uv)⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁾=Σ_{j=0}ⁿ⁺¹C(n+1,j)u⁽ʲ⁾v⁽ⁿ⁺¹⁻ʲ⁾, the desired formula at n+1.
Mathematical induction proves the result for all n≥0.
pitfalls: Failing to change summation bounds after reindexing
Omitting the two endpoint terms
Reversing the subscripts in the binomial recurrence
solution.verification: At n=2, the formula gives u″v+2u′v′+uv″, exactly what results from differentiating the ordinary product rule once more.
solution.takeaway: The binomial coefficients in the Leibniz formula count the ways to distribute differentiations between two factors.
solution.extension: If u is a degree-m polynomial, u⁽ᵏ⁾=0 for k>m, so the formula automatically truncates to at most m+1 terms.

zh.title: 诊断被遗漏的重复链式因子
zh.prompt: 学生对 y=ln(2x−1)（x>1/2）写道：y⁽ⁿ⁾=(−1)ⁿ⁻¹(n−1)!/(2x−1)ⁿ。指出错误发生在哪里，给出正确公式，并至少检验 n=1、2。
zh.answer: 错误是每一阶都漏乘内层导数 2；正确公式为 y⁽ⁿ⁾=(−1)ⁿ⁻¹(n−1)!2ⁿ/(2x−1)ⁿ。

solution.analysis: 一次求导产生一个因子 2；之后每次对 (2x−1) 的负幂求导又产生一个因子 2，所以 n 阶应累计 2ⁿ，而不是只改分母幂次。
steps: 直接求一阶导数：y′=2/(2x−1)，学生公式在 n=1 时只给 1/(2x−1)，已暴露漏因子。
再求一次得 y″=−4/(2x−1)²；这里第二个因子 2 来自再次使用链式法则。
设 u=2x−1，则 y=ln u，而关于 u 的 n 阶导数为 (−1)ⁿ⁻¹(n−1)!/uⁿ。
因为 u 是线性函数，每一次关于 x 的求导都把关于 u 的导数再乘 du/dx=2，共累计 2ⁿ。
代入 n=1、2 分别恢复 2/(2x−1) 与 −4/(2x−1)²，检验通过。
pitfalls: 认为内层导数只在第一阶出现一次
把累计因子误写成 2n
只看符号与分母幂而忽略系数
solution.verification: 取 x=1，正确公式给 y′(1)=2，而由定义对 ln(1+2h) 的差商也得到 2；错误公式只给 1。
solution.takeaway: 线性复合函数的 n 阶导数会累计 n 个相同的内层斜率因子。
solution.extension: 对 ln(ax+b)，正确公式为 (−1)ⁿ⁻¹(n−1)!aⁿ/(ax+b)ⁿ。

en.title: Diagnosing a Missing Repeated Chain Factor
en.prompt: For y=ln(2x−1), x>1/2, a student writes y⁽ⁿ⁾=(−1)ⁿ⁻¹(n−1)!/(2x−1)ⁿ. Identify the error, give the correct formula, and check at least n=1 and n=2.
en.answer: The student misses a factor 2 at every order. The correct formula is y⁽ⁿ⁾=(−1)ⁿ⁻¹(n−1)!2ⁿ/(2x−1)ⁿ.

solution.analysis: The first derivative contributes one factor 2, and each later differentiation of a negative power of 2x−1 contributes another. Thus the nth derivative contains 2ⁿ.
steps: Directly, y′=2/(2x−1); the student's n=1 formula gives only 1/(2x−1), revealing the missing factor.
Differentiating again gives y″=−4/(2x−1)², with another factor 2 from the chain rule.
Set u=2x−1. The nth derivative of ln u with respect to u is (−1)ⁿ⁻¹(n−1)!/uⁿ.
Because u is linear, each differentiation with respect to x multiplies the corresponding u-derivative by du/dx=2, giving 2ⁿ in total.
Therefore y⁽ⁿ⁾=(−1)ⁿ⁻¹(n−1)!2ⁿ/(2x−1)ⁿ.
For n=1 and n=2 this gives 2/(2x−1) and −4/(2x−1)², confirming the formula.
pitfalls: Including the inner derivative only at the first order
Replacing the accumulated factor 2ⁿ by 2n
Checking signs and powers but ignoring coefficients
solution.verification: At x=1, the correct formula gives y′(1)=2; the defining difference quotient for ln(1+2h) also gives 2, while the student's formula gives 1.
solution.takeaway: For a linear composite, the same inner slope factor accumulates once per derivative order.
solution.extension: For ln(ax+b), the formula is (−1)ⁿ⁻¹(n−1)!aⁿ/(ax+b)ⁿ.

zh.title: 三次隐式曲线的二阶导数
zh.prompt: 曲线 x³+y³=6xy 通过点 (3,3)。求该点的 y′ 与 y″。

solution.analysis: 先求一阶关系并在点处得到 y′；第二次求导时 y²y′、xy′ 都是乘积，必须逐项展开。
steps: 一次求导得 3x²+3y²y′=6y+6xy′。
对一阶关系再求导：6x+6y(y′)²+3y²y″=6y′+6(y′+xy″)。
右侧合并为 12y′+6xy″。
pitfalls: 把 d(3y²y′)/dx 漏成 3y²y″
右侧 6xy′ 求导漏掉 6y′
一阶导数符号错误传递到二阶
solution.takeaway: 复杂隐式二阶求导要把每个含 y′ 的乘积逐项列出，避免心算漏项。
solution.extension: 可在其他非奇异点重复同一流程；若一阶关系中 y′ 的系数为 0，应先检查局部切线方向。

en.title: Second Derivative of a Cubic Implicit Curve
en.prompt: The curve x³+y³=6xy passes through (3,3). Find y′ and y″ at that point.

solution.analysis: First obtain the derivative relation and y′ at the point. In the second differentiation, both y²y′ and xy′ are products.
steps: Differentiate once: 3x²+3y²y′=6y+6xy′.
Differentiate again: 6x+6y(y′)²+3y²y″=6y′+6(y′+xy″).
The right side simplifies to 12y′+6xy″.
Substitute x=3,y=3,y′=−1 to get 18+18+27y″=−12+18y″.
pitfalls: Omitting 6y(y′)² from d(3y²y′)/dx
Dropping a 6y′ term from d(6xy′)/dx
Carrying an incorrect sign for y′
solution.verification: (3,3) satisfies 27+27=54. In the second derivative equation, both sides become −108 after substitution.
solution.takeaway: For a complicated second implicit derivative, list every product-rule contribution explicitly.
solution.extension: The same procedure works at other nonsingular points; if the coefficient of y′ vanishes, first inspect the local tangent direction.

zh.title: 推导参数二阶导数公式
zh.prompt: 设 x=x(t)、y=y(t) 二阶可导且 x′(t)≠0。证明 d²y/dx²=[x′(t)y″(t)−y′(t)x″(t)]/[x′(t)]³。
zh.answer: 由 dy/dx=y′(t)/x′(t)，再用 d/dx=[1/x′(t)]d/dt 与商法则即可得到公式。

knowledge: d/dx 与 d/dt 的关系
solution.analysis: 先把 dy/dx 看成 t 的函数。对 x 求导等于先对 t 求导，再除以 dx/dt。
steps: 因 x′(t)≠0，一阶参数导数为 dy/dx=y′(t)/x′(t)。
