对任何可导的 t 函数 H(t)，有 dH/dx=(dH/dt)/(dx/dt)=H′(t)/x′(t)。
令 H(t)=y′(t)/x′(t)，则 d²y/dx²=(1/x′)·d/dt[y′/x′]。
由商法则，d/dt[y′/x′]=[y″x′−y′x″]/(x′)²。
再乘 1/x′，得到 d²y/dx²=[x′y″−y′x″]/(x′)³。
所有除法均依赖 x′(t)≠0，公式得证。
pitfalls: 把二阶导数误写成 y″(t)/x″(t)
商法则分子次序颠倒
最后漏乘 1/x′
未说明 x′≠0
solution.verification: 代入 x=t²+1、y=t³：分子 (2t)(6t)−(3t²)(2)=6t²，分母 8t³，得到 3/(4t)，与直接计算一致。
solution.takeaway: 参数二阶导数包含两次变量转换，因此分母最终出现 [x′(t)]³。
solution.extension: 该公式只描述 x′≠0 的普通点；x′=0 时不能直接套用。

en.title: Deriving the Second Parametric Derivative Formula
en.prompt: Let x=x(t) and y=y(t) be twice differentiable with x′(t)≠0. Prove d²y/dx²=[x′(t)y″(t)−y′(t)x″(t)]/[x′(t)]³.
en.answer: Start from dy/dx=y′(t)/x′(t), then use d/dx=[1/x′(t)]d/dt and the quotient rule.

solution.analysis: Treat dy/dx as a function of t. Differentiating with respect to x means differentiating in t and then dividing by dx/dt.
steps: Since x′(t)≠0, dy/dx=y′(t)/x′(t).
For any differentiable H(t), dH/dx=(dH/dt)/(dx/dt)=H′(t)/x′(t).
With H(t)=y′(t)/x′(t), d²y/dx²=(1/x′)·d/dt[y′/x′].
The quotient rule gives d/dt[y′/x′]=[y″x′−y′x″]/(x′)².
Multiplying by 1/x′ yields d²y/dx²=[x′y″−y′x″]/(x′)³.
Every division uses x′(t)≠0, completing the proof.
pitfalls: Using y″(t)/x″(t)
Reversing the quotient-rule numerator
Forgetting the final factor 1/x′
Omitting x′≠0
solution.verification: For x=t²+1,y=t³, the formula gives [(2t)(6t)−(3t²)(2)]/(2t)³=3/(4t), matching the direct result.
solution.takeaway: A second parametric derivative converts variables twice, which creates the cube [x′(t)]³ in the denominator.
solution.extension: The formula applies only where x′≠0; points with x′=0 require separate analysis.

zh.title: 诊断圆锥水面半径被冻结的错误
zh.prompt: 倒置圆锥容器高 9 m、口半径 3 m。水深 h 以 0.2 m/min 上升；当 h=3 m 时求水体积变化率。某同学把水体半径直接取为容器口半径 3 m，写 V=(1/3)π·3²h，得到 dV/dt=0.6π m³/min。指出错误并给出正确结果。
zh.answer: 水面半径随 h 变化，不能固定为 3 m。由 r/h=1/3，V=πh³/27，故在 h=3 m 时 dV/dt=0.2π m³/min。

solution.analysis: 3 m 是容器满口半径，不是任意水深下的水面半径。错误本质是把随时间变化的 r 冻结成常数。
steps: 容器高与口半径之比为 9:3=3:1；水体与容器相似，所以 r/h=1/3。
因此当前水面半径 r=h/3，而不是始终等于 3 m。
代入圆锥体积 V=(1/3)πr²h，得 V=(1/3)π(h²/9)h=πh³/27。
对时间求导：dV/dt=(πh²/9)dh/dt。
代入 h=3 m 与 dh/dt=0.2 m/min，得 dV/dt=(π·9/9)(0.2)=0.2π m³/min。
原解 0.6π 高估了体积率，因为它使用了只有水满到 h=9 m 时才达到的半径 3 m。
pitfalls: 混淆容器固定尺寸与水体瞬时尺寸
先代入数值后把变量错误视为常数
漏掉相似关系
未检查 m³/min 量纲
solution.verification: 当 h=3 m 时正确水面半径为 1 m；直接用多变量公式 dV/dt=(π/3)[2rhr′+r²h′]，其中 r′=h′/3，也得到 0.2π。
solution.takeaway: 相关变化率错解常源于冻结一个仍在变化的几何量；先标明每个量是否随时间变化。
solution.extension: 若容器是圆柱，横截面半径才是固定的，此时可以直接使用 V=πR²h。

en.title: Diagnosing a Frozen Water-Surface Radius
en.prompt: An inverted conical tank is 9 m high with rim radius 3 m. The water depth rises at 0.2 m/min. Find the volume rate when h=3 m. A student fixes the water radius at 3 m, writes V=(1/3)π·3²h, and obtains dV/dt=0.6π m³/min. Diagnose the error and give the correct result.
en.answer: The water-surface radius changes with h and cannot be fixed at 3 m. Since r/h=1/3, V=πh³/27, so at h=3 m, dV/dt=0.2π m³/min.

solution.analysis: The 3 m radius belongs to the full rim, not to every water depth. The error freezes the time-dependent radius r as a constant.
steps: The tank height-to-radius ratio is 9:3=3:1. Similarity gives r/h=1/3.
Thus the current water radius is r=h/3, not always 3 m.
Substitute into V=(1/3)πr²h to get V=(1/3)π(h²/9)h=πh³/27.
Differentiate: dV/dt=(πh²/9)dh/dt.
At h=3 m and dh/dt=0.2 m/min, dV/dt=(π·9/9)(0.2)=0.2π m³/min.
The student's 0.6π is too large because radius 3 m occurs only when the water reaches h=9 m.
pitfalls: Confusing fixed tank dimensions with instantaneous water dimensions
Freezing a variable by early substitution
Omitting similarity
Failing to check m³/min
solution.verification: At h=3 m, r=1 m. Direct differentiation of V=(π/3)r²h with r′=h′/3 also gives 0.2π.
solution.takeaway: A common related-rate error is freezing a geometric quantity that still varies with time; identify every time-dependent variable first.
solution.extension: For a cylinder, the cross-sectional radius is fixed, so V=πR²h may be used directly.

zh.title: 增量线性分解与导数的充要关系
zh.prompt: 证明：一元函数 f 在 x₀ 可导，当且仅当存在常数 A，使 Δy=AΔx+o(Δx)；并证明此时 A=f′(x₀)，因而 dy=A dx。
zh.answer: 可导时令余项 r=Δy−f′(x₀)Δx，有 r/Δx→0；反向除以 Δx 即得差商极限 A。

solution.analysis: 证明分为两个方向。可导方向构造余项；可微方向将线性分解除以 Δx。
steps: 先设 f 在 x₀ 可导，则 lim_{Δx→0}Δy/Δx=f′(x₀)。
定义 r(Δx)=Δy−f′(x₀)Δx。对 Δx≠0，有 r(Δx)/Δx=Δy/Δx−f′(x₀)→0。
因此 r(Δx)=o(Δx)，从而 Δy=f′(x₀)Δx+o(Δx)，取 A=f′(x₀)。
反过来，设 Δy=AΔx+o(Δx)。当 Δx≠0 时，Δy/Δx=A+o(Δx)/Δx。
令 Δx→0，右侧第二项趋于 0，所以导数存在且 f′(x₀)=A。
常数 A 因而唯一，并且定义微分 dy=A dx=f′(x₀)dx。
pitfalls: 只证明一个方向
使用 o(Δx) 却不说明其商趋于 0
在 Δx=0 时直接除法
未证明 A 等于导数
solution.verification: 两方向的核心等式互为逆过程；差商极限若存在则唯一，因此 A 也唯一。
solution.takeaway: 可导性既可用差商描述，也可用增量具有线性主部描述；微分正是该线性主部。
solution.extension: 该证明同时给出可导必连续，因为 Δy=AΔx+o(Δx) 在 Δx→0 时趋于 0。

en.title: Equivalence between a Linear Increment Decomposition and a Derivative
en.prompt: Prove that a one-variable function f is differentiable at x₀ if and only if there is a constant A such that Δy=AΔx+o(Δx). Prove that A=f′(x₀), so dy=A dx.
en.answer: If the derivative exists, set r=Δy−f′(x₀)Δx and observe r/Δx→0. Conversely, divide the decomposition by Δx to obtain derivative A.

solution.analysis: Prove both directions. Construct a remainder from the derivative in one direction; divide the linear decomposition by Δx in the other.
steps: Assume first that f′(x₀) exists, so lim_{Δx→0}Δy/Δx=f′(x₀).
Define r(Δx)=Δy−f′(x₀)Δx. For Δx≠0, r/Δx=Δy/Δx−f′(x₀)→0.
Thus r=o(Δx), and Δy=f′(x₀)Δx+o(Δx), with A=f′(x₀).
Conversely, suppose Δy=AΔx+o(Δx). For Δx≠0, Δy/Δx=A+o(Δx)/Δx.
As Δx→0, the second term tends to 0, so the derivative exists and f′(x₀)=A.
Therefore A is unique, and dy=A dx=f′(x₀)dx.
pitfalls: Proving only one implication
Using o(Δx) without its ratio definition
Dividing at Δx=0
Failing to identify A with the derivative
solution.verification: The two arguments are reverse algebraic processes. Since a limit is unique, the coefficient A is unique.
solution.takeaway: A derivative can be described by a difference quotient or by a linear principal part in the increment; the differential is that principal part.
solution.extension: The same decomposition immediately proves that differentiability implies continuity because Δy→0 as Δx→0.

zh.title: 诊断错误基点与精确等号
zh.prompt: 为近似 √25.5，某同学取 f(x)=√x、x₀=25、Δx=0.5，却写 dy=f′(25.5)Δx=0.5/[2√25.5]≈0.04951，并断言 √25.5=5.04951。指出全部关键错误，给出正确的微分近似，并说明能否据此声称严格误差界。
zh.answer: 微分系数应在基点 25 计算，dy=f′(25)·0.5=(1/10)·0.5=0.05，所以 √25.5≈5.05；必须用近似号，且本方法不自动给出严格误差界。

solution.analysis: 线性化是基点处切线的预测，因此斜率必须取 f′(x₀)，不是未知目标点处的斜率；预测值也不能写成精确等式。
steps: 线性近似公式是 f(x₀+Δx)≈f(x₀)+f′(x₀)Δx，导数必须在基点 x₀ 计算。
原同学使用 f′(25.5) 相当于使用目标点未知斜率，不是所设基点的线性化；同时把近似号写成等号。
仅凭本章微分线性化不能声称一个严格误差上界；可数值核对，但不能虚构余项控制。
pitfalls: 在目标点而非基点求线性化斜率
把 dy 当作精确 Δy
误把数值核对当成严格证明
未明确基点与增量
solution.takeaway: 线性化由基点函数值和基点导数决定；结果只是一阶近似，必须使用近似号。
solution.extension: 若改用更接近且易算的基点，可提高近似质量，但仍不能在没有额外理论时声称严格误差界。

en.title: Diagnosing a Wrong Base Point and an Exact Equality
en.prompt: To approximate √25.5, a student takes f(x)=√x, x₀=25, and Δx=0.5, but writes dy=f′(25.5)Δx=0.5/[2√25.5]≈0.04951 and claims √25.5=5.04951. Identify all key errors, give the correct differential approximation, and state whether a rigorous error bound follows.
en.answer: The derivative must be evaluated at the base point 25: dy=f′(25)·0.5=(1/10)·0.5=0.05, so √25.5≈5.05. An approximation sign is required, and this method gives no automatic rigorous error bound.

solution.analysis: A linearization is the tangent prediction at the base point, so its slope is f′(x₀), not the slope at the unknown target. The prediction is not an exact equality.
steps: The formula is f(x₀+Δx)≈f(x₀)+f′(x₀)Δx, so the derivative is evaluated at x₀.
The differential is dy=f′(25)Δx=(1/10)(0.5)=0.05.
Using f′(25.5) is not the stated base-point linearization, and the student also replaces approximation by equality.
Differential linearization in this chapter alone does not provide a rigorous error bound; a numerical check is not a remainder proof.
pitfalls: Evaluating the slope at the target instead of the base point
Treating dy as exact Δy
Calling a numerical check a rigorous proof
Failing to distinguish base point and increment
solution.takeaway: A linearization uses the function value and derivative at the base point; its output is a first-order approximation.
solution.extension: A closer convenient base point may improve the approximation, but still does not create a rigorous error bound without additional theory.

zh.title: 计算第 2026 阶导数在零点的值
zh.prompt: 设 y=eˣ(cos x+sin x)。不逐阶展开，求 y⁽²⁰²⁶⁾(0)，并说明所用循环结构。

solution.analysis: 先把 cos x+sin x 合并为单个带相位的余弦，再使用每次求导振幅乘 √2、相位加 π/4 的规律。
steps: 利用 cos x+sin x=√2cos(x−π/4)，得 y=√2eˣcos(x−π/4)。
对 eˣcos(x+φ)，每求一次导数，振幅乘 √2、相位增加 π/4。
因此 y⁽ⁿ⁾=√2(√2)ⁿeˣcos(x−π/4+nπ/4)。
pitfalls: 合并三角函数时相位正负写反
只看到四阶循环而忽略振幅变化
指数 2027/2 与余弦值合并错误
solution.verification: 低阶检查：公式在 n=1 时给 2eˣcos x，恰与 y′=eˣ(cos x+sin x−sin x+cos x) 相同。
solution.takeaway: 指数三角乘积的超高阶问题可化为固定振幅倍率与有限相位循环。
solution.extension: 用同一公式计算 y⁽²⁰²⁷⁾(0)，并比较相邻两阶结果的比值。

en.title: Evaluating the 2026th Derivative at Zero
en.prompt: Let y=eˣ(cos x+sin x). Without expanding derivative by derivative, find y⁽²⁰²⁶⁾(0) and explain the cyclic structure used.

solution.analysis: First combine cos x+sin x into one phase-shifted cosine. Each differentiation then multiplies the amplitude by √2 and advances the phase by π/4.
steps: Use cos x+sin x=√2cos(x−π/4), so y=√2eˣcos(x−π/4).
For eˣcos(x+φ), every differentiation multiplies the amplitude by √2 and adds π/4 to the phase.
Hence y⁽ⁿ⁾=√2(√2)ⁿeˣcos(x−π/4+nπ/4).
Set n=2026 and x=0 to get y⁽²⁰²⁶⁾(0)=2^(2027/2)cos(2025π/4).
pitfalls: Using the wrong sign for the phase shift
Noticing a phase cycle but ignoring amplitude growth
Combining the exponent 2027/2 with the cosine value incorrectly
solution.verification: At n=1, the formula gives 2eˣcos x, exactly matching y′=eˣ(cos x+sin x−sin x+cos x).
solution.takeaway: Very high derivatives of exponential-trigonometric products reduce to a fixed amplitude multiplier and a finite phase cycle.
solution.extension: Use the same formula to compute y⁽²⁰²⁷⁾(0) and compare two consecutive values.

zh.title: 含重复极点的有理函数 n 阶导数

solution.analysis: 分母含 x²，部分分式必须同时包含 1/x 与 1/x²。分解后分别使用一次倒数和平方倒数的 n 阶公式。
steps: 两边乘 x²(x−1) 得 1=Ax(x−1)+B(x−1)+Cx²；比较系数得到 A=−1、B=−1、C=1。
使用 (x−a)⁻¹ 的 n 阶导数为 (−1)ⁿn!(x−a)⁻ⁿ⁻¹。
逐项合并并提取 (−1)ⁿn!，得到答案中的三个分式项。
pitfalls: 重复因式只写一个 A/x 项
遗漏 −1/x² 前的负号
把 (n+1)! 提取 n! 后漏掉 n+1
solution.verification: 令 n=0，公式给 1/(x−1)−1/x−1/x²；通分后分子为 x²−x(x−1)−(x−1)=1，恢复原函数。
solution.takeaway: 重复线性因式决定部分分式中必须出现一整列负幂项。
solution.extension: 若分母含 (x−a)ᵐ，则部分分式需包含从 1/(x−a) 到 1/(x−a)ᵐ 的所有幂次。

en.title: The nth Derivative of a Rational Function with a Repeated Pole
en.prompt: Let y=1/[x²(x−1)], x≠0,1. Find y⁽ⁿ⁾ for n≥0.

knowledge: Higher derivatives of negative integer powers
solution.analysis: Because the denominator contains x², the partial fractions must include both 1/x and 1/x². After decomposition, use the nth-derivative formulas for reciprocal and reciprocal-square terms.
steps: Set 1/[x²(x−1)]=A/x+B/x²+C/(x−1).
Multiplying by x²(x−1) gives 1=Ax(x−1)+B(x−1)+Cx²; coefficient comparison yields A=−1, B=−1, C=1.
Combine the three derivatives and factor (−1)ⁿn! to obtain the stated answer.
pitfalls: Using only one term A/x for a repeated factor
Dropping the minus sign before 1/x²
Forgetting the factor n+1 after factoring (n+1)!
solution.verification: At n=0, the formula is 1/(x−1)−1/x−1/x²; combining the terms gives numerator x²−x(x−1)−(x−1)=1, recovering the original function.
solution.takeaway: A repeated linear factor requires a complete ladder of reciprocal powers in the partial-fraction decomposition.
solution.extension: A factor (x−a)ᵐ requires every term from 1/(x−a) through 1/(x−a)ᵐ.

zh.title: 双参数振荡族的临界指数
zh.prompt: 设 α,β>0，且 f_{α,β}(x)={|x|^α sin(1/|x|^β), x≠0; 0, x=0}。(1) 证明 f_{α,β} 在 0 连续；(2) 完整判定它在 0 可导的充要条件；(3) 在可导情形下，完整判定 f′_{α,β} 在 0 连续的充要条件。
zh.answer: (1) 对所有 α,β>0 均连续；(2) 在 0 可导当且仅当 α>1，且 f′(0)=0；(3) f′ 在 0 连续当且仅当 α>β+1

solution.analysis: 连续性由 |x|^α 控制；可导性由差商中的指数 α-1 控制；导函数连续性还会受到相位求导产生的 |x|^{-β-1} 放大，因此临界指数提高到 β+1。
steps: 由 |f_{α,β}(x)|≤|x|^α 且 α>0，x→0 时右端趋于 0=f_{α,β}(0)，所以对所有 α,β>0，函数都在 0 连续。
原点差商为 sgn(h)|h|^{α-1}sin(1/|h|^β)。若 α>1，其绝对值不超过 |h|^{α-1}→0，故 f′(0)=0。
若 α=1，取正数列 h_n=(1/(π/2+2πn))^{1/β}，差商恒为 1；再取 k_n=(1/(3π/2+2πn))^{1/β}，差商恒为 -1，故导数不存在。
若 0<α<1，沿同一 h_n 有差商 h_n^{α-1}→+∞，没有有限导数。因此在 0 可导当且仅当 α>1。
对 x≠0 求导得 f′(x)=sgn(x)[α|x|^{α-1}sin(1/|x|^β)-β|x|^{α-β-1}cos(1/|x|^β)]。
若 α>β+1，则 α-1>0 且 α-β-1>0，两个括号项的绝对值分别被 α|x|^{α-1}、β|x|^{α-β-1} 控制并趋于 0，所以 f′(x)→0=f′(0)。
若 1<α≤β+1，取 x_n=(1/(2πn))^{1/β}>0，则正弦项为 0、余弦项为 1，故 f′(x_n)=-βx_n^{α-β-1}；指数为 0 时恒为 -β，指数为负时绝对值无界，都不趋于 0。
因此在可导范围内，f′ 在 0 连续当且仅当 α>β+1。
pitfalls: 只看函数中的 |x|^α 而忽略差商会降低一次幂
求相位 1/|x|^β 的导数时漏掉 sgn(x) 或指数 β+1
必要性只说“振荡”却不给数列
把 α>1 与 α>β+1 混为一个条件
solution.verification: 取 (α,β)=(2,1)，函数在 0 可导但 α=β+1，导函数不连续；取 (3,1)，有 α>β+1，导函数连续，说明两个临界条件确实不同。
solution.takeaway: 每进行一次差商或相位求导，都要重新计算控制振荡的净幂次；临界指数由最强放大项决定。
solution.extension: 将 sin 换成 cos 并适当重新定义 f(0)，可设计相似的连续、可导与导函数连续分类问题。

en.title: Critical Exponents in a Two-Parameter Oscillatory Family
en.prompt: Let α,β>0 and f_{α,β}(x)={|x|^α sin(1/|x|^β), x≠0; 0, x=0}. (1) Prove that f_{α,β} is continuous at 0. (2) Completely classify differentiability at 0. (3) When it is differentiable, completely classify continuity of f′_{α,β} at 0.
en.answer: (1) Continuous for all α,β>0; (2) differentiable at 0 exactly when α>1, with f′(0)=0; (3) f′ is continuous at 0 exactly when α>β+1

solution.analysis: Continuity is controlled by |x|^α. Differentiability is controlled by α-1 in the quotient. Differentiating the phase introduces the amplification |x|^{-β-1}, raising the critical exponent for continuity of the derivative to β+1.
steps: Since |f_{α,β}(x)|≤|x|^α and α>0, the right-hand side tends to 0=f_{α,β}(0) as x→0. Thus the function is continuous at 0 for all α,β>0.
The origin quotient is sgn(h)|h|^{α-1}sin(1/|h|^β). If α>1, its absolute value is at most |h|^{α-1}→0, so f′(0)=0.
If α=1, take positive h_n=(1/(π/2+2πn))^{1/β}, for which the quotient is 1, and k_n=(1/(3π/2+2πn))^{1/β}, for which it is -1. Thus no derivative exists.
If 0<α<1, along the same h_n the quotient is h_n^{α-1}→+∞, so there is no finite derivative. Hence differentiability at 0 holds exactly when α>1.
For x≠0, differentiation gives f′(x)=sgn(x)[α|x|^{α-1}sin(1/|x|^β)-β|x|^{α-β-1}cos(1/|x|^β)].
If α>β+1, then α-1>0 and α-β-1>0. The two terms are bounded in absolute value by α|x|^{α-1} and β|x|^{α-β-1}, so both tend to 0 and f′(x)→0=f′(0).
If 1<α≤β+1, take x_n=(1/(2πn))^{1/β}>0. Then the sine term is 0 and the cosine term is 1, so f′(x_n)=-βx_n^{α-β-1}. It equals -β when the exponent is 0 and is unbounded when the exponent is negative.
Therefore, within the differentiable range, f′ is continuous at 0 exactly when α>β+1.
pitfalls: looking only at |x|^α and forgetting that a difference quotient lowers the power by one
omitting sgn(x) or β+1 when differentiating the phase
claiming necessity from vague oscillation without sequences
confusing the conditions α>1 and α>β+1
solution.verification: For (α,β)=(2,1), the function is differentiable at 0 but α=β+1, so its derivative is not continuous. For (3,1), α>β+1 and the derivative is continuous, confirming that the thresholds differ.
solution.takeaway: After each difference quotient or phase differentiation, recompute the net power controlling the oscillation; the strongest amplification determines the critical exponent.
solution.extension: Replacing sine by cosine and redefining f(0) appropriately produces a related classification problem for continuity, differentiability, and continuity of the derivative.

zh.title: 对数平方的 n 阶导数与调和数
zh.prompt: 定义 H₀=0，Hₘ=1+1/2+⋯+1/m（m≥1）。对 x>0，用数学归纳法证明：当 n≥1 时，[(ln x)²]⁽ⁿ⁾=2(−1)ⁿ⁻¹(n−1)!x⁻ⁿ[ln x−Hₙ₋₁]。
zh.answer: 公式对所有 n≥1 成立；归纳步骤利用 Hₙ=Hₙ₋₁+1/n。

solution.analysis: 公式同时包含阶乘、负幂和随 n 改变的常数。归纳求导后，把新出现的 1/n 与 Hₙ₋₁ 合并为 Hₙ，是证明的关键。
steps: 当 n=1 时，右边为 2(ln x−H₀)/x=2ln x/x，正是 [(ln x)²]′，起点成立。
假设 n 阶公式成立，并暂记 C=2(−1)ⁿ⁻¹(n−1)!。
对 Cx⁻ⁿ(ln x−Hₙ₋₁) 求导，得到 Cx⁻ⁿ⁻¹[1−n(ln x−Hₙ₋₁)]。
将括号整理为 −n[ln x−Hₙ₋₁−1/n]=−n[ln x−Hₙ]，其中用了 Hₙ=Hₙ₋₁+1/n。
系数 C(−n)=2(−1)ⁿn!，故得到 2(−1)ⁿn!x⁻ⁿ⁻¹[ln x−Hₙ]。
这正是把 n 替换为 n+1 后的目标公式，归纳步骤成立。
因此所给公式对所有整数 n≥1 成立。
pitfalls: 忘记 H₀=0 导致起点不成立
乘积求导时漏掉 ln x 的导数 1/x
将 Hₙ₋₁+1/n 错写成 Hₙ₊₁
solution.verification: 取 n=2，公式给 −2x⁻²(ln x−1)=2(1−ln x)/x²；直接对 2ln x/x 求导也得到同式。
solution.takeaway: 复杂 n 阶公式常通过一个恰当的递推量吸收每次求导新产生的常数。
solution.extension: 直接计算 n=3，并核对公式中的 H₂=3/2 如何出现在结果中。

en.title: The nth Derivative of a Squared Logarithm and Harmonic Numbers
en.prompt: Define H₀=0 and Hₘ=1+1/2+⋯+1/m for m≥1. For x>0, prove by induction that for n≥1, [(ln x)²]⁽ⁿ⁾=2(−1)ⁿ⁻¹(n−1)!x⁻ⁿ[ln x−Hₙ₋₁].
en.answer: The formula holds for every n≥1; the induction step uses Hₙ=Hₙ₋₁+1/n.

solution.analysis: The formula contains a factorial, a negative power, and an n-dependent constant. After differentiating in the induction step, the new 1/n combines with Hₙ₋₁ to form Hₙ.
steps: For n=1, the right side is 2(ln x−H₀)/x=2ln x/x, exactly [(ln x)²]′, so the base case holds.
Assume the formula for n and abbreviate C=2(−1)ⁿ⁻¹(n−1)!.
Differentiate Cx⁻ⁿ(ln x−Hₙ₋₁) to obtain Cx⁻ⁿ⁻¹[1−n(ln x−Hₙ₋₁)].
Rewrite the bracket as −n[ln x−Hₙ₋₁−1/n]=−n[ln x−Hₙ], using Hₙ=Hₙ₋₁+1/n.
Since C(−n)=2(−1)ⁿn!, the result is 2(−1)ⁿn!x⁻ⁿ⁻¹[ln x−Hₙ].
This is precisely the claimed formula with n replaced by n+1, so the induction step holds.
Therefore the formula is valid for every integer n≥1.
pitfalls: Forgetting H₀=0 in the base case
Omitting the derivative 1/x of ln x in the product rule
Replacing Hₙ₋₁+1/n by Hₙ₊₁
solution.verification: At n=2, the formula gives −2x⁻²(ln x−1)=2(1−ln x)/x²; direct differentiation of 2ln x/x gives the same expression.
solution.takeaway: A carefully chosen recurrence can absorb the new constant produced at every differentiation step in a complicated nth-order formula.
solution.extension: Compute n=3 directly and check how H₂=3/2 appears in the result.

zh: 隐函数二阶导数一般式

zh.title: 可分隐式方程的二阶导数通式
zh.prompt: 设 φ、ψ 二阶可导，y=y(x) 满足 φ(x)+ψ(y)=C，且 ψ′(y)≠0。证明 y″=−{φ″(x)[ψ′(y)]²+[φ′(x)]²ψ″(y)}/[ψ′(y)]³。全程只用第二章求导法则。
zh.answer: 先由 y′=−φ′/ψ′，再对 φ′+ψ′y′=0 求导并代回 y′，即可得到所给通式。

solution.analysis: 直接对一阶关系 φ′(x)+ψ′(y)y′=0 再求导，比对分式 y′=−φ′/ψ′ 使用商法则更清晰。
steps: 第一次求导得到 φ′(x)+ψ′(y)y′=0，因此 y′=−φ′(x)/ψ′(y)。
对一阶关系再次求导，φ′(x) 给出 φ″(x)。
对 ψ′(y)y′ 使用乘积法则与链式法则，得到 ψ″(y)(y′)²+ψ′(y)y″。
所有分式均由 ψ′(y)≠0 保证有定义，公式得证。
pitfalls: 把 d[ψ′(y)]/dx 写成 ψ″(y) 而漏掉 y′
对 ψ′(y)y′ 不用乘积法则
代入 y′ 后漏掉平方
通分时把分母幂次写成 2
solution.verification: 取 φ=x²、ψ=y²，通式给 y″=−[2(2y)²+(2x)²·2]/(2y)³=−(x²+y²)/y³；由圆方程直接二次求导也得到同式。
solution.takeaway: 一般二阶隐式公式来自对一阶关系再求导；最关键的新项是 ψ″(y)(y′)²。
solution.extension: 对具体题目通常不必背通式，保留一阶导数关系逐次求导更不易出错。

en.title: A General Second-Derivative Formula for a Separable Implicit Equation
en.prompt: Let φ and ψ be twice differentiable, with y=y(x) satisfying φ(x)+ψ(y)=C and ψ′(y)≠0. Prove y″=−{φ″(x)[ψ′(y)]²+[φ′(x)]²ψ″(y)}/[ψ′(y)]³ using only the differentiation rules of this chapter.
en.answer: First obtain y′=−φ′/ψ′, then differentiate φ′+ψ′y′=0 again and substitute y′.

solution.analysis: Differentiating the first relation φ′(x)+ψ′(y)y′=0 again is clearer than applying the quotient rule directly to y′=−φ′/ψ′.
steps: The first derivative gives φ′(x)+ψ′(y)y′=0, hence y′=−φ′(x)/ψ′(y).
Differentiate the first relation again; φ′(x) becomes φ″(x).
The product and chain rules give d[ψ′(y)y′]/dx=ψ″(y)(y′)²+ψ′(y)y″.
Thus φ″(x)+ψ″(y)(y′)²+ψ′(y)y″=0.
Solve for y″=−[φ″(x)+ψ″(y)(y′)²]/ψ′(y).
Substitute (y′)²=[φ′(x)]²/[ψ′(y)]² and combine denominators to obtain the stated formula.
The condition ψ′(y)≠0 makes every division valid.
pitfalls: Omitting y′ from d[ψ′(y)]/dx
Failing to use the product rule on ψ′(y)y′
Forgetting the square on y′
Using denominator power 2 instead of 3
solution.verification: For φ=x² and ψ=y², the formula gives y″=−(x²+y²)/y³, exactly as direct second differentiation of a circle does.
solution.takeaway: The general second implicit formula comes from differentiating the first relation again; the new key term is ψ″(y)(y′)².
solution.extension: For specific problems, repeatedly differentiating the relation is usually safer than memorizing the general formula.

zh.title: 从可微定义证明微分乘积法则
zh.prompt: 设 u=u(x)、v=v(x) 在 x₀ 可微。仅用增量分解证明乘积 uv 在 x₀ 可微，且 d(uv)=v du+u dv。不得引用中值定理或更后章节工具。
zh.answer: 由 Δu=u′Δx+o(Δx)、Δv=v′Δx+o(Δx)，展开 Δ(uv)=vΔu+uΔv+ΔuΔv；最后一项为 o(Δx)，线性主部为 (vu′+uv′)Δx。

solution.analysis: 不能先引用导数乘积法则。应从乘积的新旧值之差出发，证明其增量具有线性主部。
steps: 在基点 x₀ 记 u=u(x₀)、v=v(x₀)。可微性给出 Δu=u′(x₀)Δx+o(Δx)，Δv=v′(x₀)Δx+o(Δx)。
乘积增量为 Δ(uv)=(u+Δu)(v+Δv)−uv=vΔu+uΔv+ΔuΔv。
代入前两项，vΔu+uΔv=[vu′(x₀)+uv′(x₀)]Δx+o(Δx)。
对余下乘积，有 (ΔuΔv)/Δx=(Δu/Δx)Δv；其中 Δu/Δx→u′(x₀)，而 Δv→0，所以该比值趋于 0，即 ΔuΔv=o(Δx)。
因此 Δ(uv)=[vu′(x₀)+uv′(x₀)]Δx+o(Δx)，这证明 uv 在 x₀ 可微。
其线性主部定义为 d(uv)=[vu′+uv′]dx=v(u′dx)+u(v′dx)=v du+u dv。
整个证明只用了可微定义、代数展开与高阶小量运算。
pitfalls: 循环引用导数乘积法则
展开乘积增量时漏掉 ΔuΔv
未证明 ΔuΔv=o(Δx)
把基点值 u、v 与增量混淆
solution.verification: 取 u=x、v=x²，则公式给 d(x³)=x²dx+x·2x dx=3x²dx，与幂函数微分一致。
solution.takeaway: 微分运算法则可从增量的线性主部推出；二阶乘积 ΔuΔv 被归入高阶余项。
solution.extension: 用同样思路可从增量恒等式推导和、差的微分法则；商法则还需分母基点值非零。

en.title: Proving the Product Rule for Differentials from the Definition
en.prompt: Let u=u(x) and v=v(x) be differentiable at x₀. Using only increment decompositions, prove that uv is differentiable at x₀ and d(uv)=v du+u dv. Do not cite the mean value theorem or later-chapter tools.
en.answer: Use Δu=u′Δx+o(Δx), Δv=v′Δx+o(Δx), and Δ(uv)=vΔu+uΔv+ΔuΔv. The last term is o(Δx), leaving linear part (vu′+uv′)Δx.

solution.analysis: Do not invoke the derivative product rule. Start from the difference between the new and old product and prove that its increment has a linear principal part.
steps: At x₀ write u=u(x₀), v=v(x₀). Differentiability gives Δu=u′(x₀)Δx+o(Δx) and Δv=v′(x₀)Δx+o(Δx).
The product increment is Δ(uv)=(u+Δu)(v+Δv)−uv=vΔu+uΔv+ΔuΔv.
Substitution in the first two terms gives vΔu+uΔv=[vu′(x₀)+uv′(x₀)]Δx+o(Δx).
For the remaining product, (ΔuΔv)/Δx=(Δu/Δx)Δv. Here Δu/Δx→u′(x₀) and Δv→0, so the ratio tends to 0 and ΔuΔv=o(Δx).
Thus Δ(uv)=[vu′(x₀)+uv′(x₀)]Δx+o(Δx), proving uv differentiable at x₀.
Its linear principal part is d(uv)=[vu′+uv′]dx=v(u′dx)+u(v′dx)=v du+u dv.
The argument uses only the differentiability definition, algebraic expansion, and small-order arithmetic.
pitfalls: Circularly citing the derivative product rule
Dropping ΔuΔv
Failing to show ΔuΔv=o(Δx)
Confusing base values with increments
solution.verification: For u=x and v=x², the rule gives d(x³)=x²dx+x·2x dx=3x²dx, matching the power-function differential.
solution.takeaway: Differential rules follow from linear principal parts; the product ΔuΔv is absorbed into the higher-order remainder.
solution.extension: The same method proves sum and difference rules; a quotient rule additionally requires a nonzero denominator value at the base point.
